🎨 FEATURES

fdroid:com.aistudio.snoredetector.afkwd.name: Snore Detector
fdroid:com.aistudio.snoredetector.afkwd.summary: Detects snoring during sleep and records snore events.
fdroid:com.aistudio.snoredetector.afkwd.description:
Snore Detector is a privacy-first, 100% open source Android app for real-time snore detection and sleep analysis. All audio processing happens entirely on your device—no cloud services, tracking, telemetry, or network connection required.
Features
• Real-time snore detection using multiple digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms, including decibel level, RMS power, Zero-Crossing Rate (ZCR), snore-band spectral energy (100 Hz–1 kHz), and low-frequency spectral analysis.
• Privacy by design. Audio never leaves your device. No accounts, analytics, advertising, or external servers.
• Adjustable detection settings. Customize sensitivity and enable or disable individual detection algorithms.
• Snore event history. Detected events are stored locally with timestamps, duration, peak volume, and confidence information.
• Optional audio recording. Save short WAV recordings of detected snoring events for later playback.
• CSV export. Export your detection history for personal analysis or to share with healthcare professionals.
• Modern interface. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3, supporting light and dark themes.
Privacy & F-Droid
Snore Detector is fully offline and designed to comply with F-Droid's Free Software principles.
No analytics or telemetry
No advertisements
No proprietary SDKs
No tracking
No cloud services
Works entirely offline
The app only requires the permissions needed for audio monitoring and background operation.
Technology
Kotlin
Jetpack Compose (Material 3)
Room database
Kotlin Coroutines & StateFlow
Android AudioRecord with on-device FFT-based signal processing
Foreground Service for continuous overnight monitoring
Snore Detector is free software released under an open-source license, giving you full control over your sleep data while providing reliable overnight snore monitoring.

fdroid:com.antivocale.app.name: Anti-Vocale
fdroid:com.antivocale.app.summary: Transcribe voice notes and calls on-device
fdroid:com.antivocale.app.description:
Anti-Vocale transcribes voice messages from WhatsApp, Telegram, and other messaging apps directly on your Android device. All processing happens on-device: your audio never leaves your phone. It works on recorded calls and meetings too: recordings of any length are split and stitched automatically (up to two hours on the streaming path), a failed run keeps the transcript it produced, and long transcripts can be exported as subtitles (SRT, VTT) or timestamped text, with sentence-level timing on streaming models.
BUILT-IN MODELS
- Parakeet TDT (recommended): fast, 25 European languages. Two variants: high-quality (862MB) or compact (640MB)
- Whisper Turbo: 99 languages, balanced speed and quality
- Whisper Distil Italian: best Italian quality, tuned for voice messages
- Whisper Medium / Small: more accuracy or smaller download
- Nemotron 3.5 streaming: text appears in real time while it decodes, 45 languages
- Qwen3-ASR: compact, 59 languages
- GigaAM v3: Russian, very small and fast
- Gemma 4 / 3n (LiteRT): multimodal AI with customizable prompts
BRING YOUR OWN MODELS
Import custom transcription models from a folder on your phone or from a link: Whisper fine-tunes, CTC models, SenseVoice and other sherpa-onnx architectures. Files are integrity-checked on import, split-file models are supported, and every imported model gets its own share target. Ideal for languages the built-in models don't cover.
FEATURES
- Share voice messages from any app via the Android share sheet
- Smart notifications: one-tap copy, share back, page through long transcripts without opening the app
- Auto-copy to clipboard and auto-save transcripts to a folder you pick (Drive, Syncthing, ...)
- Video file transcription (audio track extracted)
- Real-time progressive text with streaming models
- Per-app notification preferences
- Transcription log with search and swipe actions
- In-row audio playback: replay a recent transcription's audio right from its history row, with speed control and an optional skip-silences mode
- Silence stripping and parallel chunk processing for speed
- Neural acceleration (NNAPI) on supported devices, with automatic CPU fallback
- Tasker integration for automation
- Scheduled folder watch: transcribe new audio files in folders you choose automatically (on Android 11+, even a messaging app's media folder)
- Remote offload (experimental, off by default): delegate long transcriptions to your own OpenAI-compatible server
- WhatsApp voice notes transcribe themselves: new voice notes in WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business become transcripts as they arrive, zero taps, with the sender's name when it can be confirmed
- Built for aggressive battery savers: an opt-in background protection keeps transcription running with the screen off (Realme, Oppo, OnePlus, Vivo and similar), and the app recovers on its own from crashes and corrupted models
- Open Transcribe provider (experimental): apps that speak the open contract, like Forkgram, turn Anti-Vocale into their inline voice transcriber
PRIVACY
No network needed after download, no accounts, no data collection, no ads, no tracking. By default the audio never leaves your phone; the only exception is the optional Remote offload feature, which sends audio solely to the server address you configure and stays off unless you turn it on.
OPEN SOURCE
Apache 2.0. Source code: https://github.com/RisorseArtificiali/anti-vocale
REQUIREMENTS
Android 8.0+ | 4GB+ RAM recommended | 326MB-4.7GB storage per model
NOTE: on some phones with aggressive battery savers (Realme, OnePlus, Vivo), open the app once after sharing audio so the transcription can finish; the Background transcription protection setting helps keep long runs alive with the screen off.

fdroid:com.musicremover.app.name: Murem
fdroid:com.musicremover.app.summary: Remove background music from videos and keep the voices, right on your phone.
fdroid:com.musicremover.app.description:
Murem removes the background music from videos and audio and keeps the voices and dialogue, using AI vocal separation. It can now do this on your phone, with no server.
Processing modes:
• Internal (on-device): the separation model runs on the phone with ONNX Runtime. No server and no Termux needed
• Local (Termux): run the Murem server in Termux on the same phone, with one-tap Install / Start / Stop
• Server: connect to your own server on a PC for faster GPU processing (Docker supported, found on the local network with mDNS)
Input:
• Links from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Vimeo and other sites supported by yt-dlp
• Several links at once: paste, add, or import a .txt file
• Local video and audio files (MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, M4A and more)
• Share from any app to start; the right mode opens automatically
• Built-in yt-dlp, updated from Settings when links stop working
Models:
• On-device: MDX-NET HQ3, MDX-NET Voc FT, a small 30 MB model for low-end phones (MDX-NET 3_9662), UVR KARA 2 for the lead vocal only, and Kim Vocal 2 (optional, with a license notice)
• Models download on first use and can be deleted to free space
• Server and Termux: Kim Vocal 2, MDX-NET HQ3, Karaoke, Mel-Band RoFormer, BS-RoFormer, or any custom audio-separator model
Output:
• MP4 with the original video, or audio only as MP3 or M4A
• Bitrate 128k / 192k / 320k
• Performance settings for on-device jobs: threads, quality or speed, batch size, and a time estimate while processing
• Optional GPU acceleration with a load limit, and live GPU, CPU, memory and heat graphs while processing
Sites that need a login:
• Log in inside Murem with the built-in browser, or import a cookies.txt file
• Cookies are kept per site, can be switched on or off per site, and are excluded from backups
Player:
• Built-in player with an audio waveform: tap to play or pause, drag to seek
• Rewind / forward 10 s, loop, volume, fullscreen with landscape rotation
• Open in an external player (VLC, MX Player and others)
History:
• Recent results show where each one was made: On device, Termux or Server
• Search, long-press for video details, save and share results, export all at once
• Processing queue that survives app restarts
Design:
• Redesigned Home screen with one input card for links and files
• Settings split into clear sections
• Two-pane layouts on tablets and other large screens
• Light, Dark, Black (OLED) and System themes
• Material You colors on Android 12+, or one of 8 color palettes
• Home screen widget with 4 themes
• 16 languages
Privacy:
• In Internal mode, processing stays on your device. Files are not uploaded anywhere
• Login cookies are stored only on the device and are only sent to the sites you switch on
• In Server or Termux mode, files go only to the server you run yourself
• Network access is used to download links, models (from GitHub and Hugging Face) and yt-dlp updates
Murem is open source (MIT). On-device processing is slow on most phones and uses a lot of battery, so keep the phone charging for long videos.

fdroid:dev.darshit.daak.name: Daak
fdroid:dev.darshit.daak.summary: Send files and text between your own devices over Wi-Fi. No account.
fdroid:dev.darshit.daak.description:
Daak (डाक, "post") moves photos, files, and text between your own devices over your local network. Nothing goes through the internet. Nothing goes through a server. You do not create an account.
Pair two devices once. Scan a QR code and check that both screens show the same number. After that, pick an item and send it.

 End-to-end encryption between paired devices.
 Local network only. No account and no internet relay.
 Files of any size. Daak sends 1 MiB chunks, so memory use stays low.
 Send text and photos as well as files.
 Works with Daak on macOS and iOS.
 Permissions 
 Camera: scan the QR code when you pair a device.
 Local network and Wi-Fi multicast: find your paired devices.
 Notifications: show the result of a transfer.
Daak receives files only while the app is running.

fdroid:me.testcase.ognarviewer.name: OGN AR Viewer
fdroid:me.testcase.ognarviewer.summary: Experimental augmented reality client to the Open Glider Network (OGN).
fdroid:me.testcase.ognarviewer.description:
Discover aircraft around you with OGN AR Viewer, an experimental privacy-friendly augmented reality client to the OGN (Open Glider Network). Keep a private directory of the aircraft that belong to your club or friends and see how far they are. For free and without advertisements.
Privacy note: the application needs to send your location to the OGN in order to listen for aircraft beacons around you and because the OGN doesn’t support encryption, this happens in clear text. The good news is that OGN AR Viewer reduces the location accuracy to about 5 km before transmitting it and then restores it back on recipient, so the fine location never leaves your device. It further anonymizes you by connecting to the OGN without identification (other clients based on the official library generate an identifier based on your hostname). Check out the privacy policy to learn more (it is written in simple language and has illustrations).

fdroid:org.arkikeskus.launcher.name: ARK-launcher
fdroid:org.arkikeskus.launcher.summary: A modern, customizable home-screen launcher built with Jetpack Compose
fdroid:org.arkikeskus.launcher.description:
ARK-launcher is a modern, lightweight Android home-screen launcher built entirely with Jetpack Compose and Material 3. It is available in English, Finnish, German, Spanish, French, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish and Turkish, and works as a standalone launcher for anyone.
Features:
* Paged home screen with free icon placement and smooth drag-and-drop — move icons within a page, across pages, and between the home grid and the dock.
* Dock of favourite apps.
* App drawer with universal search: apps, system settings pages, contacts (opt-in), and a calculator / unit converter, plus an optional most-used apps row.
* Home-screen widgets — add, resize, move, reconfigure, and stretch a widget to full width. Collection widgets (chat lists, calendars) scroll in place.
* Built-in widgets: a clock with the date, your next event, the next alarm and optional weather; battery; notifications; and people (conversations grouped by person).
* Folders on the home screen and inside the app drawer.
* Third-party icon packs (ADW/Nova appfilter format) and Material You themed icons.
* Configurable gestures: swipe up for the app drawer, swipe down for notifications, and a configurable left-edge swipe.
* Notification dots / badges, and an optional themed status bar.
* Backup and restore your layout and settings to a file. Widgets are included in backups.
* Double-tap empty home-screen space to lock the screen (opt-in).
* Lock desktop, hide apps, rename apps with custom labels, and a self-contained settings screen.
Network use: the only feature that uses the internet is the optional weather in the clock widget. It needs the location permission and fetches the current weather from Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) with your location rounded to about 1 km. The place name comes from the phone's own geocoder; only if you turn on "Place name from the internet" (off by default) and the phone has no geocoder of its own is the name looked up from BigDataCloud (bigdatacloud.com). With the weather turned off in Settings, the app makes no network requests.
Free and open-source under the Apache-2.0 license.

fdroid:org.fossify.home.name: Fossify Launcher Beta
fdroid:org.fossify.home.summary: Customize your home screen with a fast, ad-free, open-source launcher
fdroid:org.fossify.home.description:
Fossify Launcher is your gateway to a fast, personalized, and privacy-first home screen experience. No ads, no bloat – just a smooth, efficient launcher designed to fit your unique style and preferences.
 🚀 LIGHTNING-FAST NAVIGATION: 
Navigate your device with speed and precision. Fossify Launcher is optimized to be responsive and fluid, giving you instant access to your favorite apps without lag.
 🎨 FULL CUSTOMIZATION: 
Tailor your home screen with dynamic themes, custom colors, and layouts. Personalize your launcher to match your style with easy-to-use tools that let you create a truly unique setup.
 🖼️ COMPLETE WIDGET SUPPORT: 
Integrate fully resizable widgets with ease. Whether you need clocks, calendars, or other handy tools, Fossify Launcher ensures they blend seamlessly into your home screen design.
 📱 NO UNWANTED CLUTTER: 
Effortlessly manage your apps by hiding or uninstalling them in just a few taps, keeping your home screen organized and clutter-free.
 🔒 PRIVACY AND SECURITY: 
Your privacy is at the heart of Fossify Launcher. With no internet access and no intrusive permissions, your data stays with you. No tracking, no ads – just a launcher built to respect your privacy.
 🌐 OPEN-SOURCE ASSURANCE:

fdroid:org.totschnig.ocr.tesseract.name: OCR (Tesseract)
fdroid:org.totschnig.ocr.tesseract.summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) functionality based on Tesseract via Intents
fdroid:org.totschnig.ocr.tesseract.description:
This app bundles OCR functionality (based on Tesseract) that can be called from other apps via Intents. It listens for Intents with action "org.totschnig.ocr.action.RECOGNIZE" and expects an Uri pointing to a JPEG file as data. The recognized text is passed back in the extra "result" as an object of a parcelable data class Text, that must be copied into the client app.
This app is not intended to be useful stand-alone. It was created out of the motivation to not blow up the size of an application that makes use OCR for a feature that is not needed by all users. Currently it is used by My Expenses for scanning receipts.
Before you start using it, you need to configure the language that Tesseract should use, which triggers the download of the necessary trained models, hence the need for INTERNET permission.

winget-run-community:NirSoft.NK2Edit.name: NirSoft NK2Edit
winget-run-community:NirSoft.NK2Edit.summary:
Every time that you type an email address or name in the message window of MS-Outlook, it automatically offer you a list of users and email address that you can choose. This feature is known as 'AutoComplete' and Outlook automatically build this emails list according to user activity and save it into a file with .NK2 extension. 
In some circumstances, you may need to repair or modify the values appeared in the AutoComplete list, or you may want to remove unwanted email addresses and/or to add new email addresses. MS-Outlook doesn't provide any ability to edit this AutoComplete list, so this is where NK2Edit software can help you.

flathub:com.sciactive.QuickDAV.name: QuickDAV
flathub:com.sciactive.QuickDAV.description:
Network file and folder transfer app. Simple and easy upload, download, and management of
 your files and folders from any other device.
 It works by creating a temporary, secure WebDAV server that you can connect to from a
 remote device. If your device doesn't support WebDAV, you can connect with a web browser.

flathub:com.voxdsp.TheCatrooms.name: The Catrooms
flathub:com.voxdsp.TheCatrooms.description:
The Backrooms, catified. Find all 14 trinkets before the cat emojis get you!
 Follow the floating eye to obtain the trinkets before the demonic cats get to you!! There are 14 trinkets in total and the final trinket will have no floating eye to guide you, instead the sky will turn more red the closer you are to it! Once you have won the game the sky will turn yellow.
 ESCAPE to release mouse lock.
 Mouse Move to Look Around.
 Arrow Keys or WASD to Move Around.

flathub:io.github.hakuneko.HakuNeko.name: HakuNeko
flathub:io.github.hakuneko.HakuNeko.summary: A cross-platform downloader for manga and anime from various websites
flathub:io.github.hakuneko.HakuNeko.description:
HakuNeko is a cross-platform downloader for manga and anime from various websites. 
 HakuNeko was made to help users downloading media for circumstances that require offline usage. 
 The philosophy is ad-hoc consumption, get it when you going to read/watch it. 
 It is not meant to be a mass downloader to stock up thousands of chapters that are just collected and will probably never be read.

flathub:io.github.pieterdd.RcloneShuttle.name: Rclone Shuttle
flathub:io.github.pieterdd.RcloneShuttle.description:
Access all your cloud storage providers from one app. Powered by Rclone's superb command line
 tool, Rclone Shuttle lets you browse your files wherever they are hosted.
 Rclone Shuttle can:
 Upload files via drag and drop
 Rename, move, copy and delete files/folders
 Open remote files locally via double click
 Permanently save a local copy of specific files/folders
 Handle encrypted Rclone configuration files
 Rclone supports a variety of providers and protocols including:
 Amazon S3
 Dropbox
 FTP
 Google Cloud Storage
 Google Drive
 Google Photos
 OneDrive
 Proton Drive
 SFTP
 SMB (Samba)
 WebDAV (works with Nextcloud)
 Full host filesystem access is necessary to enable drag-and-drop until
 https://github.com/pieterdd/RcloneShuttle/issues/7 is fixed.

flathub:io.gitlab.news_flash.NewsFlash.name: Newsflash
flathub:io.gitlab.news_flash.NewsFlash.description:
Newsflash is a program designed to complement an already existing web-based RSS reader account.
 It combines all the advantages of web based services like syncing across all your devices with
 everything you expect from a modern desktop program: Desktop notifications, fast search and filtering,
 tagging, handy keyboard shortcuts and having access to all your articles for as long as you like.

flathub:net.rpdev.OpenTodoList.name: OpenTodoList
flathub:net.rpdev.OpenTodoList.summary: Todo list and note taking application
flathub:net.rpdev.OpenTodoList.description:
OpenTodoList is a todo list and note taking application. It is
 available for Linux, macOS and Windows as well as on Android.
 Your information can be shared across devices to keep everything
 up date date, where ever you go.
 Organize todo lists, notes and other items in libraries
 Synchronize out-of-the-box with NextCloud, ownCloud and other WebDAV
 servers
 Use sync clients of your choice to synchronize with arbitrary
 services
 Schedule items by setting due dates on them
 Use Markdown in item titles and descriptions to format text
 as you like

flathub:org.kde.kanagram.name: Kanagram
flathub:org.kde.kanagram.description:
Kanagram is a game based on anagrams of words: the puzzle is solved when the letters of the
 scrambled word are put back in the correct order. There is no limit on either time taken, or the
 amount of attempts to solve the word. It features several included word lists, a hints-and-cheats
 help system, a word list editor, and allows for updating and distributing wordlists via KNewStuff.
 The interface is scalable and appropriate for children.

flathub:org.kde.konquest.name: Konquest
flathub:org.kde.konquest.description:
Konquest is a version of Gnu-Lactic Konquest. Players conquer other planets by sending ships
 to them. The goal is to build an interstellar empire and ultimately conquer all other player's
 planets.

flathub:org.kde.kwave.name: Kwave
flathub:org.kde.kwave.description:
Kwave is a sound editor that can record to, play, open, and edit many file formats. Kwave makes
 it simple to edit audio in many ways.
 Adjust volume level:
 Fade in, fade out, or custom amplitude curve
 Scale volume by a constant factor
 Normalize volume
 Adjust frequency content:
 Lowpass filter
 Bandpass filter
 Notch filter
 Pitch shift
 Other features:
 Add noise
 Add silence
 Convert audio sample rate
 Go to position
 Insert audio from clipboard
 Reverse audio
 Save audio blocks between labels as separate files
 Sonagram (spectrogram)
 Supported file formats:
 WAV (*.wav)
 Ogg/Opus (*.opus)
 Ogg/Vorbis (*.ogg)
 MP3 (*.mp3)
 FLAC (*.flac)
 ASCII coded audio (*.ascii)
 all file formats supported by libaudiofile (some formats are import only)
flathub:org.kde.kwave.category: Qt, KDE, AudioVideo, Audio, AudioVideoEditing, Player, Recorder

flathub:uk.org.zint.zint-qt.name: Zint Barcode Studio
flathub:uk.org.zint.zint-qt.description:
The Zint project aims to provide a complete barcode generating solution. It is hoped that Zint
 provides a solution which is flexible enough for professional users while at the same time takes
 care of as much of the processing as possible to allow easy translation from input data to barcode
 image.
 Zint is currently able to encode data in over 50 barcode symbologies (types of barcode), for
 each of which it is possible to translate that data from either Unicode (UTF-8) or a raw 8-bit
 data stream. The image can be rendered as either a Portable Network Graphic (PNG) image, Windows
 Bitmap (BMP), Graphics Interchange Format (GIF), ZSoft Paintbrush image (PCX), as Encapsulated
 Post Script (EPS) or as a Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG). Many options are available for setting
 the characteristics of the output image including the size and colour of the image, the amount
 of error correction used in the symbol and, in the case of raster images, the orientation of the
 image.

flathub:xyz.audiostellar.AudioStellar.name: AudioStellar
flathub:xyz.audiostellar.AudioStellar.description: AudioStellar is an AI powered experimental sampler that is free, open source and available for Mac, Linux and Windows. It generates interactive maps from users’ sound collections and it allows to explore any sound corpus by timbric similarity and play audio clips in creative ways: parametric autonomous agents, rhythmic constellations, free trajectories in latent space or custom heuristics using MIDI and OSC.

fedora-packages:amanda/amanda.name: amanda
fedora-packages:amanda/amanda.description: AMANDA, the Advanced Maryland Automatic Network Disk Archiver, is a backup system that allows the administrator of a LAN to set up a single master backup server to back up multiple hosts to one or more tape drives or disk files. AMANDA uses native dump and/or GNU tar facilities and can back up a large number of workstations running multiple versions of Unix. Newer versions of AMANDA (including this version) can use SAMBA to back up Microsoft(TM) Windows95/NT hosts. The amanda package contains the core AMANDA programs and will need to be installed on both AMANDA clients and AMANDA servers. Note that you will have to install the amanda-client and/or amanda-server packages as well.

It is designed to provide simple, yet effective means for controlling BlueZ API and simplifying bluetooth tasks such as: - Connecting to 3G/EDGE/GPRS via dial-up - Connecting to/Creating bluetooth networks - Connecting to input devices - Connecting to audio devices - Sending/Receiving files via OBEX - Pairing

fedora-packages:bluez/bluez-hid2hci.name: bluez-hid2hci
fedora-packages:bluez/bluez-hid2hci.summary: Put HID proxying bluetooth HCI's into HCI mode
fedora-packages:bluez/bluez-hid2hci.description: Most allinone PC's and bluetooth keyboard / mouse sets which include a bluetooth dongle, ship with a so called HID proxying bluetooth HCI. The HID proxying makes the keyboard / mouse show up as regular USB HID devices (after connecting using the connect button on the device + keyboard), which makes them work without requiring any manual configuration. The bluez-hid2hci package contains the hid2hci utility and udev rules to automatically switch supported Bluetooth devices into regular HCI mode. Install this package if you want to use the bluetooth function of the HCI with other bluetooth devices like for example a mobile phone. Note that after installing this package you will first need to pair your bluetooth keyboard and mouse with the bluetooth adapter before you can use them again. Since you cannot use your bluetooth keyboard and mouse until they are paired, this will require the use of a regular (wired) USB keyboard and mouse.

The connecting is fully transparent: hosts connected to one ethernet device see hosts connected to the other ethernet devices directly. The bridge-utils package is deprecated, the bridge command from the iproute package should preferably be used for linux ethernet bridges.

fedora-packages:edac-utils/edac-utils.description: EDAC (Error Detection and Correction) is a set of Linux kernel modules that handle reporting of hardware-related errors. Currently these modules mainly handle detection of ECC memory errors for many x86 and x86-64 chipsets and PCI bus parity errors. The edac-utils project currently has three components: libedac, edac-util, and edac-ctl. The libedac library presents a standard API for reading EDAC error counts and other information from sysfs, and edac-util uses this API to generate standard reports from the commandline. The edac-ctl utility is a perl script which uses config files to load the appropriate EDAC driver for a given chipset and register motherboard DIMM labels if they are configured. An init script is also provided which uses edac-ctl to initialize EDAC at system startup. This is a metapackage that installs all three components.

Advanced users will also like using renaming masks, which let you automatically assign names (and even sub-folders within your downloads folder), fast-filtering or even custom, re-usable filters.

We will never add adware, spyware, user tracking or other nasty stuff. Therefore we rely on your donations exclusively to fund the development.
 We are looking for people willing to help translate DownThemAll! to more languages . For a small guide on how to do that, please see our preliminary translation guide . You will get our gratitude, and the gratitude of all the users whose live you improved by bringing DownThemAll! to their language.
 Please do NOT report any bugs and issues in the user review section , but file a bug report instead. This is the only way to make sure we actually see it, and it also makes communicating to us/with you a lot easier. Thanks
 Please note: Version 4 of DownThemAll! is.a complete rewrite as a WebExtension, as the old add-on system was abandoned and disabled in Firefox. This was mozilla's decision, and there is nothing we can do about it. We are therefore limited to the tools the WebExtensions model provides to us, which sadly makes it impossible to provide some of the advanced features of DownThemAll! Version 3. Furthermore there are some bugs in Firefox that affect DownThemAll! as well, e.g. downloads will always succeed even if the server returns an error, but I fixed this in upcoming Firefox 71.
However, we're still able to provide the advanced selection, queuing, file naming options of the old DownThemAll! and a lot more.

firefox-addons:3021205.name: Adaptive Tab Theme
firefox-addons:3021205.summary: Changes the color of Firefox theme to match the website’s appearance.
firefox-addons:3021205.description:
Adaptive-Tab-Theme
Changes the color of Firefox theme to match the website’s appearance.
 What Does the Add-on Do? 
This add-on dynamically adjusts the Firefox theme to match the appearance of the website you are viewing, similar to the tab bar tinting feature in Safari on macOS.
 Works Well With 
 Dark Reader 
 Stylus 
 Dark Mode Website Switcher 
 Incompatible With 
 Adaptive Theme Creator 
 Chameleon Dynamic Theme 
 VivaldiFox 
 Envify 
 Any other add-on that modifies the Firefox theme
 Removing the Shadow at the Bottom of the Toolbar 
To remove the thin shadow cast by web content onto the browser toolbar, navigate to Settings ( about:preferences ) and disable “Show sidebar” in the “Browser Layout” section. Alternatively, add the following code to your CSS theme:
 #tabbrowser-tabbox, .browserContainer { box-shadow: none !important; } 
 Customising color Transitions 
Due to technical limitations, smooth color transitions for the tab bar are not natively supported. However, you can enable this effect by adding the following code to your CSS theme:
 #navigator-toolbox, #TabsToolbar, #nav-bar, #PersonalToolbar, #sidebar-box, .tab-background, .urlbar-background, findbar { transition: background-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1), border-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1) !important; } 
To enable smooth color transitions in the Sidebery UI, add the following code to the Sidebery Style Editor:
 .Sidebar, .bottom-space { transition: background-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1) !important; } 
Alternatively, if you wish to remove Firefox’s built-in color transition on the toolbar for an instant color change, add the following code to your CSS theme:
 :root { --ext-theme-background-transition: none !important; } 
 Compatibility with Third-Party CSS Themes 
A third-party CSS theme works with Adaptive Tab Theme, as long as they use Firefox’s standard color variables (e.g. --lwt-accent-color for the tab bar color).
 Title Bar Buttons on Linux with GTK Theme 
Firefox’s titlebar buttons may revert to the Windows style. To prevent this, open “Advanced Preferences” ( about:config ) and set widget.gtk.non-native-titlebar-buttons.enabled to false .
 Safety Reminder 
Beware of malicious web UIs. It is important to distinguish between the browser UI and the web UI. For further information, please refer to The Line of Death .

firefox-addons:3030879.summary: Control each website's appearance with Follow System, Preserve Site Design, Force Dark, and Force Light modes.
firefox-addons:3030879.description:
Dark Light is a lightweight browser extension where you decide how each website looks. Unlike typical dark-mode extensions, Dark Light also has a reliable Force Light mode to turn dark sites back to light. Use one global default, then override individual domains whenever you want.
 Follow your real preference: Choose Follow System, Preserve Site Design, Force Dark, or Force Light as the default behavior.
 Different from typical dark-mode plugins: It supports both directions - Force Dark for bright pages and Force Light for dark pages.
 Per-site rules: Set a different mode for any domain, with optional subdomain matching.
 Better dark mode: Turn light-heavy websites into comfortable dark reading spaces.
 Reliable light mode: Turn dark websites back to light when you want daytime readability.
 Local and private: Settings and style changes stay in your browser.
 Global default mode: Follow System, Preserve Site Design, Force Dark, or Force Light.
 Current-site popup controls: Change the current domain in seconds.
 Rules manager: Add, edit, disable, and remove all site rules from the options page.
 Visual badge: The toolbar badge shows mode at a glance: A (Follow System), 🌙 (Force Dark), ☀ (Force Light), empty for Preserve Site.

bluejetty:00000001:android:1.name: Ping
bluejetty:00000001:android:1.summary: Ping is a personal relationship management app that helps you stay consistently connected with friends, family, and professional contacts using customized outreach cadences and milestone tracking.
bluejetty:00000001:android:1.description:
Ping helps you stay connected with the people who matter most.
In a busy world, it’s easy to lose touch — even with your closest friends, family, mentors, and professional relationships. Ping gives you a simple, thoughtful system for keeping important connections warm without stress, spreadsheets, or forgotten reminders.
Whether you want to strengthen personal relationships, maintain your professional network, or simply be more intentional with the people in your life, Ping makes it easy.
WHY PING?
Life gets busy. Relationships shouldn’t slip through the cracks. Ping helps you stay meaningfully connected by giving you clarity, structure, and gentle reminders — all in one clean, modern app designed for real humans.
KEY FEATURES
• Add Your Most Important Contacts
Create a focused list of the people you want to stay connected with — friends, family, mentors, clients, coworkers, and more. Each contact includes space for notes, relationship context, important dates, and personal details you never want to forget.
• Smart Cadences and Check-In Scheduling
Set how often you’d like to reach out, and Ping will calculate when your next touchpoint should be. The app organizes contacts into Overdue, Due Today, and Upcoming so you always know exactly who needs attention.
• Log Interactions Effortlessly
Record calls, texts, emails, meetings, and other meaningful moments. Ping updates timelines and next outreach dates automatically, helping you see your relationship progress at a glance.
• A Clean, Modern Dashboard
Your home screen summarizes everything:
How many contacts are up to date
Who needs attention
Your upcoming outreach schedule
Quick actions for calling, texting, or emailing
It removes overwhelm and makes staying connected feel natural.
• Build a Habit of Meaningful Connection
Ping isn’t a social network. It doesn’t track your messages or require your private data. Instead, it empowers you to build real relationships — intentionally, privately, and consistently.
WHO IS PING FOR?
Ping is perfect for:
• People who want to strengthen friendships or family connections
• Partners trying to be more thoughtful in their daily communication
• Founders, creators, and professionals managing personal networks
• Anyone who struggles to remember outreach timing or track relationship history
• Those who value meaningful human connection in a digital world
If you’ve ever said “We should talk more often,” Ping is for you.
DESIGNED WITH PURPOSE
Ping is intentionally simple. No complex CRM features. No clutter. No distractions. Just the tools you need to nurture relationships with clarity, consistency, and care.
Your relationships deserve attention — and Ping helps you give it.
PRIVACY FIRST
Your relationship data belongs to you. Ping does not share or sell your information. Ever.
START NURTURING YOUR RELATIONSHIPS TODAY
Download Ping to build a more connected, intentional life — one thoughtful touchpoint at a time.

Create your personalized dictionary today with Kalimaty and start mastering the words that actually matter to you!

bluejetty:00096706:ios.summary:
Turn any idea or photo into a video with 360+ AI models in one app. Pick the model that fits the shot, or run one idea on several models side by side and keep the best. You see the credit cost before you create.
IMAGE TO VIDEO AND TEXT TO
bluejetty:00096706:ios.description:
Turn any idea or photo into a video with 360+ AI models in one app. Pick the model that fits the shot, or run one idea on several models side by side and keep the best. You see the credit cost before you create.
IMAGE TO VIDEO AND TEXT TO VIDEO
• Animate any photo, or describe a scene and watch it become a video.
• Guide the shot with start and end frames, camera moves and reference images.
• Draw arrows on a photo to show where things should move.
• Extend a video, edit it with supported models, and upscale it to 4K.
• Not sure which model to pick? Let Auto choose one for your idea and your credits.
LIP SYNC, TALKING PHOTOS AND AVATARS
• Make a portrait talk with a voice you choose.
• Sync the lips in a video to a new voice track.
STORYBOARDS AND LONGER STORIES
• Turn one idea into a storyboard of up to 8 scenes with a shared look.
• Open any scene in a video or image tool when you are ready.
• Train a character from your own photos for supported image models.
IMAGES, ANIME AND ART
• Create art, anime, portraits and illustrations from text.
• Edit a photo with words, or draw on it to show what to add or take away.
• Retouch an area, expand an image, remove backgrounds and upscale.
• Turn a description or a picture into a vector logo, icon or illustration, saved as SVG.
• Turn a description or a single picture into a 3D model, then view it in your room.
MUSIC, SONGS AND SOUND
• Create music and songs from a description or your own lyrics.
• Add voiceovers and sound effects, or save your own voice once in My voices and use it for any script.
• Describe a scene and get its voices, sounds and music in one track.
200+ VIDEO EFFECTS
• One-tap video effects across 12 categories, from dance to cinematic scenes.
• Put yourself, a place or a product into a photo effect.
VIDEO TOOLS
• Add subtitles, or cut a long video into short captioned clips.
• Cut out the subject, relight or recolor a shot, and convert it to HDR.
• Check whether a clip will hook viewers before you post it.
ADS, POSTERS AND MOTION DESIGN
• Turn a product photo, a person and a look into a ready-to-post ad or poster.
• Paste an App Store link or a product page and get a 15-second promo video.
• Pick a finished ad and make it again with your own product.
• Design animated titles and text videos layer by layer.
COMMUNITY
• Share your best work, follow creators and see what is trending.
• Earn badges for what you make and pin your favorites to your profile.
NO PRICE SURPRISES
See the credit cost before every generation. If a generation fails for a technical reason, you get the credits back automatically. Every plan includes the same 360+ models; credit costs depend on the model and settings.
Choose Basic with 50 credits a month, Pro with 150 or Max with 300. Every paid month adds bonus credits on top. Pay monthly, or pay once a year for less: a yearly plan still adds its credits every month. Need more for one project? Add a one-time credit pack, no subscription needed. Bigger packs include bonus credits.
Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each month or year, and are charged to your Apple Account. To stop the next charge, turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.
ON IPHONE, IPAD, MAC AND THE WEB
Your library and credit balance follow your King AI account everywhere, and the app speaks 31 languages. Share results without an added King AI watermark, organize them into collections and remix community creations.
Support: https://kingaivideo.app/support

Privacy Policy: https://kingaivideo.app/privacy

bluejetty:00168491:ios.description:
Find Your Calm with PAUSE: Sound Baths & Meditations by Sara Auster
Looking to sleep better, reduce stress, and feel more balanced throughout your day? With PAUSE, you’re just a breath away from calm.
Created by world-renowned sound therapist, meditation teacher, and author Sara Auster, PAUSE offers an immersive library of guided sound baths, meditations, breathwork, and daily rituals—all designed to support your emotional, physical, and spiritual well-being.
Whether you need a quick two-minute reset, a soothing 20-minute meditation, or a restorative hour of sound to help you sleep, PAUSE meets you where you are. Simply press play and listen.
What’s Inside:
Sound Baths for Every Moment
Let Sara’s expert guidance and carefully curated sound experiences help you unwind, focus, reset, or drift into restful sleep.
New Sessions Weekly
Access an ever-growing library of meditations and sound baths with new practices and seasonal programs added regularly.
Tools for Daily Support
Use the in-app progress tracker to build healthy habits, explore daily mantras and affirmations, and download your favorite tracks for offline listening.
Custom Playlists
Create personalized collections to match your mood, schedule, or intention—whether at home, on a walk, or during travel.
Sleep Support
Gently transition into rest with calming, dreamy soundscapes designed to help you fall asleep faster and sleep more deeply.
What Is a Sound Bath?
A sound bath is a deeply immersive listening experience that uses therapeutic sound and mindfulness to calm the nervous system and restore balance. Sara’s sessions feature overtone-rich instruments—like tuning forks, gongs, shruti box, Himalayan and crystal singing bowls, chimes, and voice—to help you shift into a relaxed, meditative, or dreamlike state.
Why PAUSE?
This app is for anyone—whether you’re just beginning your mindfulness journey or looking to deepen your practice. The techniques are simple, science-backed, and accessible. PAUSE helps you build a more mindful, present, and peaceful life—one listen at a time.
Start your sound healing journey today.
Download PAUSE: Sound Bath + Sleep and bring moments of calm into every part of your day.

bluejetty:00018560:ios.description:
A B.blend é a primeira máquina de bebidas all-in-one do mundo, criada para transformar a sua casa em um verdadeiro bar com tecnologia, praticidade e design premium. 
Com ela, você pode filtrar a água, preparar água com gás geladinha, aquecer água para chás e ainda contar com uma seleção exclusiva de bebidas: refrigerantes, sodas italianas, sucos, chás e muito mais. Tudo isso, direto da cápsula para o seu copo, em apenas alguns segundos.
B.blend: variedade, inovação e praticidade
Já imaginou ter em casa uma máquina que atende a todos os seus desejos por bebidas, a qualquer hora do dia? Com a B.blend, isso é possível. São muitos sabores para você viver momentos únicos, seja sozinho, com a família ou com amigos. A B.blend transforma a sua cozinha em um espaço de convivência, inovação e sabor, com a praticidade que só uma máquina all-in-one pode oferecer.
Escolha a sua cápsula favorita, pressione um botão e, em poucos segundos, desfrute de uma bebida perfeita para cada ocasião. Uma água com gás refrescante após o treino, um chá quentinho em um dia frio, um energizante pela manhã ou uma soda italiana para surpreender convidados. Tudo isso com um toque de tecnologia e um design elegante que valoriza qualquer ambiente da sua casa.
Tudo na palma da mão com o app B.blend
O aplicativo B.blend eleva a sua experiência a outro nível, tornando o dia a dia ainda mais prático e conectado:
 - Compre cápsulas de todos os sabores disponíveis em poucos cliques
 - Adquira filtros e cilindros de CO₂ rapidamente, sempre que precisar
 - Acompanhe seus pedidos em tempo real até a entrega na sua casa
 - Receba notificações, promoções e dicas exclusivas direto no app
Com uma interface moderna e intuitiva, o app facilita cada etapa.
Por que escolher a B.blend?
- A única máquina all-in-one com refrigerantes, sucos, sodas italianas, chás e água com gás
- Água filtrada e com gás, fresquinha e deliciosa todos os dias
- Solução prática e moderna para simplificar a sua rotina
- Design premium que transforma o ambiente da sua casa
- Uma grande variedade de sabores para todos os momentos e preferências
Mais sabor com menos impacto
Com o sistema de cápsulas e refis da B.blend, você evita o uso excessivo de garrafas plásticas e adota um consumo mais consciente. Mais sabor, menos desperdício.
Tecnologia, inovação e conveniência
A B.blend une praticidade, tecnologia e estilo em uma só solução. Com ela, tudo é simples: escolha a cápsula, pressione um botão e aproveite a bebida ideal para cada momento. Seja para uma rotina mais prática ou para impressionar os convidados, a B.blend está sempre pronta para surpreender.
B.blend: uma experiência completa na sua casa
Mais do que uma máquina de bebidas, a B.blend é uma nova forma de viver o dia a dia. Com o app B.blend, você tem o controle de tudo na palma da mão, tornando sua experiência ainda mais completa, intuitiva e prazerosa.
Baixe o app B.blend agora e descubra como é fácil ter bebidas incríveis sempre à disposição. Transforme sua rotina e leve a inovação para dentro da sua casa.

Buffalo Bills, every kickoff, in your pocket. MafiaKickoff is rebuilt from
the ground up for the 2026 season — live countdowns, full live game

WHAT'S IN THE APP
Countdown to Kicko
bluejetty:00093710:ios.description:
Buffalo Bills, every kickoff, in your pocket. MafiaKickoff is rebuilt from
the ground up for the 2026 season — live countdowns, full live game
tracking, AFC East standings, the Bills Mafia sound board.
WHAT'S IN THE APP
Countdown to Kickoff
Every Bills game on the schedule with a live countdown to the second,
broadcast network, and game-day glow. Past games show the final score
and a clear W/L marker so you can scan the whole season at a glance.
Live Game Tracking
Tap any game for the full picture — scoring summary play-by-play, the
quarter-by-quarter score, QB matchup, top performers in pass / rush /
rec / defense, team stats, odds, injuries, venue, and broadcast info.
Updates live during the game.
AFC East Standings
Bills' division on top, your row highlighted, with W-L-T, points for /
against, point differential, and current streak. The rest of the AFC
and NFC are right below.
Bills Mafia Sound Board
Train horn, Shout, classic chants — all served fresh from the cloud so
new sounds reach you without waiting for an app update.
WGR 550 Live Radio
Tap once during any Bills game and the flagship Audacy broadcast plays
right in the app. Pauses cleanly when you need it, comes right back.
Smart Reminders
Pick exactly when you want pinged before kickoff — 2 hours, 1 hour,
30 minutes, 15 minutes, any combination. Reminders survive device
reboots and refresh in the background every 12 hours, so a flex
schedule change never catches you off guard.
DESIGNED FOR BILLS MAFIA
Painted head-to-toe in Bills royal navy with red used sparingly as a
small accent — no glaring surfaces, no eye-tiring text colors. Calm
enough to scan all season, loud enough to feel like a Bills app.
Light and dark mode both fully supported.
OFFLINE-FRIENDLY
The full schedule caches locally so you can browse upcoming and past
games without a connection. Live data flows back in the moment you're
online again.
GO BILLS
Built by Bills fans, for Bills fans. Got an idea, a bug, or a sound
you want on the board? There's a feedback form right in Settings —
we read everything.
GoBills!

bluejetty:00098132:ios.description:
The Ultimate Peptide Tracker & Calculator for All Your Protocols
Take control of your peptide journey! Whether you're deep into peptide research, optimizing for fitness with performance peptides, aiding recovery with compounds like BPC-157 or TB-500, exploring biohacking protocols, or managing GLP-1 agonists like Semaglutide and Tirzepatide, Peptide Tracker & Calculator is your essential management tool. Stop relying on messy notes or complex spreadsheets – track everything accurately in one secure, easy-to-use app.
Comprehensive Peptide Inventory Management:
Log Any Peptide: Maintain a detailed database of all your compounds – from research peptides and GHRP/GHRH analogs (like CJC-1295 or Ipamorelin) to healing peptides and GLP-1s.
Track Critical Vial Data: Record concentration (mg/mcg), units, vial size (ml), diluent (e.g., BAC water), date, storage conditions (fridge/freezer), source, batch number, and expiration dates. Essential for consistency and safety across all peptide protocols.
Smart Low Stock Alerts: Visual indicators warn you when any peptide vial is running low, helping you reorder before interrupting your research, peptide cycle, or therapy.
Precise Dose Logging:
Accurate Dose Recording: Log every administration with meticulous detail: specific peptide used, dose amount (mg/mcg/IU), date/time, method/site (subcutaneous, intramuscular), and personal notes for context (e.g., "pre-workout," "post-injury").
Complete Dose History: Review your entire usage history for any tracked peptide. Filter logs by compound (e.g., view all BPC-157 doses) to analyze patterns, effectiveness, and adherence. Perfect for managing complex peptide stacks or cycles.
Intelligent Injection Site Rotation:
Smart Site Tracking: Maintain a personalized map of injection sites with customizable rest periods for optimal absorption and tissue recovery.
Rotation Recommendations: Receive intelligent suggestions for your next injection site based on usage history and proper rotation patterns.
Site Status Monitoring: Color-coded indicators show which sites are ready for use, need rest, or are inactive, helping prevent site overuse and associated complications.
Find Information Instantly:
Quick Search: Locate specific peptides, inventory details, or past dose logs in seconds.
Privacy You Can Trust:
Your peptide usage and research data are confidential. All information entered into Peptide Tracker & Calculator is stored securely and locally on your device only. We never access, collect, or store your personal data.
Master Your Peptide Regimen:
Peptide Tracker & Calculator is the indispensable tool for researchers, athletes, biohackers, and anyone utilizing peptides for performance, recovery, longevity, or wellness. Download today and bring precision and organization to your peptide management!

bluejetty:00178759:ios.description:
WingMate is an unofficial companion app for the award winning board game Wingspan, designed by Elizabeth Hargrave and published by Stonemaier Games.
The app lets you:
* assign a name and action cube color for each player, and order the players based on seating position
* select an Automa player as one of the five players as well as difficulty
* pick or randomly draw the end-of-round goal tiles
* randomly draw the starting player and show the first player for each round
* display Automa moves based on the Automa cards included in the game. Automatically tracks face-down birds, eggs and end-of-round cubes
* score each player's total for the end-of-round goals, and then display the action cubes on the goal board
* total each player's points per category (birds, bonus cards, end-of-round goals, eggs, food on cards and tucked cards)
* automatically sum the values of each bird you score by tapping the point value of each bird
* show and share a summary of the game results
The free version of WingMate lets you score a single player. To fully score a game, you need to purchase the Scoring Unlock via an in-app purchase on the WingMate Store. To play a full solo game, you need to additionally purchase the Automa Unlock. A 7-Day Free Trial is available.
WingMate requires iOS 18.0 or later.
WingMate is not an official Stonemaier Games product, and is created with permission of Stonemaier Games. Special thanks to Elizabeth Hargrave, Jamey Stegmaier and Natalia Rojas, Ana Maria Martinez Jaramillo, and Beth Sobel for creating Wingspan, and David Studley and the Automa Factory for creating the Automa. Cardenio Modern by Nils Cordes, Bebas Neue by Font Fabric and Kronos by Lyft are used under their respective licenses. German translation proofreading by Nadine Bomhard. French translation proofreading by Thierry Bordet.

bluejetty:00092467:ios.description:
Welcome to Open Relationship. What began as a passion project now offers open-minded couples and singles a place to connect and meet. We're a free dating and mingling experience built for people looking for more profound, engaging experiences. We're home to millions of couples and singles just like yourself, and we're happy you discovered us.
Become a part of one of the largest non-traditional meet-up apps online. Discover people from all over the United States who share your interest in unconventional dating fun. We're not the usual dating app, we're free of cultural restraints, and we're growing exponentially.
Our dating app supports open relationships of ALL types, and we mean ALL. Open Relationship welcomes all genders and identities. Our alternative dating app connects you with a robust community of open-minded people who don't care about conventional dating ways. The Open Relationship community welcomes you and embraces who you are. 
-What Open Relationship Offers
● Use of high-quality, secure messaging means getting to know members before meeting in person.
● Connect using a sophisticated location finder and advanced search features that discovers members in your area.
● Experience fast and responsive feedback, no lag!
● Discover couples and singles who have the same lifestyle experience as you. Or find those with more or less. That's up to you!
● Explore couples, find a partner who wants to explore with you, or go it as a single. Our Open Relationship dating platform encourages all types of ambitions. 
● View or send private photos through our secure messaging.
● Enjoy our lifestyle educational articles, meet up with members at exotic locations by making new connections, and evolve your open relationship ambitions.
Our Open Relationship mobile app resides on cutting-edge technology that's more than easy to use; it's downright blazing fast. The superior responsiveness of our app means less time waiting for profile images to load and more time connecting and chatting. In addition, our soon-to-be launched, unparalleled video caliber enables non-monogamous singles and couples' intimate interactions. 
-How To Use Open Relationship
It's a simple process.
You'll download our app - less than 1 minute.
You'll tell us a little about how exciting you are! - Around 3 minutes.
You'll choose a fun pic of yourself! - Maybe 2 minutes?
You'll begin searching your area for members - a lifetime's worth of excitement!
There's nothing to overthink here. Getting started with Open Relationship is simple and easy. 
-Rapidly Find Members Near You
Sometimes it probably feels as though you're alone out there. But the truth is, there's a whole lot of people that can't wait to meet you. Only they haven't found you. This is why our app's cosmopolitan and sophisticated search features matter. 
Cutting-edge search more than enhances a dating app experience, it fuels it. Our innovative, ultra-modern open relationship search, delivers updated, GPS-based results from wherever you are. 
Some members can't wait to mingle with you and yours, whether you are away on business or taking a vacation with your partner. When you use the Open Relationship app, the alternative dating lifestyle experience is only a few finger swipes away. 
Open Relationship has been around for over a decade and during that time, we've established ourselves as a premier online destination for couples and likeminded singles. We don't mean to brag, or maybe we do! After using our Open Relationship app, we're confident you'll understand exactly what we mean. 
We're excited you found us, and we know that of our millions of users, there are a lot of others who are going to be over the moon you're here. 
Join us today and start mingling with members in your area, no matter where that may be.

bluejetty:00042652:ios.description:
Turn your voice notes and recordings into text with Note AI. Use AI-powered transcription, translation, and summaries to help organize information for work, study, and everyday note-taking.
Record audio or upload supported audio and video files. Create transcripts, review key points, and revisit information from your recordings in one place.
AUDIO TO TEXT
Transcribe voice memos, meeting recordings, lectures, and interviews. Convert recorded speech into text to help you review discussions and organize your notes.
VIDEO TRANSCRIPTION
Generate transcripts from speech in supported video files. Use the text to revisit recorded content and identify points you want to review.
AUDIO TRANSLATION
Translate recorded speech into English or other supported languages. Use translations to help you work with multilingual recordings and study materials.
AI-POWERED SUMMARIES
Create summaries and key takeaways from your recordings. Use them as a starting point when reviewing a discussion, lecture, or spoken idea.
VOICE NOTES
Record ideas, reminders, and thoughts as audio, then use transcription to turn them into text for later reference.
STUDY TOOLS
Create flashcards and summaries from recorded material to support your study routine. Revisit topics and organize information from your lectures and notes.
FOR WORK, STUDY, AND EVERYDAY IDEAS
Use Note AI to review meeting recordings, revisit course material, or capture ideas as they come to mind. Bring transcription, translation, and summaries into your note-taking routine.
Transcription and translation results may vary depending on audio quality, language, and recording conditions. AI-generated content may contain errors; review important details against the original recording.

bluejetty:00070710:ios.summary:
رفيقك اليومي للعبادة… بدقة، سهولة، وأناقة عالية!
من اللحظة الأولى التي تفتح فيها التطبيق، ستجد أوقات الصلاة مضبوطة 100٪ على توقيت المسجد الذي تصلي فيه، بدون أي إعدادات معقدة ولا حاجة للتخصيص، وكل هذا خالي تمامًا من الإعلانات!
• مواقيت دقيق
bluejetty:00070710:ios.description:
رفيقك اليومي للعبادة… بدقة، سهولة، وأناقة عالية!
من اللحظة الأولى التي تفتح فيها التطبيق، ستجد أوقات الصلاة مضبوطة 100٪ على توقيت المسجد الذي تصلي فيه، بدون أي إعدادات معقدة ولا حاجة للتخصيص، وكل هذا خالي تمامًا من الإعلانات!
• مواقيت دقيقة 
تحديد تلقائي لمدينتك مع أوقات صلاة مطابقة تمامًا للمساجد في السعودية، لتعيش أجواء الطمأنينة وأنت على يقين أن مواعيدك مع الله مضبوطة بالدقيقة.
• القبلة حيثما كنت
تحديد دقيق لاتجاه القبلة مع خريطة تفاعلية تسهّل عليك العثور على الاتجاه الصحيح في أي مكان في العالم.
• زاد يومي من الأذكار
كل أذكار المسلم بين يديك: أذكار الصباح والمساء وقبل النوم وبعده وغيرها الكثير، مع تلاوات صوتية رائعة وأدعية مأثورة من القرآن والسنة.
• القرآن الكريم معك دائمًا
تصفح القرآن كاملًا، استمع لتلاوات قراءك المفضلين في الخلفية، وابدأ ختمتك بخطة واضحة مع تذكيرات يومية بوِردك.
• تنبيهات ذكية قبل الصلاة
لا يفوتك وقت الصلاة مع تنبيهات مسبقة للأذان والإقامة بأصوات مميزة واختيارات متعددة. بل وأكثر: تنبيهات للثلث الأخير، الضحى، الصيام، وساعة الجمعة!
• أذان كامل حتى والشاشة مقفلة
استمع لصوت الأذان الكامل عند كل صلاة، أينما كنت وفي أي وقت.
• الويدجت
ويدجت متنوعة تعرض لك أوقات الصلاة، العد التنازلي للصلاة القادمة، الأدعية، التاريخ الهجري، وأكثر. على الشاشة الرئيسية وشاشة القفل!
• تصميم عصري وأنيق
استوحينا التصميم من تطبيقات آبل: تجربة استخدام سلسة، تفاصيل مدروسة، سرعة في الأداء، وأناقة في كل زاوية.
• مناسبات إسلامية 
اطّلع على أهم المناسبات الإسلامية لكل عام مع مواعيد دقيقة وعدّ تنازلي للأحداث القادمة.
• تكامل كامل مع ساعة آبل
اعرض مواقيت الصلاة والأذكار على معصمك بسهولة، مع وجوه ساعة أنيقة تناسب جميع الأذواق.
• ورد المحاسبة اليومي
تابع عباداتك اليومية وحفّز نفسك على الانتظام في الطاعات عبر واجهة جميلة وويدجت مخصص.
• من أعمال اليوم والليلة
السنن الرواتب، صلاة الضحى, قيام الليل, وقت النهي، سورة الكهف، وغيرها، تظهر لك حسب الوقت المناسب.
• المساجد والإقامة القريبة
اعثر على المساجد المجاورة لك بضغطة. زر وحدد وقت الإقامة لكل صلاة بدقة.
• دعم فني
قسم المساعدة والإجابات المتكررة دائمًا معك، مع إمكانية التواصل مع فريق الدعم عبر البريد أو الواتساب مباشرة.
• مشاركة الخير بسهولة
شارك الأذكار والأدعية وأوقات الصلاة في بطاقات أنيقة وخلفيات جميلة عبر وسائل التواصل المختلفة.
• والمزيد من الميزات الرائعة:
- عرض التاريخ الهجري
- التحويل من ميلادي إلى هجري
- كل يوم آية وتفسيرها
- إضافة تنبيهات يمكن تخصيصها بشكل كامل
- أحاديث صحيحة تتغير كل يوم
- أدعية منوعة في الواجهة الرئيسية
- بطاقة التقويم الهجري اليومية مع أهم المعلومات
- وقت منتصف الليل والثلث الأخير
- حالة القمر الحالية
- حساب زكاة المال والزروع والأنعام
- فوائد يومية متجددة
- حساب ساعات الجمعة
- التقويم الشهري لأوقات الصلاة
- الخصوصية التامة
- دعم الوضع الليلي وتغيير الأيقونة
- خلفيات متنوعة تتغير حسب وقت الصلاة
- تحديثات مستمرة لتقديم أفضل تجربة لك

bluejetty:00122387:ios.description:
Für alles Wichtige auf und abseits des Fußballplatzes. 11FREUNDE ist seit 2000 das deutsche Magazin für Fußballkultur, das mit Leidenschaft, Humor und Selbstironie auf die Welt des Fußballs blickt. Ob Reportagen, Interviews, Podcasts, dem Liveticker und vieles mehr: alles in der 11FREUNDE-App.
Alle aktuellen Nachrichten und Hintergründe aus der Welt des Fußballs – mit allem Wichtigen aus Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga und 3. Liga – sowie das digitale 11FREUNDE Magazin übersichtlich in einer App.
• 11FREUNDE-Startseite: alle wichtigen Nachrichten, lesenswerte Reportagen, den preisgekrönten Liveticker und weitere Hintergründe auf einen Blick – inklusive News, Ergebnissen und Livetickern aus Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga und 3. Liga.
• Eine zentrale Navigation: Einfach einsteigen, ob in die aktuellen Schlagzeilen, den preisgekrönten Liveticker, das Audio-Angebot – oder in die digitale Ausgabe und alle anderen digitalen 11FREUNDE Magazine in einer kompakten Übersicht.
• Einstellbare Push-Benachrichtigungen: Ob Eilmeldungen, Leseempfehlungen der 11FREUNDE-Redaktion, aktuelle Fußball-Liveticker zur Champions League sowie zu Bundesliga und DFB-Pokal oder das neue 11FREUNDE Magazin – einfach auswählen, welche Push-Benachrichtigungen du erhalten möchtest.
• Aktuelles: alle Nachrichten des Tages in chronologischer Reihenfolge – damit du bei Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga, 3. Liga und Champions League nichts verpasst.
• Audio: Entdecke unsere Podcasts und lass dir darüber hinaus Artikel mit der Text-to-Speech-Funktion vorlesen – ideal für unterwegs und für alle, die noch tiefer in die Geschichten, Analysen und Hintergründe eintauchen wollen.
Willkommen im Club. Sichere Dir jetzt die Eintrittskarte für das 11FREUNDE Digital-Abo:
• 11FREUNDE Club: unbegrenzter Zugang zu allen 11FREUNDE-Inhalten auf allen Endgeräten für € 7,49 pro Monat.
• Werbefrei lesen: die App weitestgehend werbefrei und ganz ohne Werbetracking für monatlich € 4,99 pro Monat lesen.
Feedback, Ideen, Wünsche? Bitte kontaktiere uns unter app-feedback@11freunde.de. Unser Anspruch ist, unsere Produkte und Inhalte ständig zu verbessern. 11FREUNDE Club und die Werbefrei-lesen-Option werden über deinen iTunes-Account abgewickelt und mit Kaufbestätigung bezahlt. 24 Stunden vor Ablauf verlängert sich das Abo automatisch um einen Monat. In den Einstellungen deines iTunes-Accounts kannst du jedes dieser Abos jederzeit kündigen. Um den 11FREUNDE Club oder die Werbefrei-lesen-Option außerhalb dieser App zu nutzen, musst du das jeweilige Abo direkt nach dem Kauf mit einem 11FREUNDE-ID-Konto verknüpfen. Mit dem Kauf akzeptierst du unsere Allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen (https://www.11freunde.de/impressum ) und unsere Datenschutzerklärung (https://www.11freunde.de/datenschutz ).

bluejetty:00180194:ios.description:
Save videos on Wi-Fi and enjoy them offline — anytime, anywhere.
Clicha is the trusted video saver with 1M+ downloads, 45,000+ reviews and 4.4 stars.
Background play, PiP, sleep timer, speed control, and more — all in one app.
◆ Save Once, Watch Anytime ◆
Download videos while on Wi-Fi at home, at a café, or at the office. Once saved, watch offline on the train, on a flight, or wherever you go — no internet needed.
◆ Features ◆
• Save videos and watch offline without internet
• Play video and audio in the background
• Auto-Play with controls from Control Center or Lock Screen
• Organize with folders and playlists
• Sort and reorder with drag-and-drop
• Repeat, shuffle, speed control (0.5x–2.0x)
• Import from Photos, iCloud Drive, Files, or other apps
• Record from the built-in camera
• Protect videos with passcode lock
• Sleep timer — playback stops automatically
• PiP — watch in a floating window while multitasking
• Background playback on iPad when PiP is off
• Play from Apple Watch
• Home screen widgets for quick access
• Stream to TV with AirPlay
• Back up to iCloud Drive
◆ Background Play ◆
Keep listening after you lock your screen or switch apps. Control playback from Lock Screen or Control Center — skip, pause, adjust volume. Perfect for lectures, podcasts, or music videos.
◆ Picture-in-Picture (PiP) ◆
Shrink the video into a floating window and keep watching while you browse, message, or take notes. Resize or reposition freely. Great for tutorials and cooking videos.
◆ Sleep Timer ◆
Set a timer and let playback stop on its own. Great for falling asleep to ASMR, ambient sounds, or music without draining your battery.
◆ Speed Control ◆
Watch at 0.5x for detailed tutorials or 2.0x to get through lectures faster. Match playback speed to your pace.
◆ Folders & Playlists ◆
Create folders by topic — recipes, workouts, study material, entertainment. Build playlists for continuous playback. Reorder with drag-and-drop.
◆ Recommended for ◆
• Commuters — save on Wi-Fi, watch offline on the train or bus
• Students — download lectures for review anytime
• Travelers — load videos before a flight, watch without Wi-Fi
• Fitness fans — follow workout videos without buffering
• Parents — keep videos ready for car rides and waiting rooms
• Music lovers — listen to music videos in the background
• Night owls — drift off with the sleep timer
• Anyone who wants to save mobile data
◆ FAQ ◆
Q: Is Clicha free?
A: Yes. Save and watch for free. Premium unlocks unlimited saves, no ads, PiP, and audio conversion.
Q: How do I save a video?
A: Open the built-in browser, find the video, and tap save.
Q: Can I play in the background?
A: Yes. Lock your screen or switch apps — audio keeps playing.
Q: What is PiP?
A: A floating window that lets you watch while using other apps. Available with Premium.
Q: Can I organize videos?
A: Yes. Create folders, build playlists, reorder with drag-and-drop.
Q: Does it work on Apple Watch?
A: Yes. Browse and play saved videos from your wrist.
Q: Is my data safe?
A: Videos are stored locally. Back up to iCloud Drive. Passcode lock keeps your library private.
◆ How to Organize Videos ◆
1. Tap "Edit" on the Library screen
2. Select one or more videos
3. Tap "Move to Folder"
4. Create or choose a folder
5. Confirm and finish
6. Open the Folder tab to browse
7. Tap a video to start playback
◆ Premium Subscription ◆
• Unlimited video saving
• No ads
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP)
• Audio conversion
• New features added regularly
Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation.
Subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
Manage your subscription in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
We appreciate your feedback and reviews.

bluejetty:00070637:ios.name: iNote - Sticky Note by Color
bluejetty:00070637:ios.summary:
iNote Free is a simple and quick sticky notepad app. This helps you organize your notes, memos, messages, emails, shopping lists, check lists and to-do lists by COLOR. Taking color notes with iNote is never easier than before.
MANAGE NOTE
bluejetty:00070637:ios.description:
iNote Free is a simple and quick sticky notepad app. This helps you organize your notes, memos, messages, emails, shopping lists, check lists and to-do lists by COLOR. Taking color notes with iNote is never easier than before.
MANAGE NOTE BY COLOR
Each note has a main color so you can group these notes by a color-category in a professional way like: memos, to-do lists, shopping lists, emails, travels, and ideas...
ADD IMAGES TO NOTE
Notes now can attach photos. All photos are sync with iCloud too.
DISPLAY NOTE WITH MANY OPTIONS
You can view your notes in grid (like sticky note), quick list, or detail list. This app helps you sort notes by color, remind time, updated time, created time, or title name. So you can view these note quickly and super easily.
SYNC WITH ICLOUD, NEVER LOST YOUR NOTE
Your notes is sync with your iCloud account, so you can take note on iPhone and use on your iPad and vise versa. You will never lost note because your data is saved on iCloud. 
BACKUP & IMPORT EASILY
You can backup your data, send via email then import them on all of your devices when ever you want. This app supports importing notes from ColorNote app on other devices, so you will never miss your notes.
FAST CREATE TODO LIST
In the checklist mode, you can take note quickly and re-arrange to-do items easily. When clicking on each item, you can check or un-check as done by a quick tap. Checked item will be slashed like the way you check them on your notebook.
REMIND AND CALENDAR
With each note, you can add a reminder. Then the app will notify you when the even happens. You can also repeat these events daily, weekly, monthly or yearly depend on your settings.
And you can view these events in calendar mode. It will help you have a quick view of events on specific month and day.
PIN ON TODAY BOARD WIDGET
You now can pin notes on to Today Board up to 12 notes, then you can access these note every where, at any time you need from Notification Center.
KEY FEATURES:
- Organize notes by color, display with many layout options
- Attach photos to note
- Sync with iCloud, backup and import notes
- Checklist notes for To do list and Shopping list
- Remind notes and calendar 
- Pin notes on Today Board
iNote supports up to 12 languages: English, Vietnamese, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, French, Turkish, Portuguese, Russian, Italian. The list will be continue updated.

bluejetty:00135125:ios.description:
Flow Greeks is the ultimate and essential tool for any trader!
The app serves retail traders to analyze opportunities pursued by institutions with significant capital allocation. Mastering the skill of reading options flow will enable you to navigate the complexities of institutional order flow data with precision, providing valuable insights for your trading decisions.
Real Time Option Flow:
-------------------------------------
We display the options flows for all stocks and ETFs in real time as they occur. The flow can be a SWEEP or BLOCK.

bluejetty:00082149:ios.description:
A joyful sudoku-solving experience built natively for iPhone and iPad and optimized for a zen solving experience free from bloat and distraction. Designed to be easy to play and meet you where ever you are in your sudoku journey: a casual solver or a sudoku pro. Stuck on a puzzle? Shake your phone for hints and turn on move by move validation in settings to get immediate feedback on your solve. Tickle your brain as you learn new solving strategies and customize the app to your taste with themes and alternate app icons.
Play a daily puzzle at a difficulty of your choice and see where you stack up with players across the globe. Or just turn off the stopwatch and relax.
Key features:
- Fully offline: no internet required
- No ads or distractions
- Real-time move validation to get immediate feedback
- Shake for a hint on the next logical move
- Leaderboards with assist tracking
- Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels
- Light/Dark mode
- Stopwatch and best time tracking
- Notes: Keep track of candidates
- Auto-clear Notes: removes candidate numbers automatically in row, column, and box when they become outdated
- Speed demon: Lock numbers and place them in multiple tiles at once
- Arithmophobia: Sudoku with letters instead of numbers
- Daily streak tracking
- Daily reminder notifications
- Highlighter: tap a number to highlight all its instances on the board
- Themes to customize the interface (some require Pro)
- Alternate app icons (Pro)
- Charts and statistics (Pro): track solve speed over time and puzzle count by difficulty
Play the daily puzzle at your preferred difficulty for free without any limits on assists or game features. Upgrade to Pro with a one-time purchase to unlock unlimited games, detailed stats, more themes, and alternate app icons. Pro supports Family Sharing.

bluejetty:00122023:ios.description:
The shoot ‘em up you were looking for! New entry in the series will keep you entertained with all the things you’ve came to love in scrolling shooters. Meaty explosions, incinerating lasers, collosal bosses and diverse aircrafts to pilot.
“Sky Force Reloaded” is not your average scrolling shooter. It will draw you in with its beautiful environments and intense effects. It will keep you with its superb gameplay mechanics, progression system and in-game collectibles. It will leave you wishing for more, once it’s over. Fortunately, there’s a lot to do before that happens. 
* Master 15 beautiful and immersive stages with challenging missions to complete.
* Battle enormous and intimidating bosses, laugh when they explode and cry when you explode.
* Unlock new difficulty modes, all the way from Normal to Nightmare.
* Put yourself in danger to rescue missing operatives from the battlefield.
* Assemble and test 9 different aircrafts. Pick your favorite, with its unique features and play style.
* Hunt down 30 elusive bonus cards to add even more depth to the gameplay. Some of them will grant permanent benefits, while others will boost your abilities only temporarily.
* Install hundreds of upgrades to your weapons, shields and other equipment. Turn your plane into a flying tank. 
* Complete in-game objectives to unlock 8 assisting technicians. Choose one of them to help you with their special skill.
* Spot the wrecks of your fallen friends and get rewards for picking them up.
* Appreciate highly polished gameplay and well balanced difficulty curve, whether you consider yourself a casual gamer or a die-hard shmup fanatic.
* Enjoy professional voiceover and incredible electronic soundtrack.
Welcome to your new favorite shoot ‘em up. Welcome to Sky Force Reloaded!

bluejetty:00142021:ios.description:

Every tool, strategy, framework, and principle he built and tested with millions of people is custom-trained and ready to respond to what you need in the moment—the way he would if he were sitting right next to you.
That is the difference between information and someone who knows what to do with it.
• 50 years of work from the man Fortune called the “CEO Whisperer”
• Owns 120+ businesses doing over $20 billion a year
• Strategies used by founders, athletes, investors, and world leaders
• Rated 4.8 stars by the people already using it
• 23 languages, any hour, no appointment, no waiting room
Get guidance at 6 a.m. before the meeting. At 11 p.m., when the conflict you cannot work through is still on a loop. At 2 a.m., when you cannot sleep.
Whenever the question shows up, Tony Robbins AI is there for you.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
Tony Robbins AI will continue to ask you questions before it gives you answers. It wants the details of your actual situation first, so what comes back fits your life—not advice written for everybody.
• Voice to voice: talk in real time, like a phone call
• Switch between speaking and typing anytime
• It remembers, so you never have to re-explain yourself, and your history shows your progress
• Available in 23 languages
WHAT PEOPLE BRING TO IT
• A decision they have been circling for weeks
• A goal that keeps sliding to the next month
• Questions about money, career, business, relationships, health, or purpose
• The 2 a.m. spiral
• What keeps holding them back, so they can get clear on what is really stopping them
• A win they want to build on, maintain momentum around, and turn into clear next steps
WHAT YOU GET
• Clarity on what is actually in the way—which is rarely the thing you think
• One next step, small enough to take today
• Language for the hard conversation
• Momentum that is still there next week
• The pattern underneath the problem, not just the problem
WHO IT IS FOR
People who want more and will not settle.
Whether you are new to personal development or forty years into it, the depth is there either way. If you want something that simply agrees with you, this is not it. It will tell you the truth, and it is on your side while it does.
THE METHOD UNDERNEATH
This is not motivation. Motivation fades.
It is a method, and the order matters: find the real problem, break the pattern holding it in place, then build the habits that make the change stick.
Tony Robbins has spent 50 years proving it with live audiences. Now it is on your phone, ready when you are.
Everyone has challenges. You can dwell on them or break through them with the #1 peak performance coach of all time.
Open the app. Ask your most pressing question.

bluejetty:00115092:ios.summary:
