Lazy Lighting lets you warp videos, photos, live camera feeds, animated drawings, and generative VJ visuals onto walls, stages, sculptures, windows, o
bluejetty:00115092:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a touch-first projection mapping and video mapping studio.
Lazy Lighting lets you warp videos, photos, live camera feeds, animated drawings, and generative VJ visuals onto walls, stages, sculptures, windows, objects, and multi-surface installations—without a laptop.
MAP ANY SURFACE
Create squares, circles, custom text, cubes, boxes, image silhouettes, and hand-drawn outlines. Drag corners directly on screen to align each projection, bend edges around curved forms, then use masks and cutouts to control exactly where every visual appears.
Map several surfaces at once. Assign different content to individual shapes, layer visuals with independent opacity and ordering, and save projects to continue later.
CREATE LIVE VISUALS
• Explore built-in visualizers, VJ loops, generative shaders, gradients, tunnels, neon effects, and shape-aware animations
• Import videos and photos from your device
• Use a live camera feed as projection content
• Draw and animate original visuals by hand
• Crop, fit, mask, layer, and apply real-time effects including kaleidoscope, tile, slide, rotate, zoom, blur, monochrome, invert, and color cycle
• Make visuals react to audio or control parameters with MIDI
• Animate controls with BPM-synced LFO and envelope modulation
• Use hand and face tracking for expressive control
BUILD A COMPLETE SHOW
Create scenes and switch between them live, or arrange them on a timeline. Add an audio track, trim and duplicate clips, automate visual parameters, and move between looks with fade or dissolve transitions.
Export the finished projection-mapped show in 720p, 1080p, or 4K with audio. Save it to Photos or send it to a compatible receiver running Lazy Lighting Link.
EXPORT ONCE. PLAY WITHOUT YOUR PHONE.
Once the transfer is complete, Lazy Lighting Link saves and loops the show on the receiver. Close the app and free your iPhone or iPad—the projection keeps playing without your device remaining connected.
CONNECT YOUR WAY
Connect by HDMI with a compatible USB-C or Lightning adapter, use AirPlay, or connect through Lazy Lighting Link. External display output keeps the controls on your device while the visual output fills the projector.
Lazy Lighting is made for projection artists, VJs, DJs, musicians, performers, stage and event designers, galleries, installations, window displays, parties, home ambience, and Halloween, Christmas, or holiday projections.
Create the map. Build the visuals. Perform live—or export once and let Lazy Lighting Link keep it playing.
A compatible projector or display and a wired or wireless connection are required for external output. Lazy Lighting Link export requires a compatible receiver on the same network. Some features require a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://lazylighting.com/ios-terms
Privacy Policy: https://lazylighting.com/ios-privacy

bluejetty:00044108:ios.description:
In 2024, Oxford made “brain rot” the word of the year. The term means long, mindless scrolling on social media.
But are social media really that bad? They still help us work, connect, and study. 
We believe the key is balance. Taskfulness helps you keep valuable interactions while limiting the doomscrolling. 
The results: our members save 28-36% of their screen time daily, without missing out. 
Want intentional screen time? Try Taskfulness free for 7 days. 
Built on Cognitive Behaviour Therapy principles.    
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick an app  
Select the apps that steal most of your time. For example, Instagram, WhatsApp, Reddit, Gmail, etc.
2. Set intention  
Each time you open a chosen app, Taskfulness will pop up and ask: “Why do you need it?” and “For how long?”. Once you enter the reason, the app opens.
3. Stay focused*  
Use the app for the duration you set. Mid-session, you’ll get a quick reminder of your original intention. When time’s up, the app closes automatically.  
*works only with Reminders on 
WHY TASKFULNESS 
- No deleting accounts: Use social media intentionally.
- Saves time: Our users reclaim an average of 28-36% or 14 hours of screen time per week.
- Strong against procrastination: Combats reactiveness, time blindness, and distractions.
- Built with expertise: Created by founders with ADHD, based on CBT, and approved by psychologists for effectiveness and safety.
Let’s make your screen time short and focused!
Taskfulness team.

bluejetty:00024625:ios.name: Astonishing Baseball Manager
bluejetty:00024625:ios.summary: Astonishing Baseball (AB) is your daily dose of baseball management simulation on your smartphone or tablet, and for free, with no ads. Become the coach/manager of an astonishing sports team full of stars, and as the GM, lead your players t
bluejetty:00024625:ios.description:
Astonishing Baseball (AB) is your daily dose of baseball management simulation on your smartphone or tablet, and for free, with no ads. Become the coach/manager of an astonishing sports team full of stars, and as the GM, lead your players to the ultimate reward: the Baseball Cup!
Astonishing Baseball is not your usual baseball manager game. It's not only about tables full of stats and WAR projections. It's not just trading players and signing free agent stars, or upgrading your ballpark. In Astonishing Baseball, you're writing your own coach story with one goal in mind: win the Baseball Cup. And for that, you'll need to become a great GM/manager. It's like a narrative roguelike sports game!
* A living world
Astonishing Baseball features a deep lore in a fully-customizable world. Sports fans are posting about the game and your brand new rookie. Reporters write articles about your closer's performance in the 9th inning. Players send you messages about their concerns, their contract... Or maybe they're inviting you, the coach, for dinner!
* An All-star lineup at the ballpark
Astonishing Baseball allows you to create the team you've always dreamed of. Make trades with the greedy other teams of the league, or sign free agent stars during the offseason. Draft talented prospects and train them to the rank of baseball stars during the Legends Contest. You're the manager!
* For baseball fans and stats nerds
Astonishing Baseball is very easy to learn. If you know the game rules, you'll know how to play and become a manager! But if you're a sabermetrics savant, you'll find all kind of stats to satisfy your nerdy instinct, from cool charts to WAR projections!
* Play on your own terms
Astonishing Baseball simulator can be played offline, as much as you want. You don't need to wait or watch an ad to play games. You don't need a data connection or Wi-Fi to save a game result. You don't need to create an account to build your team. You don't even have to pay!
* Get international
Not enough talent in your league? Send your local scouts to find the best prospects in the world at their local ballpark, and then invite the most promising player to your team! 
A Prodigious Story
Create your own player and follow his adventures through high school and college. Will he join the Emerald University of Seattle, or travel to Japan to study baseball? Can he find love, and keep his best friend close while becoming a local superstar? Play through dozens of events and storylines until your young prodigy joins your team!
* A fierce online competition
Even if the entire solo mode can be played offline, you can also decide to play online anytime against other managers, and play games in one of our many multiplayer modes! Try to become the King of Baseball in the Astonishing Contest, or conquer the title of World Champion. Except if you want to play with friends, and go on a road trip with your guild to conquer ballparks! 
* A Tremendous Rivalry
Maybe you're going to have success with your team, but at the top of your fame, a talented coach might come to steal your throne! Will you be good enough to get him out of this league? But beware, because the Dargor family is ready to sabotage you. 
* New challenges await you
In AB, you can play one of our many scenarios! Go back in time to manage the famous 1927 superstars, or try to rebuild Detroit in extreme mode!
*My Franchise Player mode
Start your own career and upgrade your player to become the best in the world! Sign with sponsors, unlock new skills and meet new friends. This is your career!
If you like baseball, fantasy sports and baseball coach simulation games, you'll love Astonishing Baseball Manager! See you at the ballpark!

bluejetty:00065645:ios.description:
Wine should not be mysterious nor hard. Whether you are an aspiring beginner or a casual wine lover, My Wine Guide® helps you find and select wines you’ll like; wines that match your:
a) personal preferences, and taste,
b) occasion,
c) budget, and,
d) pair with your food.
No jargon, experts or scanning. Your local restaurants, favorite retailers, both local and on-line, are already in My Wine Guide. And not just a few wines; the entire wine lists and inventories at over 7,000 restaurants and retailers.
No need to wait and hope for a successful scan. The instant you select a restaurant or retailer you get your best matches. And not just more of the same wines you know you already. My Wine Guide’s Diversity Algothim introduces you to new wines, varietals and regions from around the world.
Start your wine journey with My Wine Guide today and never look back.
Learn about and understand Your Preferences
My Wine Guide does a lot more than just recommend your best matches. We help you understand why your preferences – your palate – leads you to certain wines. My Wine Guide helps you develop a growing and ever expanding interest in and appreciation for wines around the world. For each wine, My Wine Guide explains why the wine is a match of a certain percentage for you personally. My Wine Guide is the only wine app that does this.
My Wine Guide De-mystifies Wine and Food Pairing
My Wine Guide does this in two ways. First, our participating partner restaurants provide food and wine pairing suggestions for each of their menu items and wines. You can start with a wine and see the suggested food pairings. Or you can start with your choice of food and see suggested wine pairings. Second, My Wine Guide has curated hundreds of recipes and has paired them with wines from every wine region in the world. You’ll find recipes across all cuisines for each wine My Wine Guide recommends.
Meet Edward
With a few simple questions - and in less than 30 seconds - Edward creates your wine preference profile and right away begins offering wine recommendations for your favorite restaurants and retailers. Each personalized recommendation includes your match score and details about the wine region, the grape varietal/blend and food pairings. 
Edward helps you understand your unique wine preferences. You learn about the primary characteristics of red and white wine within the context of your personal likes and dislikes. You expand your knowledge of wine regions and grape varieties and blends. New to wine? Edward can help you build your wine profile. Frequent wine drinker but stuck in a rut? Edward can take you to wines and places beyond your comfort zone. Knowledgeable wine drinker? Have Edward curate restaurant wine lists that especially suit your tastes.
With My Wine Guide you can rate your wines, and keep track of the wines you like, where they are from, where you had them, and what you paid for them. As you use My Wine Guide or rate wines, your profile gets richer and Edward’s recommendations get even better.
Be My Wine Guide® social. Add wine loving friends to your profile. See what wines Edward would recommend for each of your friends. Whether you are at a restaurant together or planning a dinner party see what Edward recommends for each of your friends?
Support your local restaurants with takeout and host Virtual Wine Dinner Parties with My Wine Guide’s built in Zoom feature. Compare recommendations, favorites and ratings with your friends.
Download the app (Link), see your local retailers and restaurants and get instant recommendations that best suit your tastes!
My Wine Guide® currently includes wine lists from over 7,000 retailers and restaurants throughout the United States. We are continually adding retailers and restaurants and expanding our coverage. If your favorite retailer or restaurant is not included, send us a note to feedback@mywineguide.com.

No need to wait and hope for a successful scan. The instant you select a restaurant or retailer you get your best matches. And not just more of the same wines you know you already. My Wine Guide’s Diversity Algothim introduces you to new wines, varietals and regions from around the world.

Start your wine journey with My Wine Guide today and never look back.

Learn about and understand Your Preferences

My Wine Guide does a lot more than just recommend your best matches. We help you understand why your preferences – your palate – leads you to certain wines. My Wine Guide helps you develop a growing and ever expanding interest in and appreciation for wines around the world. For each wine, My Wine Guide explains why the wine is a match of a certain percentage for you personally. My Wine Guide is the only wine app that does this.

My Wine Guide De-mystifies Wine and Food Pairing

My Wine Guide does this in two ways. First, our participating partner restaurants provide food and wine pairing suggestions for each of their menu items and wines. You can start with a wine and see the suggested food pairings. Or you can start with your choice of food and see suggested wine pairings. Second, My Wine Guide has curated hundreds of recipes and has paired them with wines from every wine region in the world. You’ll find recipes across all cuisines for each wine My Wine Guide recommends.

Meet Edward

With a few simple questions - and in less than 30 seconds - Edward creates your wine preference profile and right away begins offering wine recommendations for your favorite restaurants and retailers. Each personalized recommendation includes your match score and details about the wine region, the grape varietal/blend and food pairings. 

Edward helps you understand your unique wine preferences. You learn about the primary characteristics of red and white wine within the context of your personal likes and dislikes. You expand your knowledge of wine regions and grape varieties and blends. New to wine? Edward can help you build your wine profile. Frequent wine drinker but stuck in a rut? Edward can take you to wines and places beyond your comfort zone. Knowledgeable wine drinker? Have Edward curate restaurant wine lists that especially suit your tastes.

With My Wine Guide you can rate your wines, and keep track of the wines you like, where they are from, where you had them, and what you paid for them. As you use My Wine Guide or rate wines, your profile gets richer and Edward’s recommendations get even better.

Be My Wine Guide® social. Add wine loving friends to your profile. See what wines Edward would recommend for each of your friends. Whether you are at a restaurant together or planning a dinner party see what Edward recommends for each of your friends?

Support your local restaurants with takeout and host Virtual Wine Dinner Parties with My Wine Guide’s built in Zoom feature. Compare recommendations, favorites and ratings with your friends.

Download the app (Link), see your local retailers and restaurants and get instant recommendations that best suit your tastes!

My Wine Guide® currently includes wine lists from over 7,000 retailers and restaurants throughout the United States. We are continually adding retailers and restaurants and expanding our coverage. If your favorite retailer or restaurant is not included, send us a note to feedback@mywineguide.com.

bluejetty:00175520:ios.description:
Car games and soccer collide in Rocket League Sideswipe! Multiplayer car soccer has been reimagined for mobile devices by the makers of the hit game Rocket League. Score goals in fast-paced 2-minute games and customize cars in the Garage. Party up with friends or play online games with players around the world.
Drive supersonic race cars and hit the soccer ball into your opponent’s net to win matches. Already a Rocket League pro? Fly into the air and pull off trick shots, even a flip reset! Dominate the soccer field and race to the top of the car soccer leaderboard by participating in worldwide Ranked Matches. Just want to relax and have fun? Online car soccer in Casual Mode lets you perform your craziest maneuvers without affecting your rank.
Multiplayer soccer games level up with a combination of action-packed soccer and rocket-powered cars. Play online multiplayer games for free and master the game’s intuitive touch controls, perfectly designed for mobile car battle gameplay. Unlock exciting Rocket Pass Cars and Items by playing online and proving yourself in the Arena. 
Experience online car game action from anywhere with Rocket League Sideswipe. Play together with friends and become a car soccer hero. Good luck, have fun!
Rocket League Sideswipe Features:
Fast-Paced Car Soccer
- Online multiplayer games: Face off in 1v1 or 2v2 car soccer matches
- Thrilling car soccer games await: Compete in 2-minute multiplayer matches
- Play online games from anywhere. No prior soccer or driving skills needed
- Hit the soccer field at any level. It doesn’t matter if you’re a Rocket League veteran
Redesigned for Mobile Sports Games
- Arena car action: With only three buttons needed for control, Rocket League Sideswipe offers easy-to-learn gameplay with room for freestyle stunts
- Car battle: Chase down the soccer ball with aerial boost and go on the offensive
- Play together in a two-player game and communicate with Quick Chat Stickers
- Enjoy matches with random in-game changes in the casual Game Mode Mutator Madness
Online and Offline Matches
- New to Rocket League? Start with our car soccer tutorial to get you the controls you need
- Play car soccer online in competitive team games with players around the world
- Multiplayer games in Casual Mode let you have more fun without affecting your ranks
- Play multiplayer games offline and hone your skills against bots
- Play together with friends or show off your best tricks in Private Matches
Rocket Pass and Seasons
- Online multiplayer games let you earn free Rocket Pass Items
- Play car soccer online and climb the Competitive Ranks with each new Season
- Ball game with unique rewards: earn Player Titles based on your Rank
- Keep things fresh by playing rotating seasonal Modes
Car Customization
- Customize cars with Items that you unlock as you play car soccer online
- Choose from thousands of customization combinations for your unique sports car
- Play soccer with a twist and unlock cars, wheels, decals & more!
- Track your in-game Item collection. Can you collect them all? 
Download Rocket League Sideswipe and meet your fated rivals on the pitch of this next-level sports game.
Follow for all the latest news and updates:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/RLSideswipe/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/RLSideswipe/
Discord: https://discord.gg/rlsideswipe
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RLSideswipe
Support: https://www.epicgames.com/help/en-US/rocket-league-sideswipe-c5719357738779

bluejetty:00086935:ios.description:
Inside a forest on a mysterious world...
A sorcerer is casting a spell in the dark.
Once the ritual was complete, a streak of light fell from the sky.
Then you regain consciousness in the middle of a strange forest.
Where... Am I? Where is this place?!
-Game Features-
You have been summoned to another world, against your will.
You know nothing, and everything is foreign to you.
You must find food for yourself, and be cautious of monsters that emerge at night.
If you let your guard down, it’ll be the end of you.
If you die, it will be game over, and you must start from the very beginning.
However, with every death comes more knowledge about
crafting and totems, which can help you to finish the game.
It requires patience and focus, but you will find joy in your journey.
Now, be brave! Your destiny awaits you!
Challenge yourself, in a brand new game experience in another world!

bluejetty:00037503:android.summary: DuuDuu Village is a vibrant board game community. It's a gathering place for board game enthusiasts to come together and enjoy their shared passion. With a diverse range of games and a welcoming atmosphere, DuuDuu Village fosters a sense of
bluejetty:00037503:android.description:
DuuDuu Village is a vibrant board game community. It's a gathering place for board game enthusiasts to come together and enjoy their shared passion. With a diverse range of games and a welcoming atmosphere, DuuDuu Village fosters a sense of camaraderie and friendly competition among its members.
WEREWOLF
this is a multiplayer game where players are assigned different roles, including Werewolves and Villagers. The objective of the game is to identify all the Werewolves before they eliminate all the Villagers. The game is played by presenting arguments and voting to hang a player whom they suspect to be a Werewolf.
MAFIA KITTENS
Also known as "Exploding Kittens", is a group card game designed for 2-5 players. With its simple yet captivating gameplay, it has gained immense popularity and is sure to bring a super fun atmosphere to your gatherings with friends.
SMASH PIG
On the table, there are 4 cards that are flipped one by one in a clockwise direction.
When the total number of pigs of the same color on the cards reaches 5, quickly ring the bell.
The person who rings the bell first and matches the correct number of pigs will win that round.
CARO
Also known as Gomoku, is a highly popular game, especially among teenagers.
The game is played on a board consisting of square cells. The two players take turns placing their markers on the squares of the board.
The symbol for each player's move is either X or O.

bluejetty:00015763:ios.name: Sun to Moon Sleep Clock
bluejetty:00015763:ios.summary: Sun to Moon Sleep Clock is a gentle sleep trainer that helps toddlers and young children learn when to stay in bed and when it’s okay to get up. Throughout the night, 26 stars disappear one by one, giving kids an easy visual countdown until
bluejetty:00015763:ios.description:
Sun to Moon Sleep Clock is a gentle sleep trainer that helps toddlers and young children learn when to stay in bed and when it’s okay to get up. Throughout the night, 26 stars disappear one by one, giving kids an easy visual countdown until morning. The app is quick to set up, fully customizable, and packed with optional sleep sounds, wake sounds, nap timers, and bedtime-routine tools.
Kids can personalize the friendly Sun and Moon characters with outfits and accessories from their shops. Everything is unlocked from the start, but you can enable the optional Snooze Rewards system to encourage healthy sleep habits. The longer your child stays in bed, the more Snooze Coins they earn — and they can trade them for fun gifts for Sun and Moon.
Wake-up times can be set from the settings screen or by tapping the orange time buttons on the main daytime screen. Tapping Goodnight triggers an instant sunset at bedtime. Need an early wake-up for a nap or a schedule change? Tap Moon’s nose three times for an out-of-schedule sunrise — and three more times for an immediate sunrise.
Full instructions: https://www.msibley.com/sleep-clock
Updates & tips: https://www.facebook.com/suntomoonsleepclock
––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
Key Features
• Gentle sleep training with a visual star countdown
• Soothing sleep sounds: Fan, white noise (hair dryer), waves, heartbeat, whale song, rain and more — or silence
• Fun wake-up sounds: Birds, digital alarm, drums, rooster, Happy Birthday, Santa/Jingle Bells and more — or silence
• Custom schedules: Optional 7-day routine planner
• Digital or analog clock styles, including a large-digit mode
• Speaking Clock: Tap Sun or Moon’s mouth to hear the time (optional)
• Customizable outfits and accessories for Sun and Moon
• Themes: Birthday, Christmas, Easter, Halloween, St Patrick’s Day, Pirates, Sports, Space
• Snooze Rewards system using collectible Snooze Coins (optional)
• Shooting-star progress bar for nighttime visualization
• Final Countdown Mode: Faster 12-star countdown before wake-up (optional)
• Reading Time: Moon reads for up to an hour at sunrise or sunset
• Nose Tap Naps: Set a nap duration and activate with 3 taps
• Immediate Sunrise: Trigger instantly with 3 extra taps
• Morning Memo: Write a message for your child — Sun can read it aloud (optional)
• Dim & Auto-Dim controls to reduce brightness
• Dark Mode for softer nighttime colors
• Built-in help screens throughout the app
• Multilingual support: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean
• PIN-protected settings with Face ID / Touch ID support (master code: 8529)
• Dreamy illustrations by artist Michael Sibley
––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
Helpful Notes
• For uninterrupted use, enable Guided Access to disable device buttons
• Keep your device plugged in while the app is running overnight
• Reduce screen brightness or enable Auto-Dim for extended nighttime use
• If you forget your settings PIN, the master code is 8529
––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
If You Find the App Helpful…
A rating or review on the App Store really helps us improve Sun to Moon.
Thank you for your support — and sweet dreams!

bluejetty:00131704:ios.description:
Millions of travelers trust FindPenguins, the first travel app of its kind. Plan, track, and share your trip – all in one. Instantly transform your journey into flyover videos vividly visualizing your travel route. Build your own unique travel profile by adding your places, photos, and stories – capturing memories that last a lifetime. And with just a wink, turn these memories into a carefully-designed hardcover travel book.
Activate our Travel Tracker to automatically record your travel route – battery-friendly and offline, with your phone in your pocket. Write posts about the places you visit, and let FindPenguins take care of the rest.
PLAN YOUR TRIP
Assemble your itinerary, upload essential travel documents, and have everything at your fingertips. Explore itineraries from fellow travelers to inspire your bucket list and effortlessly plan your next adventure. With access to an archive of over 10 million travel experiences, you can see places as they truly are.
TRACK WITH EASE
Automatically track and log your path on an interactive world map. Have complete control over your privacy, with the option to share your live location with a time delay. Add photos, videos, and travel stories, whether solo or alongside fellow travelers. Create an archive of your travel memories that lets you relive your journeys anytime, anywhere.
SHARING BRINGS JOY
Generate exciting 3D flyover videos of your recorded route — free and in seconds. Share your trip with family and friends in a fun, inviting way. Follow other travelers, stay connected with your loved ones, or find inspiration for future adventures.
WHAT ELSE?

— Lonely Planet Traveller

— Tobias, CEO

— Inside-Fact
TELL US HOW WE’RE DOING
Leave us a review if you’re enjoying your FindPenguins app experience or head over to our help page for further assistance: support.findpenguins.com

bluejetty:00186369:ios.name: Notes Writer Browser: Nautilus
bluejetty:00186369:ios.summary:
Students, teachers, writers, doctors, journalists, scholars and business professionals use Nautilus every day for class notes, meeting notes, marked-up PDFs, signed documents, papers and lectures.
Notes Writer Pro is now Nautilus, built on
bluejetty:00186369:ios.description:
Students, teachers, writers, doctors, journalists, scholars and business professionals use Nautilus every day for class notes, meeting notes, marked-up PDFs, signed documents, papers and lectures.
Notes Writer Pro is now Nautilus, built on the all-new Notes Writer app. It carries forward familiar writing and PDF tools, then adds a smart web browser, AI help for reading and research, and Magic Lasso. Math Notebooks help you work through calculations and create charts, all in one place on iPad and iPhone.
Write and make it yours
Create notes, papers and books with headings, lists, colors and highlights. Add images or handwritten notes with Apple Pencil. Use dictation, listen back to your writing, check word counts, and keep documents open in tabs. Work with MS Word, RTF, Markdown and plain text files.
Read and mark up PDFs
Read ebooks, articles and class materials, then write in the margins, highlight, draw, and add notes, recordings or signatures. Fill and sign forms, reorder pages, and scan paper documents into PDFs. Compare two documents side by side. Measure drawings to scale and hide sensitive text before sharing.
Browse and research
Use the built-in browser to read and research without leaving Nautilus. Open pages in tabs and bookmark sites. Ask AI about a webpage, summarize or translate it, or turn it into notes.
Use Magic Lasso and AI
Circle a passage or other content with Magic Lasso, then ask AI to explain or summarize what you selected. Get help with your own writing too: rewrite, simplify, correct spelling and grammar, adjust the tone, or chat through an idea.
Capture ideas, then find them again
Record lectures, meetings and ideas. Listen back, or create a transcript so you can find important details later. Connect notes, images and recordings on whiteboards, collect quick thoughts on sticky notes, and organize plans in outlines. Bring research together in Study Projects. Plan a book or long paper with sections and a visual Corkboard. Keep sources beside your draft, save snapshots as you revise, then compile a finished document or ebook.
Work through calculations
Use Math Notebooks to keep calculations and explanations together. Explore formulas, create charts and preview the finished PDF.
Organize and share
Keep notes in folders and notebooks. Give notebooks covers that make them easy to spot. Scan paper, import Word and other files, and find what you need with search. Export to PDF, Word, HTML, EPUB and more. Sync with iCloud, Dropbox, Box, Google Drive or WebDAV.
Look after your work
Autosave, document recovery and automatic backups help protect your progress. Use passcodes for the app or private folders. Your existing Notes Writer PDF notes and outlines open in Nautilus.
Privacy Policy
http://www.noteswriter.com/Kairoos_Privacy_Policy.html
Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00185187:ios.name: Maze CrazE - Maze Games!
bluejetty:00185187:ios.summary: Welcome to Maze Craze, your one stop app for classic maze and labyrinth puzzles! Packed with custom created mazes, Maze Craze is a challenging collection of 6 different difficulty levels with over a thousand mazes to solve. The mazes start
bluejetty:00185187:ios.description:
Welcome to Maze Craze, your one stop app for classic maze and labyrinth puzzles! Packed with custom created mazes, Maze Craze is a challenging collection of 6 different difficulty levels with over a thousand mazes to solve. The mazes start simple to get your feet wet, then progress to harder and harder labyrinths. (PRO TIP: You can skip ahead to harder levels once you complete a certain number of easy mazes in each level!) Each maze is designed to be played at your own pace, with no time limits or restrictions. Finish a round in one sitting or pause it and come back later, and because no wifi is necessary these puzzles are great for playing offline.
HOW TO PLAY
Maze Craze is easy to play! Each maze is custom made from scratch and we used several different algorithms to generate the mazes so that you’re always on your toes. The game starts with two dots, sitting on a maze grid. Start dot, and green end dot. (Easy so far, right?) Simply swipe anywhere on the screen in the direction you would like for your dot to travel, then keep swiping until you reach the green dot! We also hide valuable items throughout the mazes to help you out along the way. Make sure you take the time to side-quest for these, as you’ll want them in the larger, more complicated mazes.
LEVEL 1 - is pretty easy, these mazes are simple in nature and give you the ability to explore how the game works. This is a great place to collect a lot of orbs and build experience.
LEVEL 2 - starts to raise the heat a little with some larger mazes, but they’re still manageable, so make sure to take advantage of the orbs we hand out in these labyrinths. 
LEVEL 3 - gives you a taste of what’s coming. These mazes are bigger, have longer and more difficult paths, and hide orbs in more places.
LEVEL 4 - starts to challenge your brain a little bit. If you haven’t been tricked by a maze yet, then it will probably happen here. Stay sharp!
LEVEL 5 - isn’t for the faint of heart and you’ll start to appreciate having those orbs on these bigger mazes! Don’t spend them all, though, because:
LEVEL 6 - has the hardest mazes that you've been looking for, and they're going to challenge you from start to finish! 
Hunt and collect special items and win prizes!
*ORBS* - As you play be sure to collect orbs! These little fellas show up randomly throughout mazes. Collect them as you play to build up your bank, and use the orbs for hints and other prizes, such as new skins and colors! Watch a short video to add a multiplier and get even more orbs. They add up, so don’t forget to collect as many as you can find!
*SPIN FOR PRIZES* - Everyone loves surprises, so we hid prize boards throughout the mazes in each of the levels. Hunt down the stars that will appear randomly in a maze and spin for a prize! Watch a short video for more spins and even more prizes! 
*TREASURE CHESTS* - Be vigilant and wait for these to pop up throughout the labyrinths, they are a fun way to gather items!
*SPEED UP* - Turbo charge your line speed and cruise to the end of the maze faster! Each level moves a little faster, to cover more ground. But you can carve corners even quicker with this boost!
*SKINS* - Collect orbs throughout the mazes as you go, then use them to buy and swap out skins to match your mood!

With the largest Asian singles community in the world, Tantan is the #1 network to meet, chat, and date Asians or Asian Americans.

If you can't meet someone you like because of the busy work and limited social circle, just use Tantan to explore.

The most trendy way to meet new friends instantly. Find the ones you like quickly! If you both like each other, you will match instantly to start an instant chat to get to know each other. If you don't get a match right away, don't be discouraged, there are plenty of beautiful and interesting single Asian on Tantan waiting to match with you. Your special someone is just one step away!

[Product Features]
Well matched. No harassment. The choice is yours.

- Live chat. Efficient match. Instant reply from the ones you like.
- On Tantan, your matched lover is just one swipe away, or maybe your destined soulmate!

[VIP Membership Service Description]
Purchase VIP Membership and enjoy a better swiping and matching experience:

1. User name highlight & exclusive badge to help you stand out from the rest!
2. Unlimited Rewinds. Accidentally swiped left on that special someone? Go back as far as you like so you never miss your chance again!
3. Location Change. Curious what's out there? Explore on single Asians around the world!
4. Unlimited Likes. Find your match and get hit on as many people as you like every day!

These 4 privileges will bring you a much better dating app experience while dramatically improving your match rate! 

If you choose to purchase VIP membership, the subscription fee would be paid via iTunes account. The system would renew the subscription and deduct the corresponding fee automatically by the subscription type in the 24-hour window before the subscription expires. If you want to turn off the automatic renewal after purchase, please go to iTunes Settings to turn it off.

Currently, the price of VIP membership starts from $1.99 USD / 1 month. Pricing may differ in different regions. If you do not purchase VIP membership, you can still use Tantan for free.

bluejetty:00167901:ios.name: 2FA Authenticator: OTP Codes
bluejetty:00167901:ios.summary:
Never get locked out of an account again. AuthenticKey is the 2FA authenticator app built around the one thing other authenticators get wrong: moving to a new iPhone.
Generate secure two-factor authentication codes for Google, Microsoft, A
bluejetty:00167901:ios.description:
Never get locked out of an account again. AuthenticKey is the 2FA authenticator app built around the one thing other authenticators get wrong: moving to a new iPhone.
Generate secure two-factor authentication codes for Google, Microsoft, Apple, Facebook, Instagram, GitHub, Coinbase and 1000+ other services — backed up through your private iCloud and ready the moment you sign in on a new device.
WHY AUTHENTICKEY
Most authenticator apps trap your 2FA codes on a single device. Lose the phone, factory reset, or upgrade to a new iPhone — and you're locked out of every account, hunting for recovery codes you never saved. AuthenticKey fixes this with end-to-end encrypted iCloud sync. Your codes follow your Apple ID, not your hardware.
KEY FEATURES
• One-tap setup — scan any 2FA QR code in seconds
• Encrypted iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad
• Apple Watch app — generate codes from your wrist (Premium)
• Home Screen widget for instant code access (Premium)
• Face ID, Touch ID and passcode lock for the app itself
• Auto-clearing clipboard — copied codes wipe after 30 seconds
• Works offline — TOTP and HOTP codes generate without internet
• Supports SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 algorithms
• Full RFC 6238 (TOTP) and RFC 4226 (HOTP) standard compliance
• 11 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Korean, Japanese, Norwegian, Swedish
MOVE TO A NEW IPHONE WITHOUT LOSING ACCESS
Sign into iCloud on your new device, open AuthenticKey, and every account is exactly where you left it. No screenshots of recovery codes. No 30-minute account recovery flows. No emails to support teams. Migration that actually works.
WORKS WITH 1000+ SERVICES
Google · Microsoft · Apple · Amazon · Facebook · Instagram · X (Twitter) · Snapchat · TikTok · Discord · GitHub · Slack · Zoom · Dropbox · Coinbase · Binance · Kraken · KuCoin · Crypto.com · PayPal · Stripe · AWS · Azure · Salesforce · Okta · Duo · Cloudflare · Twitch · PlayStation · Xbox · Steam · Epic Games · LinkedIn · Reddit · Shopify · Notion · 1Password · LastPass · Bitwarden · ProtonMail · Tutanota · Fastmail — and any service supporting standard TOTP or HOTP.
PERFECT FOR
→ Crypto traders securing Coinbase, Binance and Kraken accounts
→ Developers managing AWS, GitHub and Cloudflare access
→ Remote teams using Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack
→ Anyone who's lost 2FA codes during an iPhone upgrade
→ Privacy-conscious users who want their secrets to stay on Apple's hardware
HOW WE PROTECT YOUR DATA
Your 2FA secrets are encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM and stored in the iOS Keychain. Sync uses your private iCloud — Apple can't read your codes and neither can we. We never see, store, or transmit your 2FA secrets in any form.
For app improvement and crash diagnostics we collect anonymous usage statistics. Your 2FA secrets are never part of that data and never leave your device unencrypted.
FREE VS PREMIUM
Free: Core 2FA authenticator with iCloud backup, biometric lock and QR scanning.
Premium unlocks:
• Unlimited accounts
• Custom sorting and reordering
• Apple Watch sync
• Home Screen widget code display
• Priority support
SUPPORT
Email: info@authentickey.app
Privacy Policy & Terms: https://authentickey.app/privacy

bluejetty:00184019:ios.description:
First State Bank of Livingston is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FSB - myMobile: 
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FSB - myMobile app, you must be enrolled as a First State Bank of Livingston Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00082369:ios.name: Albums: Music Library Player
bluejetty:00082369:ios.summary: Albums is the Apple Music player that puts you in control of your music. Whether you just want to throw on album shuffle or spend hours meticulously sorting and filtering your collection, Albums cares about your music library as much as you
bluejetty:00082369:ios.description:
Albums is the Apple Music player that puts you in control of your music. Whether you just want to throw on album shuffle or spend hours meticulously sorting and filtering your collection, Albums cares about your music library as much as you do.
Free Features:
QUICK SELECTION
Just press “shuffle,” scroll through a grid of album art, or browse your library to select an album, and easily skip to the next one with album-focused controls.
WIDGETS & CARPLAY
See your music on your home screen with Now Playing, Collection, and Quick Collection widgets. Take it on the road with CarPlay, and pin albums and collections for easy access.
ICLOUD SYNC
iCloud sync ensures you can pick up listening where you left off across all your devices.
ALBUM NOTES
Add notes about albums or specific listening sessions.
ACCESSIBLE FOR ALL
Albums offers robust Siri interactions and App Intents and supports Dynamic Type.
Premium Tools for Power Users*:
SUBSTANTIAL STATS
Get weekly, monthly, and yearly reports looking back at your listening, and dig into the data with customizable charts. 
LAST.FM COMPATIBILITY
Scrobble your listening in real-time or manually. Import your last.fm history to fill in the full picture.
MORE CUSTOMIZATION
Explore built-in Insight Collections highlighting new and unlistened albums, old favorites you haven’t heard in a while, or even music from when you were in high school. Tag albums to create collections of your own. Customize the interface to match the color of your current album’s artwork with a simple two-finger tap.
RICHER DISCOVERY
See what’s next with a release feed of Artists and Record Labels in your library. Delve into production credits from MusicBrainz and Discogs, then browse collections of Record Labels, Producers, and more.
*Requires Albums Premium
Note:
Albums optionally integrates with Apple Health. If you choose to give Albums access to your Workout history, it can create "Workout Jams" Insight Collections, which match up your listening history to your exercise history. You can enable this functionality by going to the Insights tab and tapping the settings gear next to the "Workout Jams" heading. Permission for Albums to access this data can be controlled via the Apple Health app.

bluejetty:00035245:ios.description:
Experience the next generation of drawing with AR Drawing App - Sketchify – the ultimate tool that transforms how you sketch, trace, and create art. Powered by advanced Augmented Reality (AR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), this app redefines digital and real-world drawing.
Whether you're a beginner, hobbyist, or artist looking to refine your skills, Sketchify provides all the tools you need to learn, practice, and create with unmatched precision and freedom.
CORE FEATURES
AR Drawing – Project, Trace & Create:
- Use your phone camera to project any image onto paper, canvas, or any surface.
- Trace outlines through your screen in real time for learning, replicating artwork, or creating complex designs.
- AR Drawing adapts to your space, giving you guided drawing in real life.
Photo to Sketch – Turn Images into Line Art:
- Import photos, selfies, or designs from your library and convert them into clean sketch outlines.
- Combine with AR Drawing to trace personal references on paper with perfect positioning.
- Adjust opacity, turn on flashlight, lock screen, and align images for an accurate drawing experience.
Drawing Lessons – Beginner to Advanced:
- Step-by-step drawing guides help you move from basic shapes to advanced techniques.
- Perfect for beginners or artists mastering styles like Anime, Chibi, Portraits, and Anatomy.
- Lessons integrate seamlessly with AR drawing for an interactive, hands-on experience.
Daily Streak – Practice & Unlock Rewards:
- Build a daily drawing habit and stay motivated by watching your artistic progress grow.
- Track drawing time, calendar, and achievements directly on your personal profile.
- Keep your streak alive to unlock exclusive premium templates, badges, and secret rewards.
AI Art Generator – Let Ideas Become Art Instantly:
- Describe any concept, and our built-in AI generates original line art within seconds.
- Customize AI-generated images and trace them on real paper.
- Ideal for overcoming creative blocks and finding inspiration on demand.
1000+ Templates & Search – Unlimited Visual Inspiration:
- Explore a massive library featuring Anime, Aesthetic, Animals, Flowers, and more.
- Search directly inside the app using smart AI search to find high-quality image references fast.
Smart Coloring Tools – Bring Your Art to Life:
- Enhance your artwork with easy-to-use guided coloring tools after tracing.
- Play with palettes, gradients, and fill options to make your drawings vibrant.
SMART FEATURES & CUSTOM SETTINGS
- Customizable projection: adjust placement, opacity, zoom, and rotation for optimal alignment.
- User-friendly interface: clean, responsive, and made for all skill levels.
- Works seamlessly on both iPhone and iPad.
WHY CREATORS LOVE SKETCHIFY
- AR Drawing projection makes tracing directly on paper effortless and precise.
- Guided drawing lessons help you grow naturally from beginner to advanced.
- Daily streak system keeps your creative practice fun and rewarding.
- Combines drawing, tracing, coloring, AI art, and learning in one app.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS:

- Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Canceled subscriptions remain active until the period ends; no refunds issued.
- Unused portions of free trials are forfeited upon subscription purchase.

MEEFF goes beyond a simple
bluejetty:00140971:ios.description:
Do you want to make friends from Japan, the USA, or France? Do you want to learn a new language?
Or are you looking for a chat app where you can just have fun talking to a boyfriend, girlfriend, or a local friend?
MEEFF goes beyond a simple language exchange app; it enables everything from language acquisition to diverse communication and heart-fluttering encounters! Meet your first international friends on MEEFF!
On MEEFF, you can meet people through various free features, including free matching, free chatting, and free entry!
If you want to exchange languages with foreign friends or practice the language you're studying through conversation, even a short, fun chat with a friend will be a healing experience!
■ If text is not enough, video call the friends you want
You can have the calls you want with specific friends through VibeMeet or 1:1 chats. In 1:1 chats, you can enjoy unlimited video calls. The moment you talk while seeing each other's faces, you can share deeper connections and warmer emotions. Conversations filled with smiles and eye contact will bring your hearts closer together.
■ Meet verified friends through photo authentication
Let others know that your profile photo is really you with our secure profile verification! A single verification badge will make you more attractive than a hundred words of self-introduction.
■ Set various conditions for the friends you want to meet
Search for the type of encounter you want, friends nearby, or friends who are currently online. You can meet friends from all over the world with your own custom filters.
■ 365-day report monitoring
MEEFF constantly monitors for fake profiles and suspicious activities through our scammer reporting system. If you encounter an inappropriate user, please report them immediately. We will strive to create a safe and secure MEEFF you can trust.
It doesn't matter if you call it MEEFF, Miff, or Mef!
If you want to meet international friends instead of just Korean ones, come to MEEFF, where friends from 196 countries await! If you want to use card swiping and other features to meet both Korean and foreign friends, come to MEEFF! If you want to study foreign languages, come to MEEFF with its real-time translation! On MEEFF, you can meet friends with various matching styles that suit you.
--
Access Permission Information
[Required Permissions]
- Location: Checking customer location to find nearby friends
- Camera: Required for video calls or uploading profile photos
Paid subscription items are provided only to users who wish to use specific features.
■ Basic Subscription: Unlimited Discovery!
- Remove all in-app ads
- Unlimited Likes
- Daily Bonus Rubies (5 Rubies/day upon check-in)
- Daily Visitor items (2/day upon check-in)
- VIP Profile Frame
■ Plus Subscription: Verified & Targeted Matching
- Set up to 5 target nationality filters
- Find friends within a 5km radius
- Filter for Photo-Verified friends only
- Filter by the number of profile photos
- Filter for currently online friends
- Exclude up to 5 specific countries
- Filter by ""Purpose of Use""
- Includes all Basic Subscription benefits (No ads, Unlimited Likes)
- Daily Bonus Rubies (10 Rubies/day upon check-in)
- Daily Visitor items (5/day upon check-in)
This product is an auto-renewing subscription. Renewal fees will be charged unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. Subscription payments are made automatically through your iTunes account and can be canceled at any time in your account settings. If a user purchases a subscription, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited.
--
This service includes paid in-app items, and separate fees apply upon purchase.
- Terms of Use : https://bit.ly/meeff_tos
- Privacy Policy : https://bit.ly/meeff_privacypolicy
- Location-Based Service Terms : https://bit.ly/meeff_location

bluejetty:00179096:ios.description:
La YOXO nu ai perioadă contractuală și nu poți face cost suplimentar. Tu faci regulile. Plătești pentru Roaming doar în lunile în care îl folosești. 
Activează un număr nou, portează-ți numărul din orice rețea sau treci pe YOXO de la cartela Orange.
Beneficiile ofertei YOXO:
1. Modifici abonamentul oricând ai nevoie, astfel lunar poți configura abonamentul de mobil în funcție de nevoile tale, direct din aplicație, fără să plătești pentru ce nu folosești.
2. Ai net NELIMITAT în rețeaua Orange 4G+/5G+.
3. Ai roaming cand vrei, indiferent daca pleci in SEE sau in afara SEE
4. Portarea se face direct din aplicația YOXO, trebuie să ai la îndemână buletinul, o factură și un card bancar.
5. Le vei putea administra abonamentele părinților, copiilor direct din aplicație, iar dacă ești fan Smart Home, poți folosi SIM-ul YOXO inclusiv camere video sau gadgeturi.
6. . Ai opțiuni pentru orice: să plătești transportul în comun, parcarea, taxa de pod sau să faci o donație 7. Când alegi activarea cu eSIM și când păstrezi SIM-ul tău, activarea se face pe loc
De ce YOXO este diferit de o cartelă prepay:
Plata se face automat lunar.
Modifici oferta când și cum vrei.
Oferta se reînnoiește la fiecare 30 de zile.
De ce YOXO este diferit de un abonament obișnuit:
Nu trebuie să faci niciun drum: faci totul din aplicație
Adaugi roaming și alte opțiuni pe loc atunci când vrei. 
Modifici abonamentul când vrei.
Nu faci cost suplimentar.
Poți renunța când vrei. 
Întrebări frecvente
Facturi - Vei scăpa de grija reîncărcării, căci plata se face automat și online: plătești cu cardul, direct în aplicația mobilă. Plata se face la începutul lunii de facturare și serviciul este activ pentru următoarele 30 de zile. La începutul fiecărei luni de facturare vom retrage automat contravaloarea pachetului ales de tine, de pe cardul înregistrat în aplicație. În cazul în care plata din aplicație eșuează din diverse moptive (de exemplu fonduri insuficiente), poți plăti cu orice card și pe site-ul YOXO.
eSIM - Alege să activezi cu eSIM și te vei bucura de o instalare instant în aplicație, mai simplă și mai rapidă, fără să mai aștepți după curier. 
Consum - În aplicație vei vedea mereu consumul de resurse în timp real, în secțiunea Consum, și vei ști mereu câte minute ai consumat sau cât net mai ai la dispoziție.
Asistență clienți - Pentru a contacta serviciul de asistență clienți, poți accesa secțiunea Messenger din aplicație. În plus, ai acces gratuit, 24/7 la YOXO Helper, asistentul virtual care îți răspunde la întrebările despre serviciul YOXO.
Hai pe YOXO!

bluejetty:00040256:ios.description:
A free VPN supported by ads, with a free data allowance and optional rewarded ads to earn more data. SuperVPN is built for occasional browsing, travel and public Wi-Fi—not a subscription-first routine.
YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
Use your available free data. When an eligible reward is offered, watch an ad to add data to your allowance. Rewards are confirmed by the service; amounts and availability are shown in the app. SuperVPN displays ads. The current allowance does not reset every day.
FIND A PLACE TO CONNECT
Auto Select finds an available route. Search servers by location or return to recently used locations. Availability and connection quality depend on your network, account and the selected route. An internet connection is required.
A WELCOME TO VIP
Eligible new users may receive a complimentary VIP experience when a welcome offer is available. Duration and eligibility appear in the app. VIP access and existing paid plans follow the benefits shown for that plan; a welcome offer is not a permanent entitlement.
START AS A GUEST
No email registration is needed to get started. Review the first-launch terms, allow the iOS VPN configuration when prompted, and use the connection button. Choose from supported interface languages.
OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Subscriptions are optional. The price, billing period and plan benefits are displayed before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Auto-renewing subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the end. Manage or cancel in Apple Account subscription settings. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion is forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00090266:ios.description:
Coverage Map helps you find the #1 cell phone carrier in your area. It is a crowdsourced map of cellular networks in the US, Canada, United Kingdom, and Puerto Rico with more countries launching soon.
SPEED TEST MAP (All Countries)
• Highly accurate: see real-world performance reported by users
• Real-time: map updates in real-time as new data comes in
• Rich detail: tap any square to see download speeds, upload speeds, and latency for all carriers in that area
• Powerful filters: filter by carrier, LTE/5G, download speeds, upload speeds, or see your speed tests only
• Helpful color profiles: default, heat map, and best carrier help you visualize and understand the data
• Easy to understand: see what carrier performs best in an area at a glance with the Best Carrier color profile
BUILT-IN SPEED TEST (All Countries)
• Test your speeds: see how fast your LTE or 5G connection is by running a speed test 
• Accurate results: get accurate results for download speed, upload speed, and latency
• Recurring tests: run up to 500 recurring tests automatically and customize the pause duration between tests
• Set a data limit: limit how much data the app can use
• Tag your tests: tag a test as indoor, outdoor, driving, or other
• Improve the Speed Map: running a speed test automatically contributes to the fastest-growing crowdsourced map of cellular networks (note: if your country is not currently supported, when we do launch in your country all of your tests will instantly be mapped and will show up on the map)
SIGNAL STRENGTH MAP (US only)
• Check reception: see where each carrier has great, good, or poor coverage 
• Compare coverage footprints: toggle between carriers to see how coverage footprints compare in different areas
• Data for every location: the Signal Strength Map uses data from the FCC Broadband Collection, which has coverage data for the continental U.S., Alaska, and Hawaii
COVERAGE REPORT MAP (US only)
• Data-driven reports: the Coverage Report Map aggregates all available data points to generate detailed reports of cellular coverage & performance in every state, county, city, and ZIP code
• Percentage covered: see what percentage of an area each carrier covers
• Weighted median: see weighted median values for download speed, upload speeds, and latency for a better picture of real-world cellular performance
• Carrier rankings: see what carrier ranks best for coverage, speed, reliability, and overall performance in every area
• Distribution graphs: see the distribution graphs for download speeds, upload speeds, and latency
• Performance by time of day: see how data speeds vary over the course of day as network traffic picks up
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://coveragemap.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00200150:ios.description:
BitBop: Your Games. Your Music.
Rediscover the soundtracks that made your favorite games unforgettable. BitBop is a retro game music emulator that transforms your game collection into a personal music library, letting you experience the original soundtracks of your favorite games without having to play them.
Simply import your supported game files, and BitBop identifies each title, extracts its music, and organizes everything into beautiful soundtrack albums.
FEATURES
• Emulate authentic retro game music directly from supported game files.
• Automatically discover and organize soundtracks into albums.
• Automatic cover and metadata detection where available.
• Create custom playlists featuring tracks from different games and consoles.
• Enjoy your favorite game soundtracks without launching or playing the games.
• Experience a clean, intuitive music player designed for iPhone.
SUPPORTED SYSTEMS
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy / Game Boy Color
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Virtual Boy
• Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
Compatibility and soundtrack availability vary by game.
Whether you’re revisiting childhood favorites or discovering something new, BitBop brings generations of video game music together in one place.
Your Games. Your Music.
Note: BitBop does not include copyrighted game files, audio files, or soundtracks. Users must provide their own legally obtained game files.

bluejetty:00146779:ios.summary:
AlHadi Prayer: Your Companion in Worship
AlHadi is a comprehensive app that brings together accurate prayer times, the Quran, duas and ziyarat, a religious calendar, Qibla direction, and reliable notifications — all designed to help you o
bluejetty:00146779:ios.description:
AlHadi Prayer: Your Companion in Worship
AlHadi is a comprehensive app that brings together accurate prayer times, the Quran, duas and ziyarat, a religious calendar, Qibla direction, and reliable notifications — all designed to help you organize your worship with ease and peace of mind. The app offers practical spiritual tools that support you throughout your day.
Prayer times are calculated accurately based on your location according to Shia standards, with customize options and countdowns to upcoming prayers. The app also includes a full calendar showing daily and monthly occasions, major events of current Hijri month, Kawamel and Muhaq days, and Hilal confirmation card.
Distinctive Features
AlHadi stands out with exclusive features rarely found in other prayer apps. It calculates the end of Fadilah time (the most virtuous time to pray) for each prayer and displays it with a live countdown using precise astronomical calculations automatically adjusted to your location.
The app also responds dynamically to religious occasions — such as Imam birth anniversaries, martyrdom commemorations, Ramadan, and the Ashura season — by changing interface colors and sending themed text and audio notifications that reflect the spirit of each event, keeping you spiritually connected throughout the Islamic year.
The Duas section offers a rich collection of more than 200 duas and ziyarat with search bar for quick access. An accurate compass helps you find the direction of the Qibla, the Prophet’s Mosque, and the shrines of the Imams (peace be upon them). You can also explore a flexible calendar available in Hijri, Gregorian, or Syriac formats, with smooth navigation between weeks and months.
The app supports four languages: Arabic, English, Persian, and Urdu. All of this is presented through carefully designed interfaces that are clear, smooth, and easy to use.
Support & Share in the Divine Reward
The “Share in the Reward” page allows users to contribute to the app’s ongoing ensure it remains accurate, reliable, and continually refined.
Features
Home Screen
• Accurate prayer times based on your location
• Show or hide selected prayer times
• Countdown to the next prayer
• Show and hide home page items
• Fadilah time display
• Countdown to the end of Fadilah time
• Upcoming time display with countdown
• Today & Tonight’s occasions
• Hijri month events
• Highlighted occasions of the current month
• Kawamel and Muhaq days
• Hilal Confirmation card
• Share prayer and Fadilah times
• Share monthly calendar
Calendar Section
• Hijri, Gregorian, or Syriac calendar views
• View prayer times and events for any selected day
Quran Section
• Read by surah or juz
• Bookmark feature
• Adjustable text size
• Duas after Quran recitation
• Search feature
Duas Section
• More than 200 organized duas and ziyarat
• Adjust font size and type
Compass Section
Accurate direction for the Qibla, the Prophet’s Mosque, and the shrines of the Imams (peace be upon them).
Settings Page
• Create an account to sync preferences
• Adhan notifications at prayer time
• Well-known muezzins

AlHadi Prayer: Your Companion in Worship
 
AlHadi is a comprehensive app that brings together accurate prayer times, the Quran, duas and ziyarat, a religious calendar, Qibla direction, and reliable notifications — all designed to help you organize your worship with ease and peace of mind. The app offers practical spiritual tools that support you throughout your day.

The app also includes a full calendar showing daily and monthly occasions, major events of current Hijri month, Kawamel and Muhaq days, and Hilal confirmation card.
 
Distinctive Features
AlHadi stands out with exclusive features rarely found in other prayer apps. It calculates the end of Fadilah time (the most virtuous time to pray) for each prayer and displays it with a live countdown using precise astronomical calculations automatically adjusted to your location.
 
The app also responds dynamically to religious occasions — such as Imam birth anniversaries, martyrdom commemorations, Ramadan, and the Ashura season — by changing interface colors and sending themed text and audio notifications that reflect the spirit of each event, keeping you spiritually connected throughout the Islamic year.
 
The Duas section offers a rich collection of more than 200 duas and ziyarat with search bar for quick access. An accurate compass helps you find the direction of the Qibla, the Prophet’s Mosque, and the shrines of the Imams (peace be upon them). You can also explore a flexible calendar available in Hijri, Gregorian, or Syriac formats, with smooth navigation between weeks and months.
 
The app supports four languages: Arabic, English, Persian, and Urdu. All of this is presented through carefully designed interfaces that are clear, smooth, and easy to use.

bluejetty:00187498:ios.description:
Loyverse POS is the free POS (point-of-sale) software perfect for your retail store, cafe, bar, restaurant, pizzeria, bakery, coffee shop, food truck, grocery store, beauty salon, car wash and more. No ads, no credit card required, no contracts, and no commitments.
Use Loyverse POS point of sale system instead of a cash register, and track sales and inventory in real time, manage employees and stores, engage customers and increase your revenue.
Mobile POS System
- Sell from a smartphone or tablet
- Issue printed or electronic receipts
- Accept multiple payment methods
- Apply discounts and issue refunds
- Track cash movements
- Scan barcodes with the built-in camera
- Keep recording sales even while offline
- Connect a receipt printer, barcode scanner, and cash drawer
- Connect Loyverse Customer Display app to show order information to your customers
- Manage multiple stores and POS devices from a single account
Card Payments
- Accept card payments directly in Loyverse POS with Loyverse Payments

- Sale total is sent to the payment device automatically — no manual entry

- Track sales, refunds, tips, fees, and payouts — all in Loyverse
- Every transaction is processed securely through PCI-compliant infrastructure
- Use your preferred merchant service provider for non-integrated payments
- Choose from other integrated payment providers where available
Inventory Management
- Track inventory in real time
- Set stock levels and receive automatic low stock alerts
- Bulk import and export inventory from/to a CSV file
- Manage items that have different sizes, colors, and other options
Sales Analytics
- View revenue, average sale, and profit
- Track sales trends and react promptly to changes
- Determine best-selling items and categories
- Track financial shifts and identify discrepancies
- View complete sales history
- Browse reports on payment types, modifiers, discounts and taxes
- Export sales data to the spreadsheets
CRM and Customer Loyalty Program
- Build a customer base
- Run loyalty program to reward customers for their recurring purchases
- View customer purchase history to provide personalized service
- Instantly identify customers during a sale by scanning loyalty card barcodes
- Print customer address on receipt to streamline delivery orders
Restaurant and Bar Features
- Connect kitchen printers or Loyverse Kitchen Display app
- Use dining options to mark orders as dine in, takeout or for delivery
- Use predefined open tickets in a table service environment

Tracker Protection runs at the DNS
bluejetty:00132343:ios.description:
Trackers follow you everywhere — in apps, browsers, and emails — building profiles that advertisers and data brokers sell, and AI-powered attackers weaponize. Tracker Protection stops them.
HOW IT WORKS
Tracker Protection runs at the DNS layer. Every domain your device tries to look up routes through our encrypted DNS resolver. So every time an app or website tries to connect to a known tracker, our technology blocks the connection before the tracker can do anything. No scripts run. No data leaves. No profile gets built.
 — Blocks thousands of tracker domains before they collect your data
 — Encrypts every DNS lookup so your ISP, carrier, and Wi-Fi network can't see what sites and apps you're using
 — Works system-wide: every app, every browser, every email client on your device
FREE
 — Default tracker blocking, always on
 — Encrypted DNS for every lookup
PREMIUM
Everything in Free, plus:
 — Activity dashboard: see what was blocked, on which sites
 — Per-vendor controls — Facebook, Google, Amazon, TikTok, Snapchat — choose protection level for each
 — Block email tracking pixels
 — Block fingerprinting scripts
 — Block cryptomining
WHY DISCONNECT
 — No logs. We don't see, store, or sell your data. Ever.
 — Not a VPN. No server list, no sign-in, no slowdowns.
 — Built by Disconnect, the industry standard for tracker protection. Our technology powers tracker blocking in Mozilla Firefox and Microsoft Edge to help
 protect 350M+ users worldwide.
 — Pages load up to 2.4× faster when trackers aren't dragging them down.

Trackers follow you everywhere — in apps, browsers, and emails — building profiles that advertisers and data brokers sell, and AI-powered attackers weaponize. Tracker Protection stops them.

Tracker Protection runs at the DNS layer. Every domain your device tries to look up routes through our encrypted DNS resolver. نرم افزاری جامع با کاربری بسیار آسان و امکانات فوق العاده شامل: تلاوت‌های قرآنی، تفاسیر و ترجمه‌های فارسی، حالت شبانه، امکان یادداشت‌نویسی و اشتراک آیات. با دانلود این نرم‌افزار که دارای رابط کاربری بسیار زیبا و چشم نواز و رنگ‌بندی ملایم می‌باشد از خواندن قرآن لذت ببرید.


***امکانات نرم افزار***
● تفسیر و ترجمه
   - بیش از 10 تفسیر فارسی و چندین تفسیر عربی.
   - 10 ترجمه معاصر قرآن کریم به زبان فارسی.
   - ترجمه قرآن به زبان‌های زنده دنیا. 

● بخش تلاوت‌های قرآنی
   - تلاوت‌های قرآنی بیش از 100 قاری از مشهورترین قاریان جهان.
   - تلاوت قرآن با روایات حفص، ورش، دوری، شعبه.
   - رنگی شدن آیات و حرکت خودکار آن همزمان با تلاوت.
   - قابلیت دانلود تلاوات و گوش‌دادن به آنها بدون نیاز به اینترنت.
   - امکان تکرار آیه یا بخشی از سوره به تعداد انتخابی.
   - امکان تعیین مدت زمان تلاوت و توقف تلاوت پس از مدت تعیین شده.

● جستجو
   - جستجوی سریع و دقیق در آیات قرآن کریم و نمایش نتایج جستجو به ترتیب سوره و شماره صفحه.
   - جستجوی اسامی قاریان.
   - جستجوی در اسامی سوره‌ها.

● هم‌رسانی و کپی
   - امکان هم‌رسانی آیه و ترجمه و تفسیر آن از طریق واتساپ و برنامه‌های دیگر.
   - امکان به اشتراک گذاری آیه به صورت عکس با دیزاین بسیار زیبا.
   - اضافه یادداشت و نکات تدبری برای آیات در هنگام قرائت.

● امکانات دیگر نرم‌افزار
   - ارائه چاپ‌های مختلف قرآن شامل چاپ اول و سوم مصحف مدینه، مصحف ورش و مصحف نستعلیق.
   - قابلیت ایجاد لیست آیات منتخب جهت دسترسی سریع به آنها.
   - ذخیره اتوماتیک آخرین صفحه مطالعه شده و باز شدن آن در دفعات بعدی.
   - انتخاب آسان و سریع سوره‌ها و جزءها از طریق فهرست.
   - نمایش آیات قرآن با خط بزرگ در حالت لندسکیپ موبایل.
   - نمایش دو صفحه قرآن همانند نسخه چاپی در آیپد.
   - امکان فعال سازی حالت شبانه.
   - مجانی و خالی از تبلیغات.

bluejetty:00013751:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00013751:ios.description:
iAnnotate by Folia is the best way to read, annotate, and share PDFs, Microsoft Office files, images and web pages! Over 1 million people turn to iAnnotate to take notes, sign agreements, highlight documents, insert stamps and more.
New in v4: iPhone support, iPad Pro and multitasking support, automatic Apple Pencil detection, shape annotations, improved web markup, enhanced support for OneDrive (and OneDrive for Business), iCloud Drive, and iCloud backup.
iAnnotate’s award-winning interface and customizable set of features make it the go-to app for taking notes on lecture slides, annotating important business documents, revising screenplays, grading papers, and much more. Read on to learn about the great capabilities of iAnnotate: 
IPHONE: Now you can use iAnnotate on your phone, with all of the great features you’ve come to expect on your iPad.
IPAD PRO: iAnnotate works great with the iPad Pro. Automatically annotate when you use the Apple Pencil and easily pan, zoom, scroll with your fingers — no tool switching required. Get more work done with iOS multitasking and smart keyboard shortcuts.
ANNOTATE: Choose from the pen, highlighter, typewriter, stamp, straight-line, note, underline, strikeout, photo, voice recording, arrow, rectangle, circle, and date stamp tools.
CUSTOMIZE: Drag and drop tools to your custom toolbars. Swipe between toolbars, or open the Toolbox to access all your tools. 
ACCESS: Connect with Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive (including OneDrive for Business) or open PDFs directly from email and other apps.
SEARCH: Search documents in your local library and throughout your cloud storage. 
SHARE: iAnnotate saves your markups directly to the PDF, so they can be viewed and edited in external PDF readers. 
FLATTEN: Compress your annotations onto the document to prevent modification. This is useful for preserving signatures or for preventing recipients from deleting or changing your annotations. 
WEB MARKUP: Open a web capture tab and find the site you want to mark up. iAnnotate will convert it to a PDF for annotation.
NAVIGATE: Explore your documents by thumbnails, bookmarks, annotations, or search results.
UNLIMITED TABS: Open multiple documents in tabs, and easily navigate between them, on both tablet and phone. 
TWO DOCUMENTS: Work on two documents side-by-side, for even greater productivity.
MANAGE: Arrange documents by folders and sort contents by date added, date last opened, or alphabetical order.
CREATE: Create brand new PDFs with blank, lined, or graph-paper pages.
MODIFY: Add, delete, rotate, and rearrange pages in your documents. 
SUMMARIZE: Forward a summary of your annotations as an email or a new PDF.
SECURE: Full support for the iOS Data Protection and Keychain functions. 
Interested in using iAnnotate in your business or school? Visit us at www.folia.com to find out about our enterprise options.

bluejetty:00061522:ios.description:
PDF Reader Pro helps much for anyone who reads, edit, highlights, OCR, signs, converts, creates, protects, compresses and fills out PDFs on their iPhone and iPad. It also makes it easy to organize, annotate and edit your PDFs. Import files from your computer or the cloud, then complete forms, add freehand drawings and audio notes and more.
PDF Reader Pro offers even more - merge and combine multiple documents, split your PDFs, insert pages from another PDF, insert photos or hyperlinks to your PDFs, Convert PDF to Word and other Microsoft Office® formats. With support for reading files from popular productivity suites, it’s a convenient way to take the office anywhere you go.
PDF Reader Pro Edition for Professional is your last choice of PDF application.
READ
・ View PDFs with various themes like night mode to comfort your eyes.
・ Choose vertically/horizontally scroll pages or single/two pages/book mode.
・ Support crop mode, tabbed PDF reading, continuous page view, auto scroll and more.
・ Use text-to-speech feature to read selected text with no time limits.
・ Easy content navigation with bookmarks/outlines.
・ Fast files Printing to directly print PDFs from your device.
・ DRM, supports Vitrium* protected PDF files.
ANNOTATE
・ Annotate PDFs with highlight, underline, strikethrough, note, freehand, text box, anchored note, rectangle, circle, line etc.
・ Create multiple signatures with trackpad, keyboard or images.
・ Insert pre-designed stamps such as Approved, Confidential and more.
・ Support to link any part of the text to a different page, email or website.
・ Share your annotated PDFs with others via PDF documents/Flattened copy/ Summary/ Original PDF.
EDIT PDF
・Edit PDF text. Easily fix typos or other inaccurate content. Fast change the font color, size and style.
・Modify PDF images such as cropping, rotating, deleting, replacing, etc. Easily resize or move images for a better layout.
・Add&edit watermarks to keep your PDFs safe and professional. Watermark tiling is supported.
・Extract images from PDFs.
・Create a Flattened copy to flatten PDF to make the contents static.
PAGE EDITOR
・ Merge & Split PDFs available, split documents into multiple documents or combine multiple pages into a new one.
・ Extract the desired pages to create a new PDF.
・ Insert blank pages / another PDF to import specified content.
・ Rotate, rearrange, add, and delete PDF pages.
Fill FORMS
・ Work with static PDF forms created in Adobe Acrobat.
・ Fill out any PDF forms with interactive fields such as text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, combo boxes, list boxes, etc.
CONVERT PDF
 · Export from PDF to Microsoft Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), RTF, Text, Image, HTML, CSV, and more Offline.
・ Convert MS Office documents, iWorks, web content, and images to PDFs.
・ Create a new PDF as a blank PDF or from your clipboard content.
COMPRESS PDFs
・ Compress large PDFs to reduce file size. PDF size-reduction for easily sharing.
OCR
· OCR pdfs to convert scanned PDF files or pictures into editable & searchable PDFs/TXT files. 50+ languages supported!
PROTECT CONTENT WITH PASSWORD AND ENCRYPTION
・ Passcode to prevent unauthorized use of PDF Reader Pro.
・ Encrypt to protect your PDF files from unauthorized reading with a password.
SCANNER
・Make continuous scans and automatically detect edges of scanned objects.
Text-to-Speech
・ Support a total of 36 voices for 26 languages.
WORK IN THE CLOUD
・ Store & secure files on iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Evernote, Box, FTP, WebDav, etc.
Backup Files between iOS Devices, Mac and PC
・ Connect your iPhone/iPad with a desktop for transferring files using USB or WiFi connection.
Support Various File Types
・ MS Office, iWork, image files
・ Compressed files (zip, rar)
・ audio and video files
・ Other file formats
Have any feedback? Please contact us directly at support@pdfreaderpro.com
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
