bluejetty:00068026:ios.name: Esthetician Exam Prep 2026
bluejetty:00068026:ios.summary:
Esthetician Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass Esthetics State Board Exams with a high score on your first attempt.
Esthetician Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into esthetician exam preparation
bluejetty:00068026:ios.description:
Esthetician Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass Esthetics State Board Exams with a high score on your first attempt.
Esthetician Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into esthetician exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In Esthetician Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official exam requirements. According to the exam requirements, you must master all subjects in order to successfully pass the esthetician exam.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Infection Control
- Human Physiology
- Skin Histology
- Trichology
- Skin Evaluation
- Skin Care
- Facial & Massage Care
- Hair Removal Care
- Cosmetic Analysis & Chemistry
- Makeup Principles and Procedures
- Equipment Use
- Professional Image
- Customer Communication and Information Recording
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You'll need to practice all 13 subjects, which will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the esthetician exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice on the Esthetician Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam will increase, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you have developed good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the esthetician exam, but any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://esthetician.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://esthetician.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please let us know via email at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00171167:ios.name: Todewy: Visual Daily Planner
bluejetty:00171167:ios.summary: Todewy is a fun social todo app to track your todos, goals, and routines. Create todo items and take a picture to mark them as complete. Follow friends and see what your friends are up to on a feed that motivates you to be productive. Todew
bluejetty:00171167:ios.description:
Todewy is a fun social todo app to track your todos, goals, and routines. Create todo items and take a picture to mark them as complete. Follow friends and see what your friends are up to on a feed that motivates you to be productive. Todewy is built as a positive community that encourages each other to get their daily todo items done.
Todewy has several amazing use cases:
- Track your fitness and health progress with pictures. See your progress over time.
- Track your homework and school assignments. Get motivation from the other students on Todewy.
- Share accountability with roommates, family, or romantic partners. Easily check in on shared todos.
- Build healthy new habits with positive affirmation. 
--- From the Developer ---
Hi everyone! I’m Liz, the creator of Todewy. I’m an independent app developer that builds fun and safe apps for my online community. My goal is to create apps that add positivity to your day, have a useful purpose, and create a safe online environment. Todewy operates as an independently funded venture and I highly value data privacy and safety. I am actively working on Todewy and adding improvements & new features every week! Hope you have fun using Todewy!
--- App Features ---
- Create todo items: easily create tasks for short or long term.
- Photo checkin: mark a todo as complete by taking a picture. Create a log of pictures for all of your productive moments.
- My profile: build up your profile by creating and completing todo items, building up a streak, adding routines, and adding goals. 
- Goals: create a goal to track something you want to achieve over time. Track your progress by seeing all of the todos you have completed for your goal. Upload a cover picture and pick a color to customize your goals.
- Routines: create routines for todos you do regularly. Build better habits by creating new routines in your life. Routine todos can be added to your goals as well. 
- Reminders: get reminders for your todos so that you don’t forget about them.
- Home screen widgets: add a widget to your home screen to help you remember your todos and be more productive.
- Follow friends: find and follow friends and see all of their productive moments. 
- React and comment on friends’ todos: add reactions and comments to cheer on your friends as they get their tasks done.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00184984:ios.description:
Are you ready for a fast-paced multiplayer battles?
Battle with friends or solo across a variety of game modes! Join millions of players worldwide! You can create and customize your own character and show off on the battlefield!
Unlock and upgrade dozens of characters with powerful swords. Purchase and collect unique skins to stand out in the arena.
Swim and take out your opponents using a swordfish tusk to stab other swordfish.
HOW TO PLAY:
Use the Joystick to move around.
Use the boost button to accelerate (you need time to refill after use).
If you pierce another player with your sword, they will explode and your sword will get longer, and vice versa.
The size of your sword or your enemy doesn’t weaken your chances of becoming victorious.
BATTLE IN MULTIPLE GAME MODES
* Classic: endless battle against other players. Earn trophies to progress through multiple arenas all the way to the top.
* Team battle: team up and eliminate the opposing team. Each team has equal number of revive tickets. if your team runs out of tickets you can’t respawn to the game.
* Survival: a battle royale style fight for survival. 50 players in one room! You die once, you're out!
* Kill the king: all the players are against one king. If you kill the king you will become a new one with a bigger sword.
* Arms race: you start the game without a sword. You need to find a sword fast in order to survive.
* Smash: an overcrowded tiny room with a lot of players, You should be fast and have a good reaction time in order to survive this much intensity.
* One sword pro: this mode is for experts who like fast-paced battles. Only one sword characters are allowed.
Thank you for all the comments and advice, we really appreciate it. 
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Gold Membership offers:
Weekly subscription for $7.99 (+tax) after 3-day free trial.
It unlocks unique vip characters, removes all ads and gives additional features (you will get daily: +500 Stars, +200 Crystals and 2x boost). This is an Auto-renewable subscription. 
Platinum Membership offers:
Weekly subscription for $11.99 (+tax)
It unlocks unique platinum characters, removes all ads and gives additional features (you will get daily: +1000 Stars, +300 Crystals and 2x acceleration, 2x stars, 2x magnet). This is an Auto-renewable subscription. 
Classic card membership offers:
Monthly 1000Stars instantly + 400Stars every day. for $1.99(+tax)
Privilege card membership offers:
Monthly 800Gems instantly + 250Gems every day. for $2.99(+tax)
Senior Privilege card membership offers:
Monthly 1500Gems instantly + 400Gems every day. for $4.99(+tax)
Case of crystals membership offers:
Monthly 9000Gems for $6.99(+tax)

Monthly 15000Star for $5.99(+tax)

bluejetty:00156243:ios.description:
Your key to the Digital Maldives! Unlocking a world of digital possibilities
EASY
• Conveniently create your own verified ID to use across multiple digital and in-person services.
EMPOWERING
• Track and manage how your personal information is shared and maintained by official registrars.
SECURE
• Safeguard your identity and assure your data's safety with biometrics and multi-factor authentication.
KEY APP FEATURES:
PASSWORD-LESS / OTP-LESS AUTHENTICATION: No more passwords and OTPs. Conveniently access online services using:
• QR CODE LOGIN: Scan QR Code to login.
• ONE TAP LOGIN: Tap an icon to login.
VIEW YOUR INFORMAITON IN ONE PLACE: With eFaas mobile My Info, you can view key information about yourself from government registers.
TRACK PERSONAL INFOMRATION SHARING: With eFaas consent management system, grant and revoke consent during authentication and track and manage personal information shared to various service providers.
INBOX: Receive messages, notifications, and alerts in one inbox from different public and private agencies.
BIOMETRIC VERIFICATION: Verify your identity with just a quick selfie using the eFaas mobile and web app biometric self-verification feature.
HOW TO CREATE YOUR NATIONAL DIGITAL IDENTITY?
• Step 1: Create your eFaas at efaas.gov.mv 
• Step 2: Install the eFaas app and login with your eFaas credentials
• Step 3: Verify it’s you with face verification and setup your personal 6-digit PIN code
• Step 4: Your National Digital Identity is now ready! QR Code scan and One-Tap Login is now enabled and protected with your fingerprint, face or 6-digit PIN code.
FEEDBACK:
What can we do to improve your experience?
For feedback or questions, please email us at helpdesk@mds.gov.mv You can also reach us at 1551.
eFaas is brought to you by the Maldives Digital Service.
SOLUTIONS TO COMMON ISSUES:
• During face verification if you are getting error “"Sorry, we couldn't verify your identity." please make sure you are in a well-lit area and your face is fully angled to the camera. If issue persist, please call MDS Helpdesk 1551.
• “Login request expired” error – Please ensure your device date and time is current.

bluejetty:00079999:ios.summary: Vigor Solitaire is an Exclusive Classic Solitaire Game for Senior Citizens. With large cards and an eye-friendly easy-to-use interface, this game is the best way to play the CLASSIC card game you know and love for FREE, offline and online!
bluejetty:00079999:ios.description:
Vigor Solitaire is an Exclusive Classic Solitaire Game for Senior Citizens. With large cards and an eye-friendly easy-to-use interface, this game is the best way to play the CLASSIC card game you know and love for FREE, offline and online!
The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years, classic Solitaire, also known as Patience, now goes wherever you do. Vigor Solitaire is the ideal app for the best casual gaming experience that will help you recharge your batteries and sharpen your mind!
How to Play:
Just tap or drag cards to arrange them in descending order with alternating number, colors and suits. When you can, move cards to the foundation to sort all suits from Ace to King. Only a King or a pile starting with a King can be placed in an empty space on the Solitaire Tableau. You can play it your way, with a 1 card or 3 card draw, and choose between classic or Vegas scoring.
Exclusive Features:
- Classic Solitaire: staying true to the original gameplay
- Unlimited deck of cards: There are always a new patience solitaire card game to play
- Large Card Design: Our solitaire game features large, easily readable font sizes to alleviate the strain caused by small numbers
- Fun daily challenges: Win a gift simply for showing up
- Draw one card at a time for relax, or draw three for challenge
- Unlimited free hints and free undos to help you in the card game
- Various backgrounds and card decks for a personalized experience
- Custom Settings: Choose between portrait or landscape mode and select from a range of styles
- Rewards for Every Game: Earn points every time you play to unlock free rewards
- Leaderboards & Statistics: See how you stack up against other players, or try to beat your own high score
Vigor Solitaire offers seniors a game tailored to their unique preferences. Download Vigor Solitaire and start your amazing solitaire adventure now!

User friendly design

NEW & POWERFUL NETWORK TOOLS:
----------------------------------------
 REAL-TIME INTERNET SPEED TEST
• Test your Download speed, Upload speed, Latency (Ping), and Jitter in seconds.
• Live speedometer gauge with dynamic real-time performance indicators.
• Detailed test history tracking to monitor your ISP performance over time.
• Performance grade ratings for 4K streaming, online gaming, and video calls.
WHO'S ON MY WI-FI? (DEVICE SCANNER)

• Spot unauthorized intruder devices and safeguard your network privacy.
WI-FI SIGNAL METER & DEAD ZONE FINDER
• Measure real-time signal strength (dBm) and latency stability across every room.
• Locate Wi-Fi dead zones, interference, and weak spots in your home or office.
• Room-by-room signal recording to optimize router and mesh node placement.

• Test and compare response times across top global DNS providers: Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google DNS (8.8.8.8), OpenDNS, Quad9, and CleanBrowsing.
• Identify the fastest DNS server for your location to speed up browsing and gaming.

• Comprehensive security audit of your router and network gateway.
• Scan critical ports (HTTP 80, HTTPS 443, SSH 22, FTP 21, Telnet 23, DNS 53).
• Receive overall system health status and actionable security recommendations.
PING TEST & LATENCY DIAGNOSTICS
• Continuous ICMP ping monitoring to any custom host or IP address.
• Real-time latency chart displaying Min, Avg, and Max response times with 0% packet loss tracking.
WI-FI QR CODE SCANNER & GENERATOR
• Generate stylish Wi-Fi QR codes with customizable security types (WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP).
• Scan any Wi-Fi QR code with your camera to view credentials and connect in one tap.
 INTERACTIVE iOS HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• Beautiful iOS WidgetKit widgets for your Home Screen.
• View live connected Wi-Fi SSID, IP address, and status indicator at a glance.
• One-tap quick action buttons to launch Speed Test or Device Scanner instantly.

bluejetty:00014385:ios.summary: Line2 is the most affordable, reliable & simple way to set up a second phone number and connect anywhere! Get a second line & access unlimited calls, text & voicemail features. It’s time for a better way to communicate - Line2 is your call
bluejetty:00014385:ios.description:
Line2 is the most affordable, reliable & simple way to set up a second phone number and connect anywhere! Get a second line & access unlimited calls, text & voicemail features. It’s time for a better way to communicate - Line2 is your call and text app solution.
Your personal phone number should stay personal. Line2 makes it simple to screen and block calls to maintain your privacy with robust features that help you say goodbye to annoying spam calls. Keep your second phone number safe with Line2’s premier communications system that allows you to receive and make calls worry-free.
Line2 is more than just a calling app. Line2 provides unlimited text and group messaging, making it the robust calling and texting app you need. Set up a second phone number and message friends and loved ones wherever you are. Line2 offers WiFi texting, so you can receive messages without eating up your mobile data. Line2 is the easiest way to set up local or vanity numbers to stay connected anytime, anywhere with a new number.
Line2 is your calling and texting app for private and convenient phone calls and texts from anywhere. Download the simplest texting and calling app today and start connecting.
LINE2 FEATURES
Privacy First
- Call screening to detect if a phone call is spam or not
- Call blocking means not worrying about unwanted numbers reaching your phone
- With caller ID you can safely know who is calling you
Set Up a Second Phone Number
- Manage a second phone number with Line2’s features that make creating one (or many!) easy
- Create a vanity number, texting number, or second line with Line2
- Add multiple phone numbers to your device and receive or make phone calls from anywhere
Local and Vanity Phone Numbers
- Our calling and texting app lets you create localized and vanity phone numbers- Export your existing phone number to Line2 to keep all of your communication in one place
- Set up a new number to connect wherever you are heading next
Unlimited Text and Call App
-Enjoy unlimited texting and calling on Line2
- Unlimited VoIP calls and text across the United States and Canada
No Cellular Data Needed
- VoIP technology lets you make and receive calls and texts from anywhere, at any time
- Say goodbye to cellular data expenses with Line2’s WiFi calls
- Enjoy WiFi texting and never worry about extra SMS and MMS costs again
Calling App That Does More
- Access your new number’s voicemail and contacts from your smartphone, tablet or computer
- Call recording lets you record calls automatically to help keep track of important conversations
- Use call forwarding so you never miss a call
- Group messaging and private texting are at your fingertips with Line2
Get unlimited texting and calling with Line2 when you sign up for one of our plans.
Questions? We’re here to help at http://help.line2.com or tap Settings -> Help from within the app.
Note: Your cellular provider may prohibit or restrict VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) on their network. It’s your responsibility to check with your cellular provider about their VoIP functionality, and any additional charges it may incur. Line2 is not responsible for any additional cellular charges that may occur as a result of using the Line2 service.
Business/Work users who send SMS/MMS to U.S. numbers must complete a registration process after purchase, as required by U.S. mobile carriers. Business messages sent from unregistered numbers may be subject to non-delivery by mobile carriers. Line2 does not provide refunds or credits due to issues with messaging from unregistered numbers. Please visit https://try.line2.com/10dlc/mobile/faq/.
Privacy Policy: https://www.line2.com/privacy/
End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00175030:ios.summary: Poppo Live is a global interactive platform designed for real-time content exploration and authentic self-expression. Join a global digital ecosystem designed for sharing and discovering diverse creative content. Through real-time streaming
bluejetty:00175030:ios.description:
Poppo Live is a global interactive platform designed for real-time content exploration and authentic self-expression. Join a global digital ecosystem designed for sharing and discovering diverse creative content. Through real-time streaming technology, topic-based interactive rooms, and high-quality short videos, Poppo Live empowers you to explore global trends and engage with an interest-based community in a space where every creative moment is recognized.
- Discover Global Talent & Creativity
Explore a diverse array of talented performers and creative minds from across the globe.
Interactive Streaming: Enter real-time streaming rooms to experience stable real-time content and engage in digital interactions.
Interest-Based Discovery: Discover creators who share your passions, from music and cultural arts to lifestyle storytelling.
Structured Content Environment: Whether you are looking to explore new skills or enjoy a creative environment, there is always a welcoming space for you.
- Immersive Multi-User Interactions
Experience the power of collective engagement through our versatile real-time communication features.
Multi-User Rooms: Join topic-based voice and video rooms for group discussions and content participation.
Content-Driven Engagement: Participate in community-driven initiatives and engage with interest-based groups who value quality interaction.
- Share Your Highlights: Short Videos & Square
Everyone has a perspective worth sharing. Use our platform to showcase your skills through high-quality short-form content.
Capture & Share: Use the Square and Video modules to publish engaging short videos and photos of your creative experiences and talents.
Digital Portfolio: From artistic hobbies to creative highlights, document your journey and engage with a global content community who shares your interests.
Explore Global Trends: Stay in tune with trending topics and explore content that reflects diverse cultural perspectives.
- Regional Events & Creative Activities
Experience a dynamic community that celebrates local interests and global creativity. We host a variety of real-time activities designed to resonate with your region.
Tailored Local Events: Participate in specially curated activities that celebrate the traditions, interests, and culture of your specific region.
Diverse Creative Showcases: Join a wide range of community events that provide the perfect stage for you to showcase your professional skills.
- Personalize Your Creative Identity
Your journey on Poppo Live is about being yourself. We provide a suite of creative tools to help you craft a digital presence that reflects your unique personality.
Expressive Recognition: Unlock a variety of expressive badges, profile frames, and entrance effects to showcase your active participation.
Authentic Self-Expression: We celebrate diversity. Customize your aesthetic and share your perspective in a respectful and inclusive environment.
- Community Standards & Safety Excellence
Poppo Live is dedicated to maintaining a high-quality environment defined by integrity and mutual respect. We enforce a zero-tolerance policy against objectionable content and harassment:
24/7 Professional Moderation: Our dedicated safety team operates 24/7 to review content and act on reports within 24 hours to ensure a positive atmosphere.
User Empowerment: We provide intuitive reporting and blocking tools within the app, empowering you to manage your interactions and maintain personal boundaries.
Safety Compliance: By joining Poppo Live, you agree to our Terms of Service and End User License Agreement (EULA). We are committed to providing a safe, secure experience for every user.
- Support & Stay Connected
We are constantly evolving to provide you with a high-quality experience.
Official Website: https://www.poppolive.com/
Support Email: official@poppolive.com

bluejetty:00141350:ios.summary:
Meet Capy, Your diet best friend! Capy Diet is a calorie counter pet that helps you build a better relationship with food. Simply log your meals, and coach Capy will give you healthy and personalized food suggestions.
THE CUTEST DIET EVER
bluejetty:00141350:ios.description:
Meet Capy, Your diet best friend! Capy Diet is a calorie counter pet that helps you build a better relationship with food. Simply log your meals, and coach Capy will give you healthy and personalized food suggestions.
THE CUTEST DIET EVER
Capy is your adorable capybara pet who helps you track your food intake, macros, and calories, and build a good relationship with food. By taking care of Capy, you’re also taking care of yourself. Choose from a wide variety of personalized eating plans tailored just for you, whether you're focusing on improving eating habits, or achieving weight-loss goals, with cutting-edge features like AI scanner and instant meal feedback!
WHY CAPY DIET?
Fun Calorie Tracking, Not Boring Numbers
Track calories, macros, and nutrients in a low-pressure, intuitive way. Capy helps you eat better without judgment—just like a friend. Our calorie AI gives instant food suggestions and guidance, personalized to your goals.
Designed for Real-Life Wellness
Whether you're working through binge eating, exploring intuitive eating, or managing an eating disorder, Capy is here to support you. Track your BMI, log your meals, and explore scientifically backed methods to maintain a healthy calorie deficit.
Your Capybara Grows With You
Every healthy choice you make helps your virtual capybara grow! Unlock fun clothes, furniture, and mini-games. Keep motivated with positive feedback and cozy home upgrades that reward your progress.
Join Capy Town & Play Together
Invite friends to Capy Town and share encouragement through daily gifts and challenges. Like Parrot Pal and Dr Cal, Capy makes health social, supportive, and fun.
Customize Your Capy Style
From quirky outfits to stylish home decor, personalize your Capy experience while staying committed to your goals. Celebrate your progress with unique rewards as you track meals and lose weight the fun way.
FOOD & NUTRITION YOU CAN TRUST
Smart Food Logging Made Easy
Log meals in seconds with a vast nutrition database powered by FatSecret. Automatically calculate macros, calories, and your daily nutrient balance.
Track Your Progress
Visualize your weight changes, meal history, and fitness streaks. With built-in macro planning and BMI tracking, you'll stay focused and motivated every step of the way.
Personalized Plans
Choose weekly goals that match your vibe—intuitive eating, macro tracking, or low-fat/high-protein meal plans. Capy is more than a calorie app—it's your wellness partner.
DOWNLOAD NOW
Get Capy Diet, the gamified calorie counter and virtual pet that turns healthy eating into an adventure. Build better eating habits and track calories with your capybara companion! Powered by AI and inspired by tools like Personify Health, Hume Health, Capy offers a playful and effective way to reach your wellness goals. From tracking calories to improving your binge eating habits, Capy makes every health goal fun and interactive. Enjoy a fresh take on calorie counting and food tracking. Take the first step towards healthier habits with your new best friend, Capy the capybara! Let's go!
*Requires a subscription to access food logging features.
• Terms of service: https://www.capydiet.com/page/terms
• End user license agreement: https://www.capydiet.com/page/eula
• Privacy policy: https://www.capydiet.com/page/privacy-policy
• Powered by fatsecret nutrition API (www.fatsecret.com)

Build your
bluejetty:00078182:ios.description:
Real habits don't need perfection. They need the right system.
MyRoutine is designed for routines you can sustain — at your own pace, through busy days, bad days, and everything in between.
Structure that feels good, not strict.
Build your day around 'when' you naturally do things, not just clock times.
Check off habits with your favorite emojis. Track your mood alongside your routines. Take a rest day without losing your streak.
Whether you have 3 habits or 30, MyRoutine keeps everything visible at a glance — like a spreadsheet, but one you'll actually enjoy opening.
#Designed for real life
1. ADHD-friendly. Deeply customizable. Quietly beautiful.
■ Your habits, your way
- Connect habits to situations, not just times ("when I wake up" not "7:00 AM")
- Rest a habit without marking it failed
- Daily, weekly, or custom repeat patterns
- Ideal for busy lives: works great for parents, pet owners, plant lovers, and anyone juggling multiple responsibilities
■ Track mood alongside your routines
- Mood tracking is a habit too — log your score, feelings, and diary entries in one place
- View mood score graphs and a monthly journal overview
- No need for a separate mood tracking app
■ See your progress clearly
- Green Light system: know at a glance if your day is on track
- Daily, weekly, and monthly stats
- Stay motivated with Badges and Stamps along the way
- Monthly reports and mood journals, all in one place
■ Stay on track, your way
- Widgets and reminders that fit your schedule (especially helpful for ADHD)
- Customize how you check off habits — your favorite emojis, your own view
- 19 languages supported
- Works across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac
■ Connect with fellow routiners
- Browse others' routines for inspiration
- Connect with friends to stay accountable
MyRoutine was built with care, for anyone trying to make good habits a natural part of life 
— not a source of stress. We hope it helps you build a day that feels like yours.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at : official@minding.today

Quran Pak is the only app that offers the most beautiful Arabic Quran text (proofread by a Muslim scholar 'alim), in the elegant font used in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh region that you will find on a mobile device. It includes Urdu Tafsir Usmani (in Nastaliq font) which beautifies your life with the blessing of reading, listening to, and understanding the Quran on the go. 
اس منفرد قرآن پاک ایپ میں انڈیا، پاکستان، بنگلادیش میں پڑھا جانے والا خوبصورت قرانی خط، مکمل تفسیر عثمانی، اردو ترجمہ نستعلیق کتابت فانٹ کے ساتھ موجود ہے۔ اب آپ اپنی موبائل ڈیوائس میں کسی بھی وقت اور کسی بھی جگہ قرآن پڑھنے اور سننے کے علاوہ سمجھ بھی سکتے ہیں۔ 
● World famous reciters (Sheikh Abdul Basit, Sheikh As Sudays & As Shraym, Mishari Rashid, Saad Al Ghamdi, Abu Bakr Shatry, Sheikh Ahmed Ajmi, Sheikh Al-Huzaifi, Sheikh Mahir-al-Muayqali, Sheikh Minshawi, Sheikh Ayub, Khalil Husari, Mahmood AlBana, Salah Bukhatir & Sheikh Basfar). (Only 1st Juz/para audio by Sheikh As Sudays & As Shraym in free version). 
دنیا بھر کے مشہور قاریوں کی تلاوت (شیخ عبدالباسط، شیخ سدیس و شریم، مشاری راشد، سعد غامدی، ابوبکر شاطری، شیخ احمد اعجمی، شیخ ہذیفی، شیخ ماھر معیقلی، شیخ منشاوی، شیخ ایوب، خلیل حصری، محمود البانا، صالح بوخاطر، اور شیخ بصفر)۔ (فری ورژن میں شیخ سدیس و شریم کی پہلے پارہ کی تلاوت شامل ہے)۔ 
● Worldwide Prayer Times clock with Azan/Adhan alarm options. Supports different prayer time calculation methods. Qibla direction. Ramadan Sehar/Iftar times
نماز کے اوقات، قبلہ کا تعین، رمضان روزہ سحری افطار کے اوقات
● Four Urdu translations (For 1st Juz/para only in free version): Mutfi Mahmood Hasan, Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanvi, Maulana Ahmed Ali Lahori, Maulana Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari along with the specially featured Urdu Tafsir Usmani (juz 1 only for free version). Full version has four English translations (Pickthal, Dr. Mohsin, Mahmood & Yusuf Ali) and eighteen language translations (Bengali, Bosnian, Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Malayalam, Malaysian, Norwegian, Persian, Russian, Sindhi, Swedish, Turkish, Urdu, Uyghur, Uzbek). 
چار اردو ترجمے: شیخ الہند مفتی محمود الحسن، مولانا اشرف علی تھانوی، مولانا احمد علی لاہوری، مولانا فتح محمد جالندرھی) اور شیخ الاسلام حضرت مولانا شبیر احمد عثمانی کی معروف تفسیر عثمانی۔ چار انگریزی ترجمے اور اٹھارہ مختلف زبانوں کے ترجمے شامل ہیں (فری ورژن میں پہلا پارہ)۔ 
● Option to display any translation and Tafsir along with full Arabic text in hi-resolution, retina graphics in both portrait and landscape viewing. Option to display side by side Urdu translation. Supports pinch/zoom feature for changing font size. 
اعلی ترین ریٹینا گرافکس، چھوٹا بڑا کرنے کی سہولت، قرانی متن، اردو ترجمہ، تفسیر ساتھ ساتھ دیکھیے۔
● Highly advanced “Search” feature that can help with searching any word (search exact word, affixes or all roots) in the Arabic text, any of the translations & tafsir. (Full version shows the name of the sura in the search feature along with the option to select that aya or word that has been searched). 
جدید تلاش کی خصوصیت، کوئی بھی لفظ یہ اس کا حصہ یہ اس کی جڑ آسانی سے تلاش کریں۔ عربی متن، اردو ترجمہ اور تفسیر میں سرچ کریں۔
● Advanced audio options to help with memorization (repetition of ayah, Surah, number of repetitions, interval, and recitation speed). 
قرآن حفظ کرنے میں آسانی کے لیے آڈیو تکرار کے آپشنز۔ آڈیو تلاوت کی رفتار کم زیادہ کرنے کی سہولت۔
● Bookmarking of Aya, translation and Tafsir (supports iCloud synchronization that helps your bookmarks stay up to date on all your iOS devices). Up to three bookmark in the free version. 
بک مارک نشان کرنے کی سہولت۔ ایی کلاوڈ کے ذریعے آپ کے ایی فون اور ایی پیڈ میں ہم آہنگی۔
● Urdu translation audio for Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari 
اردو ترجمہ کی آڈیو۔
● Localized user interface in English and Urdu. 
● Quranic Aya and word highlighting during recitation. 
● Social media sharing. Ability to share selected aya via email, twitter & facebook

bluejetty:00157697:ios.description:
Do you realize just how important your sleep is?
How would life be if you had more energy throughout the day? How would you feel if you could actually get enough sleep, and that the sleep you got was the best quality it can be. Do you have problems waking up painlessly? Most people struggle with problems that can be fixed simply by improving their sleep…
The best sleep of your life is waiting... Join Quest!
---
Sleep is not just about rest – it's a crucial biological process that affects every aspect of your health. From strengthening your immune system to consolidating memories and regulating emotions, quality sleep is the foundation of a healthy life. Research shows that consistently poor sleep can increase your risk of various health conditions, including heart disease, diabetes, and depression.
Many people don't realize that their daily habits could be sabotaging their sleep quality. Simple things like exposure to blue light from devices before bedtime, irregular sleep schedules, or even the temperature of your bedroom can significantly impact how well you rest at night. By making small but meaningful adjustments to your routine, you can transform your sleep experience.
The science behind sleep is fascinating – during deep sleep, your body repairs tissues, builds bone and muscle, and strengthens your immune system. Your brain also processes the day's information, forming new neural connections that help with learning and memory retention. This is why a good night's sleep can make you feel not just refreshed, but actually smarter and more capable.
Important Notice:
Quest does not provide medical advice. All recommendations should be considered suggestions only. Please consult healthcare professionals and conduct personal research before making significant lifestyle changes!!

bluejetty:00122359:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00122359:ios.description:
Get Motivated. Get Results. Get Rewarded with Yes.Fit!
Yes.Fit is a flexible, fun, and highly motivating virtual fitness platform designed for everyone, everywhere. Whether you love running, walking, cycling, or swimming, you can complete challenges at your own pace. Fit your workouts seamlessly into your lifestyle, stay consistent, and unlock incredible, real-life rewards like stunning medals, custom coins, and premium fitness apparel!
Turn your daily exercise into a global adventure. With hundreds of themed virtual races and fitness challenges, you can select events based on distance, theme, or location to become a virtual world traveler. 
KEY FITNESS FEATURES
• Track All Activity: Monitor your daily steps, active workouts, distance, duration, and calories burned using our integrated pedometer or your favorite wearable device.
• Diverse Workouts: Tap into tailored features supporting key exercise types including Running, Walking, Cycling, and Swimming.
• Goal Setting & Streaks: Stay accountable by creating personal plans, setting daily fitness goals, and maintaining workout streaks.
• Social Community: Sync up with friends, build custom groups, check real-time step leaderboards, and share your milestones on our inspiring in-app social feed.
SEAMLESS HEALTHKIT & TRACKER SYNCING
Using an external wearable device is entirely optional! You can track your miles by entering your data manually. If you prefer automated tracking, we seamlessly integrate with the Apple Health app (HealthKit) and Apple Watch to automatically sync your steps, distance, and calories. 
We also support connections with top fitness platforms:
• Apple Health & Apple Watch
• Google Health
• Garmin
• Strava
• Under Armour
JOIN THE VIP CLUB
Enjoy a flexible pay-as-you-go experience, or upgrade to a premium VIP Membership to unlock maximum perks:
• Free domestic shipping on your physical rewards
• Unlimited access to over 100 Digital Races & 75+ Fitness Challenges
• Exclusive 20% discount on rewards and official merchandise
• Entry to the private VIP Club Group featuring exclusive contests and prizes
• Early access to major virtual events and VIP-only challenges
• Loyalty Points Program: Earn "Motion Tokens" to redeem for extra rewards
• Advanced data reports and deeper fitness insights
BECOME PART OF THE FAMILY
Yes.Fit is more than a pedometer or an activity log—we are a global fitness family. Join over 700,000 virtual racers who cheer each other on daily. Get the positive support system you need to shift your mindset, transform your body, and elevate your health journey. 
Step up your fitness goals today. Get active, lose weight, and feel amazing!
Terms of Use: https://yes.fit/terms
Privacy Policy: https://yes.fit/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00016787:ios.description:
** Apple Game of the Year 2014 **
** Winner of Apple Design Award 2014 **
In Monument Valley you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.
Monument Valley is a surreal exploration through fantastical architecture and impossible geometry. Guide the silent princess Ida through mysterious monuments, uncovering hidden paths, unfolding optical illusions and outsmarting the enigmatic Crow People.
Ida's Dream now available.
Forgotten Shores: Eight new chapters of adventure and illusion available now as a separate purchase.
Buy or download Monument Valley now and you’ll also get our fully animated iMessage sticker pack, including 5 stickers exclusive to players! Only available on iOS10 and above.
=======
"This might be the most beautiful iPad game of 2014" - Wired
"Brilliant design... stayed with me like a dream I didn't want to forget" 9/10 - Polygon
"The most sublime hour my iPad has ever given me... and the value of such a thing is incalculable" - Kotaku
"Monument Valley stuns with its serenity... each screen is a work of art" - Huffington Post
"Almost impossibly gorgeous... a feast for your senses" 5/5 - Touch Arcade
=======
BEAUTIFUL
Inspired by minimalist 3D design, optical illusions and palaces and temples from around the world, every monument is a unique, hand-crafted world to explore.
EASY TO USE
Twist and drag to reshape the world and help Ida to explore. Designed to be easy for everyone to pick up, enjoy and complete.
SOUND
Audio reacts to your manipulation of the world to provide a surreal and beautiful soundscape. Best experienced with headphones.
iCloud
Synchronize your game across all your devices.
** Monument Valley is designed for iPhone 4 and above. It is NOT compatible with iPod Touch 4th Generation.

bluejetty:00087012:ios.summary:
Jam combines calendars, to do and shopping lists in one spot so everyone in the family can get on the same page and do their fair share. Jam is here to streamline, simplify, and support modern family life as we know it. 
Key Features:
Cal
bluejetty:00087012:ios.description:
Jam combines calendars, to do and shopping lists in one spot so everyone in the family can get on the same page and do their fair share. Jam is here to streamline, simplify, and support modern family life as we know it. 
Key Features:
Calendars Designed for Busy Families
- Create events for one, some or all family members easily so you can see who needs to go where
- Build a list of what you’ll need to bring (and delegate!)
- Assign drivers for events.
- Connect your Google or Apple calendars.
- Share with kids and caregivers (without granting access to everything). 
Personal + Family To Do Lists 
- Create color-coded lists for yourself or to share with the whole family.
- Assign due dates 
- Delegate tasks to family members.
- Gentle reminders to keep action items from falling through the cracks. 
Shared Shopping Lists 
- Create multiple lists for different grocery stores, birthday lists, holiday shopping, the options are endless
- Easy to add to: Everyone in the family can add items as they notice things that are needed
- Copy lists or items you’ve liked in the past with just a click. 
- Add descriptions and links
Jam On It 
- Why bother entering events on your calendar when Jam will do it for you? Forward any email or message straight to Jam and the events will auto-populate into your calendar. 
Works for school emails, party invitations, extracurricular schedules, travel information and more
Who’s Driving 
- Tag who is driving your kids to events between family members, caretakers and friends
- Drivers automatically have the event put in their calendar with a reminder so a pick up or drop off is never missed!
Smart Reminders
- Set custom reminders ahead of events
- Get reminders for you and your family members for time-sensitive To Do list items that must get done
After the 30-day free trial period, you will be charged through your Apple account, and renewal will be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. To disable automatic renewal at any time, access your App Store settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00034946:ios.name: Neetho - Date The Telugu Way
bluejetty:00034946:ios.summary: Neetho is India’s first vernacular dating app that is designed to bring Telugu residing in and outside India closer for one common reason — finding long-lasting relationships. The word 'neetho' translates to 'with you' in Telugu. So, the ap
bluejetty:00034946:ios.description:
Neetho is India’s first vernacular dating app that is designed to bring Telugu residing in and outside India closer for one common reason — finding long-lasting relationships. The word 'neetho' translates to 'with you' in Telugu. So, the app is designed to offer high-intent dating experience that is culturally aligned with Telugu needs. Neetho's unique approach to appreciating sensitivities has made it one of the fastest-growing vernacular apps; and as we see it, Neetho is soon going to replace the need for matrimonial platforms out there for the Telugu community.
Features:
Setting Cultural Preferences: Neetho appreciates the Telugu cultural nuances and choices that define Telugu ways of living. We have preference features on the app that is tailor-made to make sure you find what you're looking for in a person. And to help you in breaking the ice, we host a gamut of Telugu pop culture references that you can use in your profile answers — from food to music and cinema.
Send 'Notes': Neetho 'Notes' serves as the best kind of conversation starter which lets users express their interest in someone they really like, by writing to them directly. For all we know, you are just an effort away from the right match.
Video Calls: If texts weren't enough, we thought about taking the dating game a notch further. Neetho offers users the feature of making video calls, provided both users have consented to it.
Neetho 'Premium': Neetho 'Premium' is an in-app paid feature through which you can send more requests and notes, see who sent you requests and unlock more preferences.
Neetho 'Select': Neetho 'Select' is our latest paid feature with everything you need to find your perfect match quickly. Get all the goodness of 'Premium', plus access profiles in the 'Select' tab with more preferences and send unlimited Notes. If you are looking to meet someone who admires Mahesh Babu as much as you do, Neetho is absolutely the dating app you should be on. 
In-app Purchases:
Neetho Notes
Neetho Premium
Neetho Select
---------------------------------------------
If you choose to purchase Neetho Premium or Neetho Select, payment will be charged to your Apple account. These subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription through the App Store settings post-purchase. Neetho Premium comes in a 1-week pack for $3.99, a 1-month pack for $10.99, a 3-month pack for $17.49, and a 6-month pack for $28.99, while Neetho Select comes in a 1-week pack for $9.99, a 1-month pack for $14.99, a 3-month pack for $24.99, and a 6-month pack for $34.99. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of current subscriptions is allowed during the active subscription period.
For more information, please visit these links - 
Terms: https://www.neetho.in/terms-conditions.html
Privacy: https://www.neetho.in/privacy-policy.html
Support: https://neetho.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

bluejetty:00062551:ios.summary:
***** Parents‘ Choice Awards winner 
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in pre
bluejetty:00062551:ios.description:
***** Parents‘ Choice Awards winner 
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
***** APProved by Famigo!!! 
Lay the basics of your child’s literacy skills with this colorful, mysterious island full of phonics sounds. Children learn and have fun tracing letters, recognizing letter sounds, matching letters, and identifying beginning sounds. Embark on the adventure with adorable Abby the Monkey and her train to discover the secret of this island! 
================== 
The best introduction to phonics reading system! 
================== 
* NOW EVEN BETTER — FABULOUS NEW ACTIVITIES ADDED! 
CHILDREN LEARN TO: 
* Recognize letter sounds 
* Trace uppercase and lowercase letters 
* Match letters 
* Recognize a variety of animals 
* Identify beginning sounds 
PURCHASING THIS APPLICATION (FULL VERSION ONLY), YOU CAN EXPECT TO GET: 
----- 
* 90 animal pictures situated in colorful sceneries, accompanied by authentic animal sounds and phonetic sounds of the animals’ initial letters 
* 21 wonderful, professionally illustrated sceneries 
* 7 alphabet phonetic sectors divided according to the Montessori methodology 
* A series of fun mini-games 
* Reward stickers 
* Surprise upon completion of all levels 
* Easy-to-use, child-friendly interface 
* High-quality audio spoken by a professional voice-over actress 
* Friendly, encouraging environment 
----- 
Hello everyone! Are you up to an adventure? I am Abby the Monkey, the friend you know from a highly-successful application series by 22learn, and I have prepared one for you! If you want to EXPLORE a strange animal island and LEARN PHONETIC LETTER SOUNDS, you shouldn’t wait a minute, and come with me!!! 
But first let me tell you a story…. 
****************************************** 
Once upon a time, there was an island, an island of indescribable beauty and magnificence. There found a shelter the animals small and large, slimy and furry, savage and tame—all protected from evil hunters and curious eyes, supplied with food from the bountiful earth. Each year, a special event was held, when one, and only one, person from the whole humankind was selected and transported to the island (blinded, to preserve the island’s secrecy) to appreciate its beauty and spread the word about it, so that the island would never be forgotten. 
The legend has it, that deep inside the rocky hill on the island, a treasure is kept. Yet, no one knows its secret anymore because the last humankind representative had enraged the animals on the island, and since then, the animals decided never to invite anyone again, and the island got lost in time and space. 
All that remains from our knowledge is that through the whole island, a very special train goes. The train has a mind of its own and likes it when the passengers’ names start from certain sounds! It is said, that if someone was ever capable to fulfill all the train’s wishes, the train would transport the lucky being deep inside the rocks and reveal the island’s precious treasure! 
****************************************** 
But, you are asking, what does all this have to do with me, monkey Abby? Well, imagine what happened to me just recently! I was flying around with my plane when, out of the blue, the storm hit and my plane got lost! 
And now, I am on this weird island that looks exactly like the legendary Phonics Island I told you about! Wohoo, how exciting! But I need someone to help me with all the strange tasks the train asks me to do! Do you want to be the one who will help me, and discover the island’s treasure together with me? 
Thank you for your purchase!

bluejetty:00070926:ios.description:
Be the best Policeman in Town and protect the city from Thieves! Visit a Police Station and have fun for hours! 7+ locations that you can explore: jail, station, training ground, garage and more. 300+ accessories to customize your characters! Have fun for hours!
If you have ever dreamed of being a cop, you will love our game. Be a good police officer and create stories you like. Dress up as a cop, detective and even a crook. Start the adventure and visit a police station.
EXPLORE A POLICE STATION
Use the police station's camera to take pictures and print them out with the printer. Just like real life! Ring the alarm bells: tap on the alarms or sirens if someone has escaped the prison! Try to catch them fast and return them to jail! Don't let the prisoner escape the prison by digging the tunnel or finding the other exits!
Explore jail, police dog training ground, drive a helicopter, fix a police car in the garage, find a photo room for thief identification and other offices. Enjoy My Town Police Game for kids and be the best cop ever! Cop games were never more fun!
BE A GOOD COP – CATCH THIEVES
Catch thieves and protect him escape the prison? Find the hidden hole and do not let him get into the sewer! Make sure you ruin ther Escape plan! My Town Police Station offers so much fun for all kids who like thieves and police games! Thieves can hide and dress in many costumes, but be a good cop, spot them and catch them!
TRAIN A POLICE DOG
Do thieves want to escape the prison? Not if the police dog is there! Take a police dog to a training ground. Make sure he is trained well. There are many obstacles he needs to pass to get a police badge. You can customize the dog in different costumes and add many accessories. Take a dog to a patrol and catch all robbers and thieves.
HOP INTO A POLICE CAR
Ring the police siren and hop into your police car. Stop a robbery. Make sure that the bad guys don't escape the prison! Take the Helicopter from the My Town Police Station and monitor the city! Find and return the stolen things. Roleplay cop games and be the best cop for your citizens. Check out the police car, take it for a ride and help the detective solve mysteries. Fun is everywhere!
MY TOWN POLICE STATION:
• Many NEW characters to roleplay!
• Meet many characters: Policeman, Policewoman, Detective, Crook and more
• 7+ locations to Explore: Jail, Training yard, the Safe, Garage and more
• Train the police dog at the training yard
• 300+ accessories and outfits
• Do not let thieves escape the prison, fix the police car, drive a Helicopter
• Be a ROBOCOP! Dress up and be the best Policeman in the city
• Enjoy cop games with friends on the same device
• Stay tuned for more games
BE A ROBOCOP!
Find a robocop suit and enjoy cop games all day! Fight crime and be the best police officer in town! Download the cop games for free, take the police car, and prevent thieves from escaping the prison! Be a cop that the city needs!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Police game for kids aged 4-12. My Town Police game is safe even when parents are not home.
ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES
My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your kids worldwide. My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com.

Want to create unique and eye-catching phone cases that reflect your personal style?
Our engaging casual game will take you on a journey into the world of design and self-expression.The game offers an extensive palette of colors, beautiful patterns, and an array of charming accessories. You have a set of tools at your disposal to experiment with design combinations and create your own phone covers.
~~~~ Features ~~~~
• Amazing customization options
Personalize a phone case with unique colors, patterns, keychains and stickers. 
• Engaging gameplay
Enjoy the interactivity of our game. Items on the case will react when you move the phone.
• Relax and have fun
Perfect for taking a break from everyday worries and just enjoying the game.
~ Create unique design with aerosol cans
Choose the shape of the phone cover, then apply glue and paint it with spray cans. Experiment with different colors and create a cool gradient by using a hair dryer, but watch out not to overheat it! Lastly, add patterns, stickers, and a funky keychain to personalize your case.
~ Restore old phone covers from damage
In this mini-game you can repair and restore damaged phone cases. Fix cracks, remove dirt and other damages. Our games offer a meditative experience, providing an opportunity to relax while cleaning and repairing phone cases.
~ Add color and draw cool pictures
Use stencils to add detailed patterns and make your phone case even more beautiful. Pick a case with funny ears, color it and choose a cute stencil (butterfly, flowers, candy and more) to transfer the image onto the case step by step. 
Unleash your creativity and create the most interesting and alluring phone cases!
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. Mini-game "Stencil".
2. Mini-game "Pop-it".
3. Mini-game "Make your own phone case".
4. Mini-game "Floating glitter".
5. 250 units of content.
6. Feature "Save photos".
7. Feature "Skip a step".
Make your life easier with premium access:

- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00070010:ios.description:
Tressette Più – Card games
Play Tressette Più online completely free, your enjoyment is guaranteed! Private messages, chat, monthly trophies, badges, personal statistics and much more awaits you!
Compete for the monthly leaderboards in the multiplayer mode or play for fun and meet new people in social mode. You can also challenge your friends… or single play against the PC.
Don´t wait any longer and join our fun community with millions of players from all over the world.
Develop your playing ability even more with:
• 100 skill levels
• 3 levels of difficulty to play against the computer AI
• 27 badges to win
• Playing statistics to check on your progress
• Offline mode to play when you're travelling or stuck with no reception
If you are more the competitive type:
• Play the ranked multiplayer mode (up to 4 players)
• Compete for the monthly and global leaderboards and win one of our trophies
If you'd like to be more social, take advantage of:
• Private matches against friends (up to 4 players)
• Private messages with other players
• Chat to communicate with your game opponents
• Rooms to find new opponents and meet new people from all over the world
• Invites to challenge your Facebook® friends
• Internal friendships system within the game
Personalise your game freely with:
• 11 packs of Italian regional cards
• Different game boards and card types
Play from your smartphone or tablet, in horizontal or vertical mode, Tressette Più will win you over with its speed, fluidity and precision. You will feel as if you are playing with your friends! Start playing directly without even registering or log in via Facebook®, Google® or email to play the social and competitive matches!
Remember that you can play Tressette Più completely free.
Subscription: "Upgrade to Gold" to remove ads and unlock other features like uploading your own profile pic and having access to an unlimited number of private messages, friends, blocked users and recent opponent list.
Length: 1 week or 1 month
Price: €1,49/week or €3,99/month
The payment will be charged directly to your Google account once the purchase is confirmed. It will be up for renewal within 24h prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of renewal. The auto-renewal can be turned off in your account settings after its first purchase.
Give our Gold subscription a try with our 7 day free trial.
These prices are for EU customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Visit www.spaghetti-interactive.it and find all our other fun classic Italian and international card games: scopa, briscola, burraco, scopone, traversone, rubamazzo, assopiglia and scala40. You will also find board games like checkers and chess!
Join our Facebook community on https://www.facebook.com/spaghettiinteractive
For support, email supporto@spaghetti-interactive.it
Terms and conditions: https://www.tressettepiu.it/terms_conditions.html
Privacy policy: https://www.tressettepiu.it/privacy.html

bluejetty:00073503:ios.description:
Dear rednote villagers,
Welcome to the community. this is a place where people share their life and connect with each other. Millions of users share their daily life here, from favorite music to fashion looks, from cooking recipe to home decor, from travel tips to their beloved cats and dogs. We welcome you to share everything about your life and connect with the villiagers around the global.
To better navigate here, we’d like to share some CORE VALUES of rednote with you:
Authenticity: Everyone is unique and has their own life story, so just be yourself here. You can think of us as friends and feel free to share your daily life or special moments. We believe authenticity builds trust, what you share may also help or inspire others, so we encourage you to be genuine and friendly in your posts.
Helpfulness:For years, rednote villagers have been sharing billions of life experience and tips and helped countless people they’ve never met. The world is big, but we believe people share more similarities in their life than they thought. We encourage you to share your unique experiences here and inspire another "you" somewhere on this planet.
Inclusivity: We believe the world is a "global village", where people from different regions and cultures can connect and communicate. In this welcoming community. We hope everyone respects each other and embraces differences in values, cultures, and perspectives. We encourage you to show your likes and appreciation for other villagers. We believe that kindness will always be returned, and you’ll feel the warmth and love from others.
Have fun and happy sharing! 
Lots of love from the rednote team

bluejetty:00023913:ios.summary:

Choose your Legion, collect cards and build a deck of Space Marines aided by Mechanicum
bluejetty:00023913:ios.description:
It’s Space Marine versus Space Marine in The Horus Heresy: Legions, a new strategy card game (TCG) where your actions and card battles change the game.
Choose your Legion, collect cards and build a deck of Space Marines aided by Mechanicum, Imperial Army or Chaos to rule the galaxy. Join a guild, discuss card strategy and decks, and fight in PvP Arena card battles. Choose a side in epic Faction Wars to influence which new cards, cosmetics and Legions are added to the game. Enter The Horus Heresy, one of the richest settings in the Warhammer 40,000 universe by Games Workshop, for the first time as an online TCG card game.
IT’S THE 31ST MILLENNIUM: Uncover the epic origins of Warhammer 40,000. Traitor Legions wage war against the Emperor. Play an epic solo campaign, ranked PvP and multiplayer PvP Arena through the most tragic civil war in Warhammer 40,000 history.
TCG LEGIONS AT WAR: Expand your card collection as new Space Marine Legions from the Warhammer 40,000 lore are added, each with a unique card list and strategy. The battlefield keeps changing in this strategy card game!
TRUE CARD BATTLE SKILL: Battle in epic Ranked PvP and Sealed Deck Arena. Build a deck from your card collection or master each Arena Sealed Deck using cards you don’t own yet.
GUILD WARS: Coordinate with your guild in epic PvP Arena card battles that determine the evolution of this TCG strategy card game. Discuss card strategy and try your deck in friendly card duels. Battle other guilds and grow your card collection!
COMMUNITY: Join other players on Twitter and Facebook and Discord. Chat about your favourite Legion, strategy, decks and favourite cards in this epic TCG.

What can I do in Nordea's mobile banking app
· In the Overv
bluejetty:00119414:ios.description:
The Mobile Banking app is a convenient way to access your finances on the go. You can check your accounts, block and reorder payment cards, personalise the overview tab and more.
What can I do in Nordea's mobile banking app
· In the Overview tab, you can see all your finances in one place. Add, hide or re-arrange the content on the overview page to personalise your experience.
· Conveniently transfer money between your accounts or to a friend.
· Quickly pay your physical invoices by scanning them with your camera.
· Access your digital wallet - Pay with Apple Pay.
· Log on securely with BankID, Nordea ID, your biometrics or personal code. The choice is yours.
Convenient access to your cards
· If you forget your PIN code for one of your cards, you can view it directly in the app.
· If you lose one of your cards, you can temporarily or permanently block it. If you permanently block a card, a new card will be sent automatically to your registered address.
· You can minimize the risk of fraud by limiting which geographical areas your credit card can be used and by restricting usage for online shopping.
Savings and investments:
· You can now get an overview of your savings and investments inside the app. In addition, you can buy stocks and funds, create saving plans and see how your investments are developing.
Mortgage
· You can see your many mortgage details and can increase monthly deductions and apply for exemption from repayment. Convenient mortgage handling.
A deeper insight into your finances
· In the Insights tab, you can see your income and expenditure at a glance. Gain deeper insights by viewing where and how you spend your income with the app's categorisation feature.
· You can add other banks to the app so you can have all your finances in one place.
We are here for you.
At Nordea, we put our customer's needs first. Contact us directly through the app, either through our online chat, phone, or book an online meeting with an advisor.
The mobile banking app is designed with you in mind.
We continuously update the app based on your feedback, to ensure you have the best experience possible. Leave us a review or send feedback directly through the app. We would love to hear your thoughts.

bluejetty:00128676:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and given it a facelift! This faster native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”

https://www.medianewsgroup.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00063434:ios.description:
Test your Gin Rummy skills in our version of the popular two-player card game! 
Today, Gin Rummy is one of the most popular forms of Rummy. As with all games in the Rummy family, you must try to arrange your cards into sets and sequences and lay them down as quickly as possible. 
The aim of the game for the two players is to get groups of the same values or sequences in the same suits to be able to knock. You should pay attention to what cards you lay and which ones your opponent selects. The player with the lower value after laying wins the round. The winner of the entire game is the player who reaches the target points of 100
Card games are a big part of life. Whether you’re young, old, or middle-aged, you’ve probably played some card games in your life. The thing with card games is that you might love them, or you might absolutely hate them. But you have to respect them due to the amount of skill it takes to become proficient in any type of card game. So Gin Rummy is obviously here to stay.
The basic game strategy of Gin Rummy is to improve one's hand by forming melds and eliminating deadwood. 
It is probably the greatest of the traditional rummy games, and one of the best traditional card game for two players. The game is great because of its relatively long hand time, it's incredibly high skill ceiling, and its low skill floor.
Gin Rummy, you can only master, appreciate and enjoy the game well when you start playing the game. It's worth a shot, and may be worth a place in your catalog of lifestyle games.
Download Gin Rummy today for endless hours of fun!!!
==== Gin Rummy Features ====
1. Create Private Room and Invite Friends and Family
2. Play your way to top the Leaderboards!
3. All time classic family Gin Rummy game
4. Hollywood Gin, Straight Gin and Oklahoma Gin 
Hope you enjoy our version of Gin Rummy! Do rate and review our game.

bluejetty:00062338:ios.description:
A.: »10/10: The best app for kanji learning!«
B.: »Carefully crafted app. Very nice done.« 
F.: »Near-perfect app, 100% free and no ads!«
S.: »I'm using this app every day, it's addicting. I have tried a lot of other apps, but this one I love!.« 
K.: »A blessing to those wanting to master Japanese reading and writing.«
S.: »I've tried so many apps & this BY FAR is the best one.«
J.: »Free, no ads, no weird data collection, no in-app purchases; and the app itself is great too.«
Kanji Teacher knows not only all the 2,136 jōyō kanjis and their readings, but also the 10,000 most common Japanese words and how to pronounce them. This unique combination enables you to learn the Kun- and On-readings of the kanjis and apply and test what you have learnt straight away: both how to read a word and how to write a word you know. 
Kanji Teacher has more features you'll love:
○ Practise your writing with Kanji Teacher! Every stroke is analysed: do the position, direction and order match up with the correct way of writing? Kanji Teacher helps you out with hints to begin with, but as you progress further you’ll be on your own.
○ Kanji Teacher is also a Kana teacher: learn how to read and write Hiragana and Katakana. 
○ Kanji Teacher comes with two dedicated tutors – one for Kana and one for Kanji. These tutors will accompany you through the entire learning process, explain Kanji Teacher, introduce new characters, present the tests and celebrate achievements.
○ Kanji Teacher uses multiple choice so you can be sure that you really do know the answer. And it also compiles the possible answers intelligently, ensuring that they all make sense and are similar to the correct answer, because Kanji Teacher is a teacher after all – it's strict, but this helps you learn more quickly.
○ Kanji Teacher uses a Leitner system so you can learn easy kanjis quickly and focus on the more difficult ones.
○ Kanji Teacher comes with around 6,000 sample sentences: Around 8,000 tests have been created based on these sentences, where the corresponding Kanji is omitted and has to be found. In addition you will find tests for 127 important geographical locations in Japan and over 1,300 Japanese first names and surnames together with their reading.
○ Kanjis can be grouped by JLPT level and school year and, most importantly, you can switch between both views without losing what you have already done. 
○ Up to eight learning lists can be managed, searched, and the Kanas, Kanjis and radicals assigned. Additionally, Kanjis detailed in sections of popular textbooks and Kanken test groups can be assigned to one of these lists.

S.: »I'm using this app every day, it's addicting. I have tried a lot of other apps, but this one I love!.« 
K.: »A blessing to those wanting to master Japanese reading and writing.«
S.: »I've tried so many apps & this BY FAR is the best one.«
J.: »Free, no ads, no weird data collection, no in-app purchases; and the app itself is great too.«

Kanji Teacher knows not only all the 2,136 jōyō kanjis and their readings, but also the 10,000 most common Japanese words and how to pronounce them. This unique combination enables you to learn the Kun- and On-readings of the kanjis and apply and test what you have learnt straight away: both how to read a word and how to write a word you know. 

Kanji Teacher has more features you'll love:

○ Practise your writing with Kanji Teacher! Every stroke is analysed: do the position, direction and order match up with the correct way of writing? Kanji Teacher helps you out with hints to begin with, but as you progress further you’ll be on your own.

○ Kanji Teacher is also a Kana teacher: learn how to read and write Hiragana and Katakana. 

○ Kanji Teacher comes with two dedicated tutors – one for Kana and one for Kanji. These tutors will accompany you through the entire learning process, explain Kanji Teacher, introduce new characters, present the tests and celebrate achievements.

○ Kanji Teacher uses multiple choice so you can be sure that you really do know the answer. And it also compiles the possible answers intelligently, ensuring that they all make sense and are similar to the correct answer, because Kanji Teacher is a teacher after all – it's strict, but this helps you learn more quickly.

○ Kanji Teacher uses a Leitner system so you can learn easy kanjis quickly and focus on the more difficult ones.

○ Kanji Teacher comes with around 6,000 sample sentences: Around 8,000 tests have been created based on these sentences, where the corresponding Kanji is omitted and has to be found. In addition you will find tests for 127 important geographical locations in Japan and over 1,300 Japanese first names and surnames together with their reading.

○ Kanjis can be grouped by JLPT level and school year and, most importantly, you can switch between both views without losing what you have already done. 

○ Up to eight learning lists can be managed, searched, and the Kanas, Kanjis and radicals assigned. Additionally, Kanjis detailed in sections of popular textbooks and Kanken test groups can be assigned to one of these lists.

○ You can choose the correct answer, check it and move on to the next question with just one touch of the screen, which speeds up your learning and progress.

○ Kanji Teacher comes with Ulrike's Mnemonics, which were provided by Joy o' Kanji,a site where you can find playful, informative, photo-filled essays about each of the 2,136 Joyo Kanji.

bluejetty:00145353:ios.name: DroidPass: Password Manager
bluejetty:00145353:ios.summary:
Fill your passwords instead of typing them, use passkeys where sites support them, and keep everything in a vault that opens with your Master PIN.
DroidPass is a straightforward password manager for iPhone and iPad. Passwords, passkeys, cr
bluejetty:00145353:ios.description:
Fill your passwords instead of typing them, use passkeys where sites support them, and keep everything in a vault that opens with your Master PIN.
DroidPass is a straightforward password manager for iPhone and iPad. Passwords, passkeys, credit cards, bank details, Wi-Fi logins, secure notes and contacts all live in one place, encrypted with AES-256 on your device.
SIGN IN WITHOUT A PASSWORD
Use passkeys to sign in without a password on supported sites and apps. Save a passkey once, then sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or your Master PIN — there is nothing to type and nothing to remember. Your passkeys sit beside your passwords in the same vault and sync with it; a new device opens them once you enter your Secret Key from your Emergency Kit.
MOVING FROM ANOTHER PASSWORD MANAGER
Bring your saved logins straight across from another password manager, with no file to export and no CSV to clean up. Your other app hands them over through the system transfer sheet and DroidPass files them in your vault. This needs iOS 26 or later, and the app you are leaving has to support credential transfer — if it does not, you can still import a CSV file the usual way.
FILL PASSWORDS. SKIP THE TYPING.
Switch DroidPass on as an AutoFill provider — from inside the app on iOS 18 and later, or in Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords. Your saved logins then appear above the keyboard in apps and in Safari. Tap one, confirm with Face ID or your device passcode, and DroidPass fills in the username and the password. When a login has a two-factor secret saved with it, DroidPass can hand over the current one-time code the same way.
EVERYTHING IN ONE VAULT
• Passwords and passkeys, organized by category, tag and favorites
• Credit cards, bank details and Wi-Fi passwords
• Secure notes and contacts
• A built-in two-factor authenticator with live, rotating codes
• A password generator that builds long, unguessable passwords in one tap
• A password audit that flags weak, reused and short passwords
• Search that finds an entry in a second
BUILT TO STAY PRIVATE
• AES-256 encryption, applied on your device before anything is stored
• A Master PIN that opens the vault — set it once, keep it to yourself
• Works offline: your vault opens without a connection
• No ads, and no tracking of what you save
WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT'S PRO
Free: six items in total across every category, one of which can be a two-factor code, plus the password generator and AutoFill.
DroidPass Pro: unlimited items, unlimited two-factor codes, Face ID / Touch ID unlock for the app itself, the password audit, custom themes, and priority support.
Get your logins out of your head and into DroidPass.
— — —
DroidPass Pro (Subscription)
Subscription length and price are shown in the app before you buy. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://droidpass.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://droidpass.app/terms
