bluejetty:00183738:ios.description:
Paytm Money is your all-in-one wealth-tech platform, offering a diverse range of investment products, including IPOs, equities, futures & options (F&O), bonds, mutual funds, and more. Our user-friendly interface ensures a seamless onboarding experience, allowing you to start your investment journey with ease. As a robust wealth tech platform, we provide:
 • Seamless Onboarding: Experience a hassle-free onboarding process, enabling you to start your investment journey with ease and confidence.
 • IPO Investing: Seize early investment opportunities with our seamless IPO application process, including the convenience to pre-apply in upcoming IPOs.
 • Equity and Stocks: Invest directly in your preferred companies with real-time data, advanced charts, and personalized watchlists, empowering you to make informed decisions.
 • Futures & Options (F&O): Engage in Futures & Options trading with advanced analytics and an intuitive interface, now including BSE F&O, broadening your trading horizons.
 • Mutual Funds and SIPs: Invest in mutual funds and initiate Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) with ease, benefiting from expert fund management and diversification.
 • Stock SIP: Build wealth systematically with the Stock SIP feature! Invest in your favorite stocks regularly and watch your portfolio grow effortlessly over time.
 • UPI Autopay: Automate your investments effortlessly with UPI Autopay. Set up once, and enjoy seamless SIP payments without any manual intervention!
 • Bonds and Fixed Income Products: Explore a variety of bonds to secure stable returns and diversify your investment portfolio.
 • Margin Trading Facility (MTF): Take advantage of MTFs to increase your purchasing power and take up to 4x positions in the market at a nominal cost.
 • Margin Pledge: Enhance your return on investment by pledging your existing securities to secure margins for trading, optimizing your portfolio's potential.
Our platform is designed to provide a seamless and efficient investment experience, supported by advanced technology and a commitment to transparency. Join millions of satisfied investors and take advantage of our comprehensive suite of investment products to achieve your financial aspirations.
Start your investment journey with Paytm Money today and unlock the potential of smart investing.

bluejetty:00022336:ios.description:
Weather Now – Accurate Forecasts, Doppler Radar Maps & Weather Widgets at a Glance
Be ready for any weather, anywhere.
Weather Now is your complete weather app for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, combining hourly and 14‑day forecasts, real‑time UV Index, Air Quality Index (AQI), customizable Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and a fully interactive 3D Earth globe with live Doppler radar maps.
Check weather instantly with widgets in multiple sizes, view animated Doppler radar maps with precipitation, wind, and storms, or receive real‑time alerts. Weather Now also provides sunrise and sunset times, geomagnetic storm forecasts, and AQI monitoring to help you plan your day better.
Key Features
 • Real‑time weather updates and live conditions for your current location and saved cities
 • Detailed hourly and 14‑day forecasts with charts for temperature, precipitation, wind, and UV Index
 • Air Quality Index (AQI) monitoring with health recommendations
 • Geomagnetic storm alerts and solar activity forecasts
 • Sunrise and sunset times with natural day‑to‑night transitions on the 3D globe
 • Multiple weather widgets for Home Screen and Lock Screen: small, medium, and large
 • Interactive widgets with detailed charts for temperature, UV Index, AQI, wind, precipitation, and hourly forecasts
 • Fully interactive 3D Earth globe with dynamic weather layers and animated clouds
 • High‑resolution Doppler radar maps with overlays for temperature, wind, pressure, clouds, and precipitation
 • Fast and intuitive city search with smart suggestions
 • Apple Watch support with live complications for weather, UV Index, AQI, and alerts
 • Instant severe weather alerts, storm tracking, and temperature shift warnings
 • Customizable notifications for morning and evening weather, AQI, and geomagnetic activity
Why Users Choose Weather Now
 • Beautiful 3D globe with live weather systems and animated cloud cover
 • Professional‑grade Doppler radar and forecast maps for everyday use
 • Real‑time UV Index, AQI, and geomagnetic storm data for better outdoor safety
 • Widgets and Apple Watch complications let you see forecasts, AQI, and UV Index instantly
 • Perfect for daily planning, travel, hiking, photography, and storm tracking
 • Family Sharing support – share your Pro subscription with your family
Go Pro and Unlock Even More
 • Access multiple professional data providers for maximum forecast accuracy
 • Save and manage unlimited favorite locations
 • Advanced morning and evening notifications with weather, AQI, UV Index, and alerts
 • More widget sizes, layouts, and forecast data with extended charts for precise planning
 • Full access to advanced weather map layers: real‑time Doppler radar, wind, pressure, clouds, and precipitation
 • Pro‑level storm tracking with geomagnetic storm data
Subscription Options
 • 1 week – ideal for short‑term use
 • 1 year with a 7‑day free trial – best value
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your account settings. Unused portions are non‑refundable. Family Sharing is supported with Pro.
Terms of Use: https://weathernow.app/term-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://weathernow.app/privacy.html

bluejetty:00160767:ios.description:
SFX Calc gives students and engineers a familiar handheld-style scientific calculator on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. From quick arithmetic to statistics and engineering formulas, it keeps advanced calculations in a practical, customizable layout.
FEATURES
• Scientific functions: trigonometric, hyperbolic, logarithmic, exponential, power, and root
• Engineering notation with SI prefixes
• Fraction and percentage calculations
• Linear regression and statistical calculations
• Binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal modes
• Fixed-constant calculations for repeated operations
• One persistent memory plus 10 temporary memory registers
• Built-in formulas, including the quadratic formula, standard normal distribution probabilities, and engineering calculations
• Configurable 10- or 13-digit display and exponent formats
• Copy and paste support for faster workflows
• A familiar keypad with customizable layout options
Ideal for coursework, laboratories, electronics, mathematics, science, and everyday engineering work.

bluejetty:00107978:android.description:
Welcome to the adrenaline-packed world of Turbo 84, the ultimate endless runner arcade game where you drive a car, dodge obstacles, and collect power-ups as you speed down the road. Strap yourself in and get ready for a wild ride!
📱In Turbo 84, you'll take on the role of a daring driver on a never-ending adventure. Your mission is simple: drive as far as you can while avoiding the obstacles in your path. With every passing second, your speed increases, adding to the excitement and challenge of the game.
As you race down the road, you'll need to use your quick reflexes and expert driving skills to avoid obstacles such as other cars, barriers, and even traffic cones. But don't worry - you're not alone on this journey. Collect tokens, tickets, and power-ups along the way to help you in your quest. These power-ups include speed boosts and magnets to help you collect tokens more easily.
👑 One of the most exciting aspects of Turbo 84 is the ability to customize your car with different colors and styles to truly make Turbo 84 your own.
But the fun doesn't stop there. Turbo 84 offers exciting game modes to keep you entertained for hours on end. Challenge yourself in Classic mode, where you'll face an endless stream of obstacles and earn points for every inch you drive. Or, from time to time, you can enter tournaments vs. the rest of the world!
⭐️ With stunning graphics, awesome music, and addictive gameplay, Turbo 84 is the ultimate mobile gaming experience. Whether you're a casual gamer or a seasoned pro, you won't be able to put this game down.
Controls are intuitive and gameplay is easy-to-learn. Turbo 84 is perfect for gamers of all ages. And with its endless replay value, you'll never get tired of driving down the road and pushing your high score to the limit.
😍 But Turbo 84 isn't just a game - it's an experience. With its retro-inspired graphics and fast-paced action, it's sure to transport you back to the golden age of arcade gaming. And with its seamless integration with social media, you can easily share your high scores with friends and compete for bragging rights.
So if you're looking for a thrilling new mobile gaming experience, look no further than Turbo 84. With its endless excitement and addictive gameplay, it's sure to become your new go-to game.
⚡So what are you waiting for? Turbo 84 is the ultimate endless runner arcade game for mobile devices. With its fast-paced action, intuitive controls, and addictive gameplay, it's sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Download Turbo 84 today and join the ranks of the ultimate driving champions!

Because of this, we believe Turbo 84 is the best racing game in the world and we are confident you will enjoy it! Meet Bubbu, your new virtual pet. He is a cute, emotional and adorable cat who loves to eat tasty food, take selfies, visit friends and dancing. Have fun at Bubbu’s home and find out other secrets about your pet’s life. He will surprise you for sure! Explore Bubbu's colorful world with many adventurous activities!
• Bubbu is waiting for you to be fed, dressed, cuddled and bathed. This lovely cat needs your love and attention every day, so take good care of him from morning to midnight. In one word, make sure your kitty is always happy and smiling, but never hungry, sleepy, sick or bored.
• Take Bubbu to the animal hospital and test your vet skills as a doctor in a modern pet clinic. Visit also spa and beauty salon, there are so many fun jobs you can do! Enjoy beauty and nail salon games like pet manicure, face care and funny bathing, or just go to the cosmetic dentist with your cat. Bring joy to your fluffy pet with stylish makeovers from head to toe in the hair salon where you can become a makeup and hairstyle expert.
• Take Bubbu to the funky showroom and dress him up stylishly. Also don’t forget to make a dream house for your lovely pet. Customize and decorate it with an awesome collection of furniture to make kitty’s home beautiful, warm and cozy.
• Over 30 fun mini-games will provide you with food or with coins to buy items for your virtual cat. Have fun playing Catcher, Cat Connect, Find the Cat, 2048, Paint the Cat, Jump, Pop Balloons, Cheese Builder, Fish Ninja, Cat Sings, Nightmare, Jumping Cat, Diver, Stick Ninja, etc. 
• Spin the wheel of fortune every day, complete daily challenges and explore friends' houses to get some extra rewards. 
• Bubbu's land offers you tons of activities. Customize Bubbu’s house into a lovely cat villa. You can grow organic food in the garden and milk a cow everyday as a real farmer. Pimp your cool car and get ready for a hill ride. Take a walk to the seaside and fish or go diving. You can go to the city or even travel into space by rocket to defend your planet against alien invasion. Play football and basketball, pass across sea rocks or climb up the tree. Try to change between day and night and enjoy listening to the sounds of mother nature.
If you have ever wanted your own cat, this game is a perfect choice for you. So, come on, what is keeping you? Adopt Bubbu and make him the happiest virtual cat ever!
This game is free to play but certain in-game items and features, also some of those mentioned in game description, may require payment via in-app purchases which cost real money. Please check your device settings for more detailed options regarding in-app purchases.
Monthly Subscription: This subscription automatically renews every month unless you turn it off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
The game contains advertising for Bubadu’s products or some third parties which will redirect users to our or third-party site or app.
This game is certified compliant with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) by FTC approved COPPA safe harbor PRIVO. If you would like to know more about the measures we have in place for protecting child privacy please see our policies here: https://bubadu.com/privacy-policy.shtml .
Terms of service: https://bubadu.com/tos.shtml

bluejetty:00064690:ios.description:
The new CHROME FCU mobile app is simple and secure banking at your fingertips.
The new CHROME FCU mobile app is simple and secure banking at your fingertips.
Easily see your balances, deposit checks, transfer funds, pay bills, send money to friends, find surcharge free ATMs and more!
FEATURES
24/7: Manage your account anywhere, anytime.
Deposit: Deposit checks quickly with the snap of a photo.
Secure: Our new app lets you use a PIN to quickly and securely access your account.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Find: Locate surcharge free ATMs, CHROME branches and CHROME Drive dealerships.
Connect: Contact the CHROME Care team easily from the app.
Big Picture: Link other accounts to see all of your financial information in one place for on-the-go organization.
Stay organized: Add tags and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on CHROME Digital Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. If your device goes missing CHROME can remotely block device access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the CHROME FCU Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a CHROME FCU Digital Banking user. If you currently use our CHROME 24 Digital Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00183998:ios.description:
GoBankFFB is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with GoBankFFB :
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the GoBankFFB app, you must be enrolled as a GoBankFFB digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00015459:ios.description:
Need to memorize text quickly and remember it long-term? 
Memorize By Heart is a memory training and study app designed to help you learn speeches, poems, verses, scripts, lines, lyrics, language text, and exam material by heart using proven memorization techniques.
Used by students, professionals, actors, and language learners, Memorize By Heart helps you learn faster, practice recall, and improve long-term memory
MEMORIZE AND LEARN ANY TEXT BY:
1. Building familiarity
• Gradually remove letters and words to strengthen memory
• Tap to reveal hidden parts of the text
• Listen to the text using text-to-speech while studying
2. Strengthening recall
• Unscramble sentences and words
• Fill-in-the-blank memory exercises
• Type the first letter of each word
• Practice active recall instead of passive reading
3. Testing your memory
• Multiple-choice memory quizzes
• Type the text from memory
• Recite the entire text by heart
• Custom games like "Run Scene" for different memorization types
Get instant feedback on accuracy!
SPACED REPETITION FOR LONG-TERM MEMORY 
Review your memorized text at scientifically optimized intervals using reminders and notifications. Spaced repetition helps you remember more while spending less total study time.
MEMORIZE TOGETHER WITH GROUPS 
Study and memorize as a group to stay motivated and accountable.
• Share memorizations with friends, classmates, or teams 
• See each other’s memorization progress and recall accuracy 
• Track rankings and compare progress within your group 
Creating a group requires Premium, but anyone can join a group for free.
CHUNKING (Premium)
Break long texts into smaller sections to make memorization easier and more effective.
EASY TEXT INPUT
• Copy and paste any text
• Download popular memorization content
• Scan images with text (Premium)
• Upload PDF files (Premium)
MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Practice memorization and recall in multiple languages — ideal for language learning and pronunciation practice.
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Unlimited memorizations
• Cloud sync across devices
• Advanced memory and recall exercises
• Group creation for shared memorization
• Scan images, take photos of text, or upload files for instant memorization
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchase.
Terms of Service: https://memorizebyheart.app/terms-and-conditions 
Privacy Policy: https://memorizebyheart.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00061809:ios.description:
Everything reps love about Salesforce—without the admin work.
Trusted by field reps to optimize routes, find new leads, and close deals — all in one AI-powered field sales app.
Veloxy is built exclusively for Salesforce users. Whether you're a rep in the field or a sales leader managing territories, Veloxy gives you everything you need to automate CRM, prioritize leads, and sell smarter from anywhere.
WHY FIELD REPS & MANAGERS LOVE VELOXY
• Automate Salesforce Data Entry: Zero-touch syncing of your calls, emails, meetings, and notes.
• Prioritize Hot Leads Automatically: Our AI surfaces who’s most likely to convert — no guesswork.
• Optimize Routes in Seconds: Visit more customers with fewer miles and less planning.
• Engage at the Right Time: Track opens, clicks, and forwards. Strike while interest is highest.
• Prospect with Geolocation: Tap once to find nearby leads and drop in between meetings.
BUILT FOR SALESFORCE. NO EXTRA SETUP.
Veloxy integrates natively with Salesforce CRM in seconds — no complex setup, connectors, or duplicate systems. It’s a privacy-first sales platform that meets the strictest enterprise security and compliance standards — trusted by teams using Apple, Gmail, and Outlook.
Your data stays accurate, your reps stay in the field, and your pipeline stays full.
THE COMPLETE FIELD SALES PLATFORM
• Call, email, and prospect from your iPhone
• View leads, accounts and opportunities on a live map
• Create and launch mobile-friendly email campaigns
• Get instant nudges, reminders, and guided selling steps
• Track performance with mobile dashboards and analytics
• Make calls and use voice-to-text to log notes into Salesforce
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT IN 1-3 MONTHS
• 300% increase in sales funnel
• 150% increase in new sales growth
• 600 hours saved per rep annually
• 2X sales productivity across teams
• 50% less time spent on CRM admin
WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS ARE SAYING
“Veloxy makes my job so much easier and allows me to be more productive. Auto logging emails and calls to Salesforce saves me time and allows me to focus on what I do best.”
 — William C., Regional Sales Manager
“Veloxy makes my job easier! It is a great software platform that allows you to increase your sales funnel day-to-day. The map view shows all of my accounts with Geo-pins that are nearby. This maximizs my time by visiting with as many accounts as I can and not having to drive all over the place.”
 — Sophea R., Territory Manager
Find 200+ 5-Star Reviews on G2 and Salesforce AppExchange
BUILT FOR EVERY INDUSTRY
Whether you're in telecommunications, logistics, medical devices, industrial equipment, or software, Veloxy adapts to your sales motion — including field sales, outside sales and door-to-door sales. Our AI adjusts to your sales cycle, helping you uncover new leads, shorten time-to-close, and build trust faster.
IMPROVE CRM ADOPTION ACROSS YOUR TEAM
Veloxy doesn’t just help reps — it empowers sales leaders. By automating CRM data capture and syncing activity across email, phone, and calendar, you’ll finally have clean, accurate Salesforce data you can rely on. This drives better forecasting, territory planning, and coaching.
DESIGNED FOR BUSY TEAMS
• Lightning-fast setup with zero IT involvement
• Works across mobile and desktop
• Access Veloxy anywhere, anytime, on any device
• Compatible with Gmail, Outlook, and your Salesforce instance
• Enterprise-grade reliability and support
ENTERPRISE-GRADE SECURITY & PRIVACY
Veloxy is certified and compliant with leading platforms and enterprise standards. For a full description of our Security Details and Privacy Policy (including our Salesforce, Apple, Gmail, and Outlook certifications), please see our security center at veloxy.io/security.
Built for reps. Trusted by teams. Powered by AI.
Sell Easier. Sell Faster. Sell Smarter.
Download Veloxy and start transforming how you sell today.

bluejetty:00015926:ios.description:
iRollerCoaster is the ultimate roller coaster and theme park simulation game! 
Ride perfectly engineered realistic roller coaster tracks all over the world. You can compete in real-time online competitions for high scores. You can have fun in your own summer theme park whenever you want!
Ride world-class tracks in the following cities:
- Monte Carlo, Monaco
- Orlando, Florida
- Williamsburg, Virginia
- Cape Town, South Africa
- London, England
- Zermatt, Switzerland
- Las Vegas, Nevada
- Los Angeles, California
- Canberra, Australia
- Paris, France
- Tokyo, Japan
- Atlantic City, New Jersey
*Warning* iRollerCoaster does not feature emergency brakes, backup generators, or shutoff valves. The cars could spiral out of control; causing nausea, whiplash, or sudden death.
Our roller coasters use a realistic lift hill cable to pull the cars to the peak of the track. Once the cars reach the peak, potential energy accumulated by the rise in height transfers to kinetic energy and the cars race downwards. Some energy is lost to friction on the track itself. The effects of gravity are taken into account to increase speed and accelerations accurately. You can experience several G's of force on high-speed turns!
iRollerCoaster features:
- Advanced OpenGL graphics
- Music and sound effects
- Online high score database
- High-resolution textures
- Compatible with iPad Pro
iRollerCoaster is brought to you by the makers of World Winter Games and iBASEjump.
Have fun with iRollerCoaster and enjoy the ride!

bluejetty:00062634:ios.description:
The Pickup Company - Off your hands, into the loopx
Take the confusion and hassle out of recycling and become a recycling champion… from home!
With ReSmart Pickup, we come to your door to collect your soft plastics, textiles, e-waste and a long list of other tricky-to-recycle items like batteries, light bulbs, aluminium coffee capsules, polystyrene, toys, books and many more!
This service is available in a growing number of selected councils - we'll tell you straight away if you are eligible.
Use the app to:
Book your Pickup in one tap
Receive notifications
Change or cancel your pickup date super easily
Track how much you've diverted from landfill
How does ReSmart Pickup work?
Book your Pickup - Want to recycle regularly? Select our "set and forget" option: we'll come monthly and you'll never worry about those tricky-to-recycle items again!
Pack your bags - Use any shopping bag you have at home (those green, blue, yellow supermarket bags? Perfect!). Just fill them with everything we collect.
Leave it out - On pickup day, leave your bag at your front door in a safe spot. You don't even need to be home!
We handle the rest - Your local driver collects your bag, empties it, returns it for next time, then sorts everything and ensures your valuable resources get recycled properly.
Get your items off your hands and into the loop - recycling made easy.
Get Australia's most downloaded recycling app and join the circular economy revolution now!RetryClaude can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.

bluejetty:00027073:ios.name: 13:20:Sync
bluejetty:00027073:ios.summary:
This app puts the Mayan Dreamspell Calendar in your pocket! "13:20:Sync makes it so much easier to understand and integrate the calendar into every day life. Highly recommend it." 
The Mayan People have described, in breathtaking precision
bluejetty:00027073:ios.description:
This app puts the Mayan Dreamspell Calendar in your pocket! "13:20:Sync makes it so much easier to understand and integrate the calendar into every day life. Highly recommend it." 
The Mayan People have described, in breathtaking precision, the cycles of both the universe and nature around us. They created a harmonic calendar that is synchronized to all those cycles. Following these cycles can help you get a stronger connection with nature around you and become conscious of your essence.
This app provides a simple way to sync along those cycles, to raise our frequency and give us a new lens to view both our day-to-day and planetary events.
- Did you ever realize that our (Gregorian) calendar is not a harmonic calendar? 
- Did you know that the moon has 13 (not 12!) orbits around the earth in 1 year? 
- Why do we live with this irregular calendar?
- Are you interested in Astrology?
-> All this, and more, is explained carefully in this app. (over 15.000 words on 37 pages) Please note that these text are in English language only.
In the New Time, synchronicity is the norm.
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// 
5 star rating across the world! 
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// 
"Entertaining as well as enlightening" 
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// 
MORE INFO: 
www.1320sync.com 
For the beginner this app is a learning tool because it contains an extensive explanation about Tones and Seals and the synchronizing order of the Mayan Astrology. You may think it's difficult at first but soon you will feel how it all connects. 
"This app is great, and allows easy manipulation of dates. I spent years in books doing in hours what I can now do in seconds."
For the ones who are already familiar with the Mayan Calendar this app is a handy tool to navigate the cycles, and calculate the Combined Kin for any given combination. Furthermore this app can be of great assistance to teach other people about the 13:20 cycles and is used in teachings around the world.
=== FEATURES ===
+ Kin Calendar
This is your main Mayan Dreamspell Calendar Dashboard with all the details you need to stay in sync. Shows the Kin of today by default, and you can calculate the Kin for any other date.
+ Personal Notes
On this new page you can keep your personal notes for the 2 main cycles of time: the Tzolkin cycle of 260 days and the 13 Moon cycle of 365 days. And with the powerful text search function you quickly find your notes.
+ Kin Picker
Select any combination of the 13 Tones and 20 Seals. Top section can scroll to 4 pages with information.
+ Combined Kin Calculator 
Calculate the Combined Kin of any combination of Kin. You can add as many Kin as you like to calculate the Combined Kin for a group of people. 
+ Tzolkin with indication of the GAP day's and Wavespell and more. Tap and hold to select a Kin number directly.
+ Contact Import 
All contacts in your Contacts App will be automatically imported and assigned to the correct Kin. See all your contacts with their Mayan Reading and how you relate to them. 
+ 13 Moon Calendar 
Full integration of 13 Moon Calendar. (doubles as a birthday calendar!) 
+ 13:20 Information 
Lots of information about the theory behind synchronization to help you navigate the Mayan Dreamspell Calendar. The texts provide a clear explanation of the Cycles of Time. (More than 15.000 words on 37 pages) Please note that these text are in English language only.
+ Sharing
On all the 3 main tabs you can share the current selected Galactic Signature using your favorite app. 
# Based on the work of José Argüelles.
# This app was made with permission of and in cooperation with the Foundation for the Law of Time - www.lawoftime.org, 
# Ariel Spilsbury.

On this new page you can keep your personal notes for the 2 main cycles of time: the Tzolkin cycle of 260 days and the 13 Moon cycle of 365 days. And with the powerful text search function you quickly find your notes.

+ Kin Picker
Select any combination of the 13 Tones and 20 Seals. Top section can scroll to 4 pages with information.

+ Combined Kin Calculator 
Calculate the Combined Kin of any combination of Kin. You can add as many Kin as you like to calculate the Combined Kin for a group of people.

All contacts in your Contacts App will be automatically imported and assigned to the correct Kin. See all your contacts with their Mayan Reading and how you relate to them. 

+ 13 Moon Calendar 
Full integration of 13 Moon Calendar. (doubles as a birthday calendar!) 

+ 13:20 Information 
Lots of information about the theory behind synchronization to help you navigate the Mayan Dreamspell Calendar. The texts provide a clear explanation of the Cycles of Time. (More than 15.000 words on 37 pages) Please note that these text are in English language only.

+ Sharing
On all the 3 main tabs you can share the current selected Galactic Signature using your favorite app.

bluejetty:00132031:ios.description:
**OurPact Jr. is the companion app for devices paired to OurPact Parent accounts.** 
Do not install on parent devices. Install OurPact Jr. on your devices you wish to manage.
If you have an OurPact Parent account you can download OurPact Jr. on devices paired to your account. 
OurPact Jr. is a portal for users on a paired device to view their screen time limitations and schedules.
With OurPact Jr. a user is able to see the current status of their screen time limitations. For instance, they can see whether they are currently granted or blocked. They'll also be able to see the duration of their block or when they will have access to their device later. 
OurPact Jr. users can also view not only their daily screen time schedules, but weekly schedules. By tapping into the schedules view, they can see what schedules have been created for that given day and later schedules created throughout the week.

Immersive Experience! Ground, Naval, Aerial—A 3D Action Game Riding Through Battlefields!
You, entrusted with fate and belief by the girls sent into the end-of-the-world scenario!
The time for counterattack has come—guide the girls as an Nexecutor!
Together with the girls, to the sky and the sea!
Stylishly and gracefully ride through the romance of the apocalypse!
Experience the powerful animations and the expansive 3D world to your heart's content!
[Worldview]
In a near future where people fight for their own desires, conflicts are never-ending.
By acquiring the remains of an extraterrestrial lifeform, Noah Technocrats Corporation developed a powerful and expandable tactical exoskeleton known as "Gallal" and built a massive orbital base called "Astral Dome" equipped with super weapons above the equator.
The sky is covered with steel as far as the eye can see, and the land is rife with despair.
Numerous factions united to challenge Noah, resulting in the destruction and desolation of most of the surface. Afterward, each faction developed a new combat weapon called "E.T.E" to replace "Gallal" and formed the "Human Union." Thus began a standoff between humanity and Noah.
...
Meanwhile, in a certain location on the continent, someone was about to visit the independent armed organization directly under the Human Union.
With your arrival, the fate of the world and the girls will begin to unfold...
[Game Overview]
To the sky! To the sea! Fight alongside the girls!
Stand shoulder to shoulder with the girls who pilot the humanoid combat weapon "E.T.E," and fight with your beliefs at stake!
As an Enforcer entrusted with the fate of the girls and the world, dash across land, sea, and air to confront the apocalyptic world!
Ground! Naval! Aerial!
Ride through dynamic battlefields filled with excitement!
Experience thrilling battles across three dynamic arenas—ground, naval, and aerial! Move freely in vast fields and hit-and-run. Witness the majestic scenery expressed in real-time with your own eyes!
Intricately crafted 3D models! Experience hardcore romance!
High-quality modeling with attention to detail. You'll see beautiful 3D models not only in character art but also during battles. Feel the intense impact of strikes and vibrant effect displays as your passionate spirit surges!
Combine diverse skills and seize victory with strategy and command!
Engage in half-real-time battles with a team of four characters. Utilize the characteristics of your mecha and weapons to adapt your strategy to various situations. Control the characters in real-time and break through adversity with your shining moves!
Delivering a fantastical sci-fi world with high-quality graphics and a stellar cast!
High-quality graphic representations built with Unity. Characters come to life in a fantastical, apocalyptic world. Enjoy the charm of uniquely characterized characters voiced by a talented cast!

bluejetty:00154749:android.description:

Account Management

bluejetty:00069584:ios.name: Mozaic Plugin Workshop
bluejetty:00069584:ios.summary:
Create your own MIDI plugins: MIDI filters, generative music tools, basic sequencers, MIDI control panels, chaos experiments... Let your imagination take you places. 
Mozaic runs inside your favorite AU MIDI host, and gives you practical b
bluejetty:00069584:ios.description:
Create your own MIDI plugins: MIDI filters, generative music tools, basic sequencers, MIDI control panels, chaos experiments... Let your imagination take you places. 
Mozaic runs inside your favorite AU MIDI host, and gives you practical building blocks such as LFOs, pre-fab GUI layouts, musical scales, AUv3 support (with AU Parameters, transport events, tempo syncing, etc.), random generators and a super-simple yet powerful script language. Mozaic even offers quick access to your device’s Tilt Sensors for expressive interaction concepts!
The Mozaic Script language is designed from the ground up to be the easiest and most flexible MIDI language on iOS. A language by creatives, for creatives. You’ll only need to write a few lines of script to achieve impressive things - or to create that uber-specific thing that was missing from your MIDI setup.
Check out the Programming Manual on Ruismaker.com to learn about the script language and to get inspiration for awesome scripts of your own.
Mozaic comes with a sizable collection of tutorials and pre-made scripts which you can use out of the box, or which can be a starting point for your own plugin adventures. 
Features in a nutshell:
- Easy to learn Mozaic Script language: easy to learn, easy to read 
- Sample-accurate-everything: the tightest MIDI timing possible
- Built-in script editor with code-completion, syntax hints, etc.
- 5 immediately usable GUI layouts, with knobs, sliders, pads, etc.
- In-depth, helpful programming manual available on Ruismaker.com
- Easy access to LFOs, scales, MIDI I/O, AU parameters, timers
- Supports Sysex, with built-in checksum calculations
- AUv3; so you'll get multi-instance, state-saving, tempo sync and resource efficiency out of the box
Mozaic opens up the world of creative MIDI plugins to anyone willing to put in a few hours and a hot beverage or two.
Practical notes:

bluejetty:00165310:ios.description:
Dive into a thrilling candy gaming journey like never before with Sugar Rush, where you are not just a player, you're the master creator of your own destiny. Step into a magical, candy filled world filled with enemies and challenging obstacles.
As the protagonist of your own adventure, you'll navigate through intricate levels, collecting candy treasures and unlocking new candy challenges at every turn. You have nothing with you but your one and most powerful strength - your sugar speed.
Unleash your inner architect and build your very own candy level masterpieces using our intuitive candy level editor. Craft devious sugar traps, create winding pathways, and customize every candy detail to challenge and amaze your fellow players.
Play, Share, and Challenge: Once you've perfected your creation, it's time to put it to the sugar and candy test. Play your custom sugar levels, hone your skills, and conquer your own candy creations. Then, share your sugar levels with the world.
Game Features 
Level editor: Design intricate candy levels, limited only by your imagination.
Share and Compete:: Challenge friends and players worldwide with your custom candy levels.
Exploration: Experience hundreds of sugar puzzle challenges in varying difficulty levels
Simple Control: Swipe up / down / left / right, and you will dash instantly in that direction.
Free Fun: 100% free to play so everyone can enjoy everything the game has to offer.
Challenging: Prove your mastery of sugar speed by collecting all of the stars. Do you have what it takes?
Beautiful Graphics: Believe it or not, we’ve built our own candy environment engine to make sure the gameplay graphics are realistic and fast, allowing for stunning, colorful effects on all candy devices.
Adaptive System: Making sure you’re always able to proceed, advance, and even skip candy levels if you’d like.
Join the Creative Candy Gaming Revolution: Sugar Rush takes candy gaming to a whole new level by letting you be the creator and the conqueror. With an ever-expanding library of player-generated candy levels, no two candy experiences are the same.
Get ready to challenge your candy mind, showcase your candy creativity, and embark on a maze-building candy adventure like never before. Download Sugar Rush now and discover the limitless possibilities of candy gaming.
In Sugar Rush, your existence revolves around a sugary euphoria that transcends gaming into a saccharine odyssey. As you navigate sugar-infused landscapes, the anticipation of the impending adventure becomes a thrilling dance with destiny. Each step and obstacle overcome builds to the sweet climax of the sugar rush, leaving you yearning for more. Embrace the sugar rush, let it become the rhythm of your candy adventure. Feel it pulse through your virtual veins as you dash, jump, and conquer.
Join the sugar rush revolution and immerse yourself in a wonderland where every candy step is a dance, and every challenge is a prelude to the sugar ecstasy of the sugar rush. Download Sugar Rush now and let the frenzy begin - an experience that will leave you enchanted and craving the next sugar rush adventure.

bluejetty:00075617:ios.description:
Stream live from your iPhone or iPad - broadcast-quality video to any server, platform, or production switcher. No encoder box, no desktop setup required.
Whether you're streaming IRL to Twitch or Kick, covering breaking news in the field, or feeding a remote production over NDI - Larix Broadcaster gives you the tools professional broadcasters rely on.
PROTOCOLS & CODECS
Supports SRT, RTMP/RTMPS, WebRTC WHIP, NDI HX2, RTSP, RIST, and Zixi. Video encoding in H.264 and H.265/HEVC. Audio in AAC or Opus depending on protocol. Multiple simultaneous outputs available (Premium).

bluejetty:00032659:ios.description:
Встановіть застосунок Повітряна тривога, щоб миттєво отримувати сповіщення про повітряну тривогу у вибраному місті чи області України від системи цивільної оборони. 
За правильних налаштувань, застосунок буде голосно сповіщати про тривогу навіть у беззвучному режимі смартфона. Застосунок не потребує реєстрації, не збирає персональні дані або дані про геолокацію.
У застосунку доступні всі області України, а також додано можливість отримувати тривоги лише за обраним районом чи територіальною громадою.
Як працює застосунок: 
1. Оператор обласної державної адміністрації отримує сигнал про повітряну тривогу.
2. Оператор негайно передає інформацію на пульт.
3. Застосунок надсилає тривожне сповіщення користувачам, які обрали відповідну область.
4. Щойно оператор надсилає сигнал про відбій тривоги, користувачі застосунку отримують відповідне сповіщення.
Це єдиний застосунок, що підтримує критичні сповіщення. Це означає, що звук тривоги буде завжди надходити з максимальним рівнем гучності смартфону. Для цього надайте усі відповідні дозволи застосунку після встановлення. Важливо! Критичні сповіщення можна вимкнути в будь-який момент в налаштуваннях застосунку.
Бережіть себе та рідних.

- Swipe-to-Clean: Review and remove unwanted photos, videos, and emails with simple swipe gestures for faster, more effortless cleanup.
- Email Cleanup: Remove spam, promotional, and outdated emails in just a few taps to keep your inbox clean and manageable.
- Contact Organizer: Clean up your address book by removing duplicate and empty contacts effortlessly.

• Efficiency: Save time with smart, automated cleanup tools.

bluejetty:00094807:ios.description:
Biggest rewards ever for the Anniversary Season!
Claim your share of 100 Million Hydra Crystals — and pick your FREE Kinetic Animus SSR!
The new Sprint Server supercharges your journey: 600 Summons, 70 Perfect Lattices, and 8 powerful Anima SSRs — all FREE, zero grind. Plus Xuan Li’s anniversary-exclusive Outfit!
Fresh UI, revamped Main Quest, double drops — level up at lightning speed. The grand [Pyrite Plunder] event is live: rally your Consortium and fight for treasure.
Restart Etheria. It all begins now.
Etheria is an Ethereal Hero Collection RPG . When a devastating global freeze threatens to extinguish human civilization, humanity transfers their consciousness into "Etheria," a virtual world, to preserve their legacy.
Within Etheria, humans coexist with beings known as the Animus, who wield mysterious Anima Powers. Their peaceful coexistence shatters when the "Genesis Virus" emerges, corrupting the Animus and driving them berserk, endangering humanity's survival. In response, the Hyperlinker Union forms to combat this threat.
Take on the role of a Hyperlinker and begin your adventure in Etheria.
[Strategic Combat & Limitless Team Compositions] Etheria evolves classic turn-based combat by incorporating diverse strategic mechanics and sandbox exploration, delivering a next-generation Team RPG experience! Create countless team combinations by synergizing Animus abilities, issue real-time combat commands, and freely control each Animus in battle. Master skill combinations and tactical setups to experience the thrill of overcoming powerful foes through superior strategy.
[Breathtaking 3D Visuals & Cinematic Spectacle] Built in Unreal Engine, Etheria delivers cinematic immersion through lifelike lighting, detailed shadows, and fully rendered real-time scenes. Each character features unique combat animations enhanced by dynamic camera work and dazzling effects, creating spectacular battles without visual clutter or overwhelming effects.
[Strategic PvP Arena Battles] Step into the Arena, where non-stop duels rage day and night! Engage in exhilarating PvP battles amid roaring crowds, showcase your unique strategies to fellow Hyperlinkers, and experience the pure thrill of tactical competition as you pursue your combat dreams!
[Venture into the Threshold] Explore Etheria's rich PvE content, where formidable foes from the Main Quest return in the Threshold, GP Outposts, and Investigations. Team up with your Animus squad to tackle powerful bosses! For those seeking greater challenges, venture into the Ember ruins, where even deadlier and more mysterious adversaries await...
[Forge Your Combat Style] Each Animus features a unique Prowess system with diverse progression paths. Customize their abilities through Shell equipment and nearly a hundred different Ether Module combinations to develop distinct fighting styles and combat approaches. Create specialized builds for your favorite Animus to tackle any battle scenario!
[Discover Extraordinary Allies] Your journey through this virtual metropolis of danger and opportunity won't be lonely! Meet hundreds of unique Animus characters: a dual-wielding Reaper carrying a mighty coffin, a punk genius Hacker, a metropolitan Empress who manipulates Soul Flames... Join forces to confront unknown threats and unveil the mysteries of this futuristic city.

bluejetty:00024228:ios.description:
Voted No. 1 text and source code editor on iPhone/iPad. Simple and fast.
iEditor is a text file and source code editing tool on iPhone and iPad. You can use iEditor to: 
- Create a new text or source code file. 
- Import files from various locations through Document Browser.
- Support Syntax Highlighting for C, Java, HTML files. 
- Edit text based files and source codes. Supported files include: TXT files, C source codes, HTML files, JAVA source codes, log files, Shell scripts, etc.
- Support Search/Replace within a text file.
- Support to export a text based file to a PDF or a JPEG file. 
- Support to Print a file. 
- Support to Email a file.
- Support File Management including: Add/Delete/Rename/Sort files. 
- Support to view many file formats, including: DOC, EXCEL, PPT, PDF, image files, video files, etc.
- Support to open a file in another App. 
- Support to save an image to your Photo Album. 
With its simple interfaces, iEditor provides the easiest way to edit text and source code files on iPhone and iPad.

bluejetty:00093542:ios.description:
Teach your kids financial responsibility and core math concepts with MoneyPrep, an award-winning, parent-approved education program made for kids ages 5-12. Using fun math and money learning games, MoneyPrep is trusted by over 40,000 parents and teachers from around the world as their go-to educational program for kid’s financial literacy. MoneyPrep is a great way to teach important money and math skills that will keep your kid entertained for hours.
• Gold Award Recipient of the prestigious Mom's Choice Awards®
• Winner of the Parents’ Picks Award – Best Product for Elementary Kids (2021)
YOUR KID WILL LEARN:
How to Save, Spend & Budget
• Kids learn the basics of how to save, spend & budget their money wisely with fun and challenging games that will keep your child entertained for hours.
• MoneyPrep teaches kids to have a “think ahead” mindset and how to be financially responsible.
The Value of Money & Math
• Kids will build a positive and healthy relationship with money by learning about its value, where it comes from and how to build responsible spending habits. 
• They’ll also learn how to be a smart consumer and build strong money habits that can last a lifetime. MoneyPrep was designed to help kids retain these skills into adulthood. 
• At the same time, MoneyPrep’s money games reinforce core math skills such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
OTHER FEATURES:
Subscribe and Unlock New Skills & Features
• Purchase a premium subscription* and unlock new skills to teach your kids like entrepreneurship, responsibility and choice, everyday money, and more!
• Gain access to the MoneyPrep virtual store experience where kids will apply their learnings from our games to become a smart consumer
• Get first access to new games and feature releases every month!
Skills Through Learning Games
• Help your kid learn important money skills without them knowing it! 
• MoneyPrep’s fun & comprehensive learning games are made for kids in grades 1-6 and feature tons of question variations perfect for replayability and skill retention.
Recommended by Teachers
• Loved by over 40,000 parents and teachers, MoneyPrep is proven in schools and teacher recommended for at-home learning. MoneyPrep’s games are challenging yet engaging, keeping your kids entertained.
Made By Experts
• MoneyPrep was built by education, finance and tech industry experts with your kid in mind. 
• Teaching money and math lessons in a fun and engaging environment is MoneyPrep’s mission.
Try MoneyPrep today!
• Quick and easy signup.
• Instant access to tons of money learning games.
• MoneyPrep complies with COPPA and equivalent child privacy acts worldwide.
*Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours prior to the renewal date.

bluejetty:00136097:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00136097:ios.description:
► AVAST YE, GAMERS!
Ahoy me hearties! Ready to hoist the mainsail, batten down the hatches and blaze your way across the Caribbean in search of plunder, glory, and hours of pirate fun? Down your grog and grab your cutlass, it’s all hands on deck in this fast-paced pirate simulator that will really float your boat. Race full-sail across the high seas to do battle with simple merchantmen, naval battleships, and fearsome sea monsters, all while filling your coffers with booty to spend on expanding your tropical island hideaway and upgrading your mighty pirateship in preparation for ever fiercer battles and more dastardly buccaneering further into the game!
► SHIVER ME TIMBERS!
• A pirate’s work is never done! The action comes thick and fast in the turbulent waters of this fun fighting game, and prize ships laden with plunder can be spotted on the horizon at every moment. Engage them in battle, exchange broadsides, send them down to Davy Jones’s locker, and grab their lovely loot. But keep an eye on the enemy’s level and the number of warships you engage simultaneously, or it may be you who’s heading for a watery grave.
• Splice the mainbrace! Head back to harbor to trade your barrels of booty for coin at the local pirates’ market, then celebrate your victory and enhance your fearsome reputation by upgrading five different parameters of your pirateship or improving your lighthouse to open up new expanses of the high seas to your reign of piratical terror.
• Pieces of eight! What do pirates love even more than the taste of rum, the scent of the ocean, and a fair following wind? Why, sunken treasure, of course! Scour the Caribbean seas for wrecked ships and bring home even more loot to help you progress through the game.
• The kraken awakes! Maybe it’s the clement climate or the constant supply of drowning sailors, but the particular corner of the ocean where this game is set is suffering a peculiar infestation of gargantuan sea monsters that pose a threat to every boat on the water. Train your cannon on them and rid the oceans of this cursed blight – profiting mightily in the process, of course!
• Not all hope is lost! You may be the most dastardly of pirates with an insatiable thirst for gold, but you get to show your better nature elsewhere in this battleships game – in side missions where you rescue maidens in distress and other unfortunate victims of life’s vicissitudes. But fret ye not, the rewards for your good deeds are ample too!
► SCOURGE OF THE SEVEN SEAS 
Does the free, lawless, action-packed life of a pirate appeal? Want a reputation for terror and plunder that would put Blackbeard to shame? Raise your jolly roger, launch your ship and download Pirate Raid, the casual pirate simulator that’s fast, fun and full to the gunnels with nautical adventure and buccaneering derring-do!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

BRING Today TO YOUR CITY!

bluejetty:00127908:ios.description:
Are you ready to manage your own law firm and become a renowned attorney?
Take on the challenge and become rich while winning crucial trials for your clients!
Start running a small firm and work hard to earn prestige and make your reputation grow. Investigate every detail, track all the leads to turn your business into a successful corporation. 
Deal with the needs of your clients and defend them in court in a fair trial. Choose your cases and hire external detectives and interns to collect evidence and convince the jury. Change the judge’s final verdict thanks to intense research and prove in front of a judge that your defendant is Not Guilty. Invest your money wisely in your business to win harder cases, and impress other famous lawyers with your fine work. Take decisions intelligently, and adapt your strategy accordingly. 
WIN CASES AND STAND OUT FROM THE REST OF LAW FIRMS:
Accept those cases you think can increase your reputation. Specialize in lawsuits related to robbery, bribery, extortion, threat, fraud, drug trafficking; or even solve crimes of passion, murders, love triangles, and mafia-related crime. Demonstrate to the prosecutor that your clients are innocent! Use the prestige earned after each victory to expand your business if you want to handle more special cases. 
INVESTIGATE AND DEFEND YOUR WORK IN COURT:
All the previous research must be defended in front of a judge. Everything will be useless if you don’t advocate all your inquiries and your findings properly. The judge has to be convinced before hitting the table with the mallet. Look for your defendant’s acquittal in every case. Deal with prosecutors and prove that they are wrong!
MANAGE YOUR STAFF: 
You will need the best working team at your law firm. Study the situation and hire lawyers, legal interns, or investigators according to your workflow and growth strategy. All the departments need the best equipment and the best attorneys to cover all the needs in your business. Manage your team wisely to make your business profitable and renowned. 
MAKE CONTACTS AND JOIN EXCLUSIVE LAW CLUBS:
Gain prestige and be invited by famous lawyers to the Lawyers Club. Accept their challenges to increase your reputation and prove your worth in front of all the members. Progress up the career ladder and maintain influential contacts in the club. 
If you like management and idle games, you will enjoy Law Empire Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to manage a law firm with profitable results. Improve your empire starting from a small and modest office and unlock visible progress in your premises. Transform your small business into the best law firm and become the best law corporation around the world!
- Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
- Multiple lines of investigation and legal cases
- Dozens of objects to be unlocked and upgraded
- Lots of characters and interactions
- Funny 3d graphics and great animations 
- Management of a successful business
- A small living world in miniature.

bluejetty:00175475:ios.description:
Welcome to Snake Clash! The ultimate snake io battle for survival is about to begin.
Start as a small, hungry snake, slither across the arena, eat, and grow into the biggest and most powerful snake of all. Jump into fast, fun duels in a fierce arena and become the last one standing!
► Eat and Grow
Keep moving across the endless battlefield, seize every opportunity, and eat smaller snakes to grow bigger. Make quick decisions, control your snake with precision, and slither skillfully to win every fight.
The more you eat, the bigger you get, boosting your attack power and presence. Don't just grow—beat your opponents and rise to the top of the food chain.
► Skins & Customization
Battles aren't just about strength. Collect a variety of skins to show off your unique personality and style. From flashy designs to quirky themes, mix and match countless options to create a one-of-a-kind snake that's all yours.
► Tower of Challenges
Ready to test your skills? Climb the Tower of Challenges floor by floor by clearing the stages and missions on each level. Clear every floor to claim limited season-themed rewards, including exclusive snake skins, profile frames, and food skins. Only players with real skill make it to the top!
► Multiplayer iO Mode
Growth isn't limited to playing alone. Play online with friends in real-time multiplayer or face off against players from around the world. Feel the thrill of a fast-changing battlefield where the game can flip in the blink of an eye.
The battle to become the top snake in the arena is always full of tension and excitement. Sharpen your skills and become a true champion in a game that keeps you hooked every moment!
► Global Ranking System
Your efforts are rewarded with more than just in-game items. Your achievements in the Tower of Challenges and Seasonal Events are immediately reflected in the global rankings.
- Compete with players worldwide and aim for the highest rank.
- Receive special rewards and honorable titles based on your ranking.
- Claim the glory of being #1 and make your name famous in the world of Snake Clash!
► Play Anytime, Anywhere
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Enjoy Snake Clash anytime, anywhere—on a plane, during your commute, or anywhere without an internet connection. Whether you have a short break or a long stretch of time, the fun never stops.
► Challenge Now!
Snake Clash is the next evolution of the snake genre, combining the intuitive gameplay of a classic snake game with innovative elements like boss battles, seasonal events, the Tower of Challenges, and a global ranking system. Download now and jump into a world of eating, fighting, and conquering.
It's time for your snake to dominate the battlefield!

bluejetty:00046789:ios.description:
Stella AI – Learn Spanish with Your Personal AI Tutor
Learning Spanish should feel like having real conversations—not memorizing endless vocabulary lists.
Stella AI is a personalized Spanish learning app that helps you learn Spanish through AI-powered conversations, interactive lessons, and instant feedback. Whether you're taking your first lesson or building on what you already know, Stella helps you speak Spanish with greater confidence through personalized practice that fits your level and goals.
Learn Spanish with AI
Meet your personal AI Spanish tutor and practice whenever inspiration strikes. Have natural conversations, receive real-time feedback, and improve your speaking skills with lessons designed around everyday communication. If you're looking for a smarter way to learn how to speak Spanish, Stella adapts every lesson to your progress.
Build Real Conversation Skills
Go beyond memorization and start using Spanish in real-life situations. Practice conversations for travel, work, daily life, and more while improving your pronunciation, listening, and speaking naturally. Every session is designed to help you feel more comfortable when you talk in Spanish.
Improve Every Essential Language Skill
Develop all the skills you need to communicate confidently:
• AI conversation practice
• Speaking and pronunciation training
• Grammar and vocabulary lessons
• Listening and reading comprehension
• Interactive quizzes with instant feedback
• Spanish lessons for beginners to advanced learners
Whether you're learning Spanish for beginners or advancing toward fluency, Stella creates a learning path that's personalized for you.
Learn at Your Own Pace
Short, focused lessons make it easy to practice every day. Build consistent learning habits, track your progress, and enjoy a more engaging way to learn a language—one conversation at a time.
Why Learners Choose Stella
- Personalized AI tutor
- Real conversations instead of rote memorization
- Instant pronunciation feedback
- Adaptive lessons that match your level
- Practical Spanish for everyday situations
- Fun, interactive learning experience
Whether you're preparing for travel, communicating with friends and family, exploring new career opportunities, or simply enjoying the process of learning a new language, Stella helps you build the confidence to use Spanish in everyday life.
Start learning today with Stella AI and discover a more natural way to learn Spanish, practice real conversations, and become a confident Spanish speaker.
---
Subscription Service
By confirming your purchase, your iTunes account will be charged. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions at any time through your Apple ID account settings. Even after cancellation, you can continue using premium features until the end of the current subscription period. After the subscription ends, you will no longer have access to these features.

Win the fights
Smash the enemy army to smithereens with your huge tank. Participate in battles all over the map, go through levels and win the war. Each battle is special, you can fight alone or build your own army of soldiers, tanks and helicopters. Aim carefully and attack!

bluejetty:00015468:ios.name: Metronaut Sheet Music
bluejetty:00015468:ios.summary:
#1 Intelligent Music Practice Tool — trusted by ABRSM, Buffet Crampon and Pleyel, and millions of practicing musicians and teachers worldwide.
Play, teach and progress, in lessons or at home. Metronaut combines interactive sheet music, pro
bluejetty:00015468:ios.description:
#1 Intelligent Music Practice Tool — trusted by ABRSM, Buffet Crampon and Pleyel, and millions of practicing musicians and teachers worldwide.
Play, teach and progress, in lessons or at home. Metronaut combines interactive sheet music, professional accompaniments and AI Feedback that listens to your playing.
Rooted in research at IRCAM in Paris, Metronaut brings technology used in performances with leading orchestras worldwide to your everyday practice.
YOUR INSTRUMENT, YOUR SCORE
Explore over 20,000 high-quality sheet music titles, with new repertoire added regularly. Play pieces written for other instruments, too. Metronaut automatically adapts the sheet music to your instrument’s clef and range. Adjust the key, octave, clef or tuning reference; the accompaniment adapts while preserving its sound quality.
HEAR WHAT TO IMPROVE WITH AI Feedback
See how accurately you play, directly on your sheet music. Get instant visual feedback on pitch and rhythm, a performance rating from 0 to 100, and XP to track your progress. AI Feedback works with every piece and instrument, including acoustic piano and guitar. Use your microphone or connect a digital MIDI instrument. Get feedback even while playing along with accompaniment — no headphones needed.
FOUR MODES, YOUR WAY TO PRACTICE
• Listen — Get to know the piece and hear your part before you play.
• Sight-read — Take your time. The cursor advances when you play the right note or chord, without accompaniment.
• Practice — Build accuracy at a steady tempo, with accompaniment when available. Start slowly and increase the speed as you improve.
• Interpret (AI Tempo) — Accompaniment that follows your lead, adapting to your tempo in real time for expressive phrasing.
Use AI Feedback alongside Sight-read, Practice or Interpret (AI Tempo).
RECORD AND REPLAY WITH YOUR SHEET MUSIC
Record audio or video and replay your performance in sync with your sheet music. Teachers can assign pieces and playlists, then exchange recordings privately with students between lessons. Share your performances with the Metronaut community, too.
TOOLS TO MAKE EVERY SESSION COUNT
• Practice offline with downloaded pieces, even without an internet connection.
• Repeat difficult passages with loops and a metronome.
• Add annotations, highlights and musical markings.
• Tune your instrument with the built-in tuner.
• Stay in sync with automatic Bluetooth audio delay compensation.
• Read comfortably with zoom, scrolling and page-turn options.
• Print sheet music where available.
• Practice piano one hand at a time on supported pieces, while Metronaut plays the other.
MUSIC FOR EVERY STAGE
Explore classical, pop, jazz and film music, alongside exercises, methods and études, with pieces and arrangements from beginner to expert. Find music for piano, violin, cello, guitar, flute, clarinet, saxophone, trumpet, viola, voice and many other instruments. Enjoy solo pieces and accompaniments recorded by professional musicians, from piano to full orchestra.
METRONAUT PREMIUM
Download the app, browse the catalog and listen to previews for free. Premium unlocks the full library, professional accompaniments and smart practice tools.
Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Eligible users can try the annual plan free for 7 days. Plans and prices are shown in the app and may vary by region.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Any unused trial period is forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Help: https://community.metronautapp.com/
Terms: https://www.metronautapp.com/eula/
Privacy: https://www.metronautapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00062101:ios.summary: Our diverse portfolio of games keeps kids engaged, motivating them to learn more! We’ve developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and
bluejetty:00062101:ios.description:
Our diverse portfolio of games keeps kids engaged, motivating them to learn more! We’ve developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids’ progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
RACE CARS
Join thousands of players worldwide in the most epic monster truck racing game ever - SKIDOS Race Cars! 
Unlock extreme monster trucks, apply countless customization features and start your journey! Tune your skills in fun single player events or compete with other players in multiplayer. Are you ready for some serious monster action? :) 
FEATURES: 
• Collect and upgrade 14 free cars 
• Choose from countless customization features 
• Progress through multiple leagues to the top 
•Compete in single and multiplayer modes
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child’s learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keep them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions, as well as nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We’ve curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalog.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-Day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, & auto-renewal for subscriptions may be turned off in the user’s device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00134502:ios.description:
Do you want to become a real tycoon in the business world? Try yourself as a financial investor? In this case, the lazy tycoon simulator in Mining Empire is just for you!
Take the chance to delve into your own mines, filled to the brim with gold coins and precious stones. Develop a strategy for developing more and more mines, extract more valuables and have fun!
Have you ever wanted to become a big boss? Then you are in the right place, hire both ordinary workers and managers to have fun while others work! Each mine, with experienced and well-trained workers, will bring a lot of money into your pocket. Drive smart and get all the possibilities in the world in tycoon simulator!
BUILD A MINING EMPIRE
Play the money making simulator to prove to yourself that you can become a great rich boss! Improve your mines and upgrade them. Work hard yourself first, then hire managers and develop their skills. Achieve success in mining mines in the simulator game!
EXPAND THE TERRITORIES OF YOUR EMPIRE
Discover new islands with unique resources and managers. Explore new locations, upgrade them and get all the resources. Do you want to visit the Island of Dawn and admire the emerald deposits? Don't forget to hire a Super Manager to help you collect resources while you relax!
MANAGE YOUR WORKFLOW
Develop your employees to increase their efficiency and your income. The more hard work you do, the more money and gold you will earn! In your gold factory, you will manage both men and women - see how their appearance changes depending on their level in the simulation game. Hire rare managers to control the work process. Each manager has his own talent to improve workflow and motivation.
It's time to build your mining empire! Build, click, manage your thriving and successful business. Start earning as much money as possible to become the richest tycoon!

bluejetty:00144861:ios.description:
FUJISTYLE is a professional auxiliary tool designed specifically for Fuji camera users, making your photography experience more enjoyable and effortless. Whether you're recording and managing Fuji color recipes, adding watermarks and borders to your photos, or identifying film simulation parameters of your shots, FUJISTYLE can meet all your needs. Hundreds of Fuji recipes + over 100 border and watermark styles.
• Highly Recommended by Fuji Photographers
• Hot topic in Facebook Instagram fuji communities
• 5.0 stars in several regions
• Apple's Editor's Choice: Featured as App of the Week
Thousands of Fuji camera users share color recipes here. We've also included some popular film simulation recipes, available for free viewing. If you use a Fuji X series camera, you can apply these recipe parameters to your camera to capture photos with unique color sensibilities.
Special Declaration: 
FUJISTYLE is NOT an official FUJIFILM application! 
FUJISTYLE is an auxiliary tool designed to enhance the experience of Fuji camera enthusiasts and provide additional features. 
Not associated with the FUJIFILM Corporation. 
Not associated with the FUJIFILM Corporation. 
Not associated with the FUJIFILM Corporation.
Key Features:
1. Fuji Color Recipe Notes: Enjoy the convenience of saving unlimited Fuji simulation recipes. FUJISTYLE makes recording and managing Fuji color recipes simple and easy, without worrying about the limited number of custom settings on your camera. Take high-quality photos and experience the limitless possibilities of Fuji cameras.
2. Fuji JPEG Original Color Recipe Recognition: With one-click operation, FUJISTYLE can intelligently recognize color recipes in Fuji original images, eliminating tedious manual input processes and simplifying your post-shooting workflow.
3. Fuji Borders and Watermarks: What you see is what you get editing experience, offering various Fuji-style borders and watermarks. FUJISTYLE can automatically recognize photo information, support batch watermarking, maintain original image quality, and enhance the individuality and quality of photos.
4. Fuji Recipe Community: Join FUJISTYLE to explore and share Fuji recipes. View and collect creative recipes in the community。
5. Camera Connection (USB or Wireless) – One-Tap Recipe Import: Connect your Fuji camera by USB cable or wirelessly and write any recipe straight into its custom slots (C1–C7) in one tap — with custom slot names, no more dialing in settings one by one. You can also read shooting parameters back from your camera to create new recipes instantly.
FUJISTYLE User Benefits
- Locally record and manage unlimited Fuji color recipes
- One-click intelligent recognition of Fuji JPEG original color recipes
- View basic photo EXIF information
- Free access to view the film recipe community
- Wireless recipe import (select models), free for a limited time
Pro Member Exclusive Benefits
- Add exclusive watermarks and borders (over 60 types)
- Generate personalized film recipe cards
- USB recipe import

- Restore Purchase: By logging into the device with the same Apple ID used for the purchase and pressing the "Restore Purchase" button, you can restore your purchase status for free.

bluejetty:00029631:ios.description:
Take on the role of a car mechanic who starts their first car workshop. 
The game features a day and night cycle, which introduces a specific rhythm and requires organizing your work accordingly. By accepting more and more complicated orders, you can develop your skills. Along with the development, a number of additional possibilities open up to you. You can collect and tune up cars and take part in a number of complicated racing challenges.
Car Mechanic Simulator Racing features:
You can: take car repair orders, tune up your own cars, take part in racing challenges on several tracks, compete with other players for first place on the race leaderboards, expand your car collection and trade your cars. 
Unlock over 25 unique skills. Some streamline the repair process, others increase earnings and some open up completely new game opportunities. The order of unlocking them depends only on you.
42 unique cars: classics, utility vehicles, muscle cars, sports cars, JDM cars.
1100 car parts. Those will enable you to construct complete: Chassis sets with drives (FWD, RWD, AWD), and engines (R4, R6, 3 Rotor, 4 Rotor, Boxer, V8).
Replace car paints, rims, spoilers, and wings.
Make progress in a number of racing challenges and compete against other players for a better place on the leaderboard.
Focus on trading cars and expanding your car collection.
Improve your repair skills and unlock advanced tuning (including engine swaps). 
Increase workshop income, speed up work on orders, and compete for a place on the leaderboard of racing events.
Supported languages: English, Polish, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese ( Brazil), Russian.
Do you play car fixing, repair, mechanic, customizing games? Do you like simulator games? Car Mechanic Simulator Racing is the right game for you.
If you are looking for a great car restoration game, download Car Mechanic Simulator Racing now.
