bluejetty:00188019:ios.description:
Get rid of the busy work and sell more with Badger Maps- a sales and mapping app specifically designed for field sales & service.
Badger Maps is your virtual field sales assistant, helping you focus on the right accounts, get the fastest multi-stop routes, find new leads, and keep all your customer data accessible and up to date in the field. It’s more than just a sales route planner. It's a total territory management solution that automates and optimizes all of your activities, from routing & mapping to prospecting to tracking mileage for expense reports. 
With a map based sales app on their iPhone or iPad, field sales & field service reps record 50% more customer data, drive 20% less, and sell around 22% more.
Join 10,000+ companies using Badger to save time and sell more with features like:
ROUTE PLANNING
Use Badger’s sales route planner to optimize routes with multiple stops (up to 120). Get turn by turn directions using your favorite navigation app like Waze, Google Maps, Apple Maps, or Apple CarPlay.
SALES MAPPING
Visualize your customers & prospects on an interactive map. Colorize and filter accounts by business type, last order date, or any other metric to make key accounts stand out.
SCHEDULING
Adjust appointment length. Know when you’ll be late or early to a meeting. Push stops to your calendar with the touch of a button.
FOLLOW-UP REMINDERS
Quickly see the accounts that need attention near your route, and add them to your schedule.
MOBILE LEAD GENERATION
Meeting canceled? No problem. Automate prospecting, and find new, qualified leads in your vicinity.
NOTES & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
Take/talk notes on your phone. Add pictures. Have all your customer data at your fingertips, when you meet with customers or plan your day. 
OUTSIDE SALES CRM
Some outside sales and field service teams use Badger as a basic field sales CRM. It also acts as a mobile front-end for feature rich CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Zoho, Insightly, Netsuite, Pipedrive, monday.com, SugarCRM, Veeva, Odoo, and more. No more double data entry or fumbling for notes in the field. Keep all your CRM data accessible and in sync with a real time, 2-way integration.
MAPPING FOR YOUR CRM
Map all your Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Tasks, and custom objects and see their relationship with one another on the map. 
AUTOMATED REPORTING & MILEAGE TRACKING
Automatically receive weekly reports, summarizing your field activity. Generate reports on your routes that make submitting your mileage easy. 
FIELD MANAGEMENT (browser/macOS)
See where your field sales or field service team is at in the sales cycle. Use territory mapping tools, like heat maps and bubble maps, to gain insight into your team’s performance. With Badger's territory alignment software, you can automatically create, balance, and optimize territories. 
Sign up for a free trial today and take your field sales performance to the next level. With route optimization, Badger pays for itself with just the gas savings alone!
See what outside sales & field service teams are saying:
"After getting Badger Maps, weekly meetings per rep jumped from 12 to 20. This led to a 22% increase in annual revenue." - Brad Moxley, Business Development Manager, Cutter & Buck
“Knowing our most valuable accounts, and the best way to get to them, saves us a ton of time driving. Badger’s route optimization cuts our drive time by 25%” - John O’Kain, Territory Manager, NCR Aloha
“With Badger, you can really plan out your week based on where you can have the biggest impact.” - Matthew Brooks, Business Development Manager, Cargill
Terms of Use: https://www.badgermapping.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00180819:ios.description:
This is a powerful and user-friendly application designed to effortlessly remove unwanted objects from digital images. With advanced image processing algorithms and intuitive controls, this app provides a seamless experience for users to edit and enhance their photos.
Key Features:
Object Removal: The app excels in its ability to remove unwanted objects, people, or elements from images with precision. Simply select the object you want to remove using the app's intuitive tools, and let the advanced algorithms work their magic to seamlessly erase it from the scene. The result is a clean and natural-looking image without any traces of the removed object.
Smart Fill Technology: The Object Remover app incorporates intelligent fill algorithms to replace the erased areas with surrounding content that blends seamlessly with the rest of the image. This technology ensures that the background or missing parts are automatically reconstructed, making the final result look as if the object was never there.
Easy-to-Use Interface: The app features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, allowing both novice and experienced users to navigate and utilize its powerful tools effortlessly. The editing process is streamlined, ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.
Sharing and Saving: Once the editing process is complete, users can easily save their edited images in various formats and resolutions. The app also supports sharing directly to popular social media platforms, email, or messaging apps, allowing users to showcase their creativity and share their images with others.

PREGNANCY TRACKER AND BABY TRACKER

- Make life easier with parenting tips.
- Get advice on baby care, breastfeeding, and more.

- Read parenting articles full of useful tips, written with up-to-date research on popular topics.
- Get access to expertly crafted guides on parenting, nutrition and more.

GREAT GIFTS!
- Parenting should be rewarding. That's why we have attractive prizes for you to win on our app!
- Participate in contests and giveaways, and you could win awesome gifts like strollers, staycations, and much more!
BABY PHOTOS, MUSIC & MORE

- Sing along to cute videos and songs!
- Avoid the dangers of other video streaming services and enjoy a wealth of videos made for children here.
Download theAsianparent app today and be a part of the largest community of Asian parents in the world.

bluejetty:00151301:ios.description:
Proov Power, in your Pocket
When paired with Proov hormone test kits, the Proov Fertility & Menopause app transforms your phone into a powerful hormone monitor. 
Get rich, hormone data-based insight on your cycle to understand ovarian reserve, find the full fertile window, confirm successful ovulation during the implantation window, and see key hormone balance ratios. Each month, you’ll get your hormone report card including a Proov-exclusive Ovulation Score along with actionable, personalized solutions to promote cycle health and improve your chances of getting pregnant.
Whether you're tracking hormones to maintain a healthy cycle or trying to conceive (TTC), join thousands of women and download Proov Fertility Insight to unlock the power of your cycle. Unlike other ovulation and fertility tracking apps, Proov goes beyond fertile window tracking to get the full picture on your cycle hormones and uncover levels that could be impacting your fertility or how you feel. 
Proov uses proprietary algorithms, patented, FDA-cleared technology, and clinically validated fertility research to help you fully understand your cycle hormones. 
A clinical study showed that Proov can improve your chances of pregnancy by up to 75%! Our algorithm provides medical-grade levels of your key cycle hormones: FSH, estrogen, LH, and PdG. Just pee, dip a test strip, and scan your test with the app to get your hormone values. Proov Fertility Insight will tell you what your unique hormone patterns mean for you and suggest actionable next steps to support a healthy cycle and ovulation. Best of all, the app is free!
Download our app to move you forward in your fertility journey or buy your test kit at proovtest.com.
Ovulation Insights 
Did you know that there are different ways to ovulate? There's more to getting pregnant than just timing your fertile window. Confirming that ovulation happened and ensuring your hormone levels are where they need to be is just as important. With the Proov Insight app you get critical insight about ovulation and you can use it with your favorite fertility tracking method.
Features
Testing plans personalized for your cycle
Daily tips and reminders when to test
Scan tests with instant results (no waiting, no pricks)
See actual hormone values
Track unique hormone patterns and cycle symptoms
Get clear, actionable results — including the Proov-exclusive Ovulation Score
Receive personalized next steps
Is Proov right for me?
Thinking about getting pregnant
Trying but not conceiving
Symptoms of hormonal imbalances
Over age of 35
Empower Perimenopause Test
This new hormone test from Proov measures hormones for women who are curious about where they might be on their perimenopause journey. It evaluates hormone levels as well as menstrual changes and perimenopause symptoms. The Proov app then connects women who have completed the Empower test with treatments to manage their perimenopause symptoms.
Support Community
In addition to our customer care team, Proov is a community of thousands of women just like you. Join our private community of support to meet women along various parts of their journeys, ask anonymous questions, and share experiences.
What our Proovers have to say:
"Proov confirmed I wasn’t ovulating successfully, which helped me advocate for the right treatment and now I have 2 living children." -Arden C.
"Thanks to Proov, I got the right treatment from my doctor and now I’m 8 weeks pregnant." -Molly S.
"I found Proov after suffering a miscarriage and within one cycle I got pregnant!" -Grace M.
Check us out
website: proovtest.com
Facebook: facebook.com/proovtest
Instagram: @proovtest
Twitter: twitter.com/proovtest
Note: This app can only be used with Proov test kits and does not substitute professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. You are advised to consult with your physician on results and treatment plans. The Proov Insight app should not be used as birth control/contraception.

bluejetty:00023209:ios.description:
Classifier is the collection tracker for collectors of pretty much anything. Catalog your license plates, coins, stamps, trading cards, vinyl, figures and more, keep a wishlist of everything you're still hunting for, and see your collections in charts and statistics.
Built with Apple's design guidelines in mind, Classifier feels right at home on iPhone, iPad and Mac. It's the easiest way to digitize your collections, whether you've been collecting for decades or are just getting started.
WHY CLASSIFIER?
• All your collections in one place, synced between your devices with iCloud
• Start from a ready-made template, or design your own collection with custom fields
• Keep a wishlist, so you never forget what you're still looking for
• Organize your collectibles with tags, and browse everything that shares a tag
• Add photos to every collectible
• Search and sort your collections in a few taps
• Charts and statistics about your collections
• Export collections and wishlists to spreadsheets and images
• Import an existing collection from a spreadsheet
CLASSIFIER PRO
• Unlimited collections, collectibles and charts
• Move collectibles between collections
• Color themes and collectible sizes to make the app your own
ALSO WORTH SHOUTING ABOUT
• No sign-up required
• Dark Mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support
• No ads
• Privacy-focused: we don't sell your data
TEMPLATES
Ready-made templates for license plates, coins, stamps, Pokémon cards, sports trading cards, Magic: The Gathering cards, Funko POP! figures, LEGO sets and minifigs, Hot Wheels, Beanie Babies, video games, board games, comic books, vinyl, art, pottery, sneakers, sports jerseys, film cameras, computers and event tickets, with more on the way.
Questions or feedback? Email classifier@appdeco.ca
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040059:ios.summary:
Aplicativo oficial homologado pela URBS para a compra e ativação do EstaR eletrônico em vagas de Estacionamento Regulamentado de Curitiba.
O EstaR Curitiba é Zul Digital. Você compra e ativa o estacionamento direto pelo app, com segurança
bluejetty:00040059:ios.description:
Aplicativo oficial homologado pela URBS para a compra e ativação do EstaR eletrônico em vagas de Estacionamento Regulamentado de Curitiba.
O EstaR Curitiba é Zul Digital. Você compra e ativa o estacionamento direto pelo app, com segurança e facilidade em qualquer uma das vagas disponíveis do EstaR Digital Curitiba.
Compre créditos do EstaR eletrônico para utilizar o Estacionamento Regulamentado de Curitiba e pague como preferir: cartão de crédito, débito, boleto e Apple Pay.
O que é o EstaR Digital Curitiba?
O EstaR digital é o sistema de estacionamento rotativo eletrônico homologado pela Urbs para facilitar o estacionamento e gerenciamento das vagas de Estacionamento Regulamentado em Curitiba. O modelo digital substitui os antigos talões de papel pelo uso do aplicativo. Agora, o motorista compra o cartão rotativo pelo celular e regulariza o estacionamento do veículo na vaga de maneira simples, rápida e segura.
Como funciona o app?
Em apenas alguns passos você compra e utiliza o EstaR Digital Curitiba:
1 - Cadastre-se no aplicativo
2 - Adicione seu veículo
3 - Compre seu EstaR eletrônico da maneira que preferir
4 - Ative o cartão ao estacionar o veículo
Qual horário do EstaR Digital Curitiba?
O EstaR Curitiba funciona de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 19h, e aos sábados, das 9h às 13h.
Como o agente de trânsito fará a fiscalização?
Com o novo sistema, a fiscalização do EstaR Curitiba também é feita digitalmente. Os agentes de trânsito da prefeitura de Curitiba - URBS utilizam um app próprio em que realizam uma consulta eletrônica buscando pela placa do veículo para verificar a situação do carro na vaga de estacionamento. Por se tratar de um processo 100% digital, não é mais necessário deixar o comprovante no painel do carro.
Receberei algum aviso de que o tempo está acabando?
Sim! O aplicativo Zul EstaR Digital Curitiba enviará avisos sempre que o tempo do estacionamento estiver próximo de acabar. Com apenas um toque você poderá renovar o seu tempo de estacionamento, de onde estiver, se a vaga onde estacionou permitir renovação.
O EstaR Eletrônico em Curitiba é seguro?
Sim! Toda a comunicação do Zul Digital com os servidores é feita de maneira criptografada, garantindo segurança máxima para que você possa comprar o EstaR para estacionamento em Curitiba de maneira rápida e sem riscos.
Como posso comprovar que fiz a compra pelo aplicativo?
Você poderá acessar seu histórico de utilização de estacionamento completo no app a qualquer momento. Lá constarão informações como data, horário e mapa com os locais de todas as vezes que você ativou seu EstaR e estacionou em uma vaga.
Baixe agora o app e tenha a melhor experiência de pagamento do EstaR Digital Curitiba!
Dúvidas, problemas ou sugestões, fale com a gente:
suporte+cwb@zuldigital.com.br

bluejetty:00129214:ios.description:
Welcome to the city of sin—the place where you can drown yourself in riches! 
 Be prepared to live a new life, experience a limitless world where you make the rules. 
 Do whatever it takes to quickly rake in a vast fortune and become a billionaire. 
 In a world where there is no law, be ready to defend yourself at the drop of a hat. 
 Game Features: 
 ■A brand-new life in riches■
Start your profligated life drowning in riches in sin city. Live a life above the law and take whatever you set your eyes on. When the money comes in, the world opens up for you to fully live a life of crime!
■Battle against rival gangs in real-time combat■
From Streetside Shootout to Turf Wars, it's all hands on deck if you want to be the top dog. Lead your crew of hardened gangsters and take the city of crime for yourself.
■Live AI calculations for a real-world simulation■
Fight for turfs during the day, and party at bars and clubs during the night! How you spend your time each day is up to you!
■Your Syndicate, your rules■
Establish a Syndicate with other players and take on the trickiest of enemies. Build relations and assist allies to further your own goals.
■A city of sin with infinite possibilities■
There is no law here. Plunder, ravage, steal, loot—these are all daily occurrences. For what you ask? To take whatever your heart desires!
■Use your wits to become a billionaire■
Run casinos, bars, black markets...whatever it takes. Produce gold bars, weapons, and contraband to rake in vast fortunes and spend them on anything you can imagine!
■Raise your criminal empire and become a legend■
Hire the strongest criminals from all around the world and build the most powerful teams sin city has ever seen. Increase your influence and hold all the power to yourself. Take what you set your eyes on—even by force, and become a legend in your own criminal empire!

bluejetty:00097992:ios.description:
Welcome to a world where every collision feels real, every deformation is dynamic, and every crash is breathtakingly authentic. Powered by FlexicEngine, the cutting-edge physics engine developed by SIDGIN, this game delivers an unparalleled softbody destruction experience. Each crash is a unique spectacle, with cars reacting to impacts as they would in real life.
Why FlexicEngine?
 • Super Realistic Physics: FlexicEngine simulates the behavior of flexible materials with incredible precision, bringing a new level of realism to softbody dynamics.
 • Immersive World: Every car crumples, bends, and breaks in real-time, creating a lifelike experience that pulls you into the action.
 • Optimized for Mobile: Despite its advanced physics, the game runs smoothly on most mobile devices, ensuring a seamless gaming experience.
What Awaits You:
 • Interactive Crash Tests: Engage with diverse obstacles, from steel barriers to massive walls, each designed to test the limits of destruction.
 • Lifelike Car Models: Every vehicle is crafted with attention to detail, responding to crashes with realistic deformations and damage.
 • Dynamic Challenges: Tackle unique crash scenarios that push your driving and survival skills to the edge.
Support Our Mission!
We’ve just launched this ambitious project and need your feedback to make it even better. Creating realistic softbody physics on mobile devices is a massive challenge, but with your help, we’re determined to perfect it.
Download now and experience the power of FlexicEngine. Become the master of crash tests in the most realistic softbody simulator ever created!

Fast Cleaner helps you organize your photo library, find duplicate and similar photos, and compress photos and videos to help free up storage space on your iPhone.

Scan your photo library for potential duplicate photos. Review the results and select the copies you no longer need.
► Organize Similar Photos
Review groups of similar-looking photos. Choose which images to keep and which ones to delete.
► Review Large Videos
Find large videos in your photo library and choose which ones to keep, compress, or delete.

Swipe left to mark photos for deletion and swipe right to keep them. Review your selections before confirming deletion.
► Video & Batch Image Compression
Compress videos or multiple photos to help reduce file sizes. File size reduction and visual quality vary depending on the original files and compression settings.
► Calendar Event Cleanup
With calendar access, review past events and select the ones you no longer need for deletion.

bluejetty:00148542:ios.description:
Call, meet, message and more! Avaya Cloud Office lets you simplify the way your business communicates with a unified experience that’s intuitive to use and accessible from a phone, a browser or any mobile device. From a single interface you’ll chat with colleagues, make and receive calls, plan and join meetings, collaborate with screen sharing and video, and keep your teams on-task with file sharing, task management and virtual team rooms that let everyone share and stay up to date. 
With Avaya Cloud Office you will:
Accelerate your decision making with team messaging
Message individuals or teams in real time to stay connected, bring remote workers together, and resolve business issues, questions and decisions instantly. Share files, assign tasks and schedule meetings with a few simple clicks.
Optimize employee and customer collaboration with frictionless video meetings
Schedule and launch video meetings directly from the app or invite guests to join from their favorite browser. No download and no delay with all the benefits of screen sharing, in-meeting chat, recording and markup tools.
Connect with intuitive, feature-rich HD calling
Find and connect with your customers and colleagues with one click. Know who called and when, and invoke the features you need through the intuitive interface. Seamlessly move from one device to another as your busy day unfolds.
Simplify your communications with a single number
Call, text (SMS) and Fax using your Avaya Cloud Office business number. No need for your customers to remember multiple numbers and no need for you to mix business with personal communications. 
Get more done with integrations that make sense for the way you work 
You rely on desktop apps, workflow automation, and customer relationship management to get your work done every day. With Avaya Cloud Office, you can integrate those apps with your communications, creating a seamless experience that eliminates the need to switch between applications. 
An Avaya Cloud Office subscription is required. Features may vary by plan and country.

bluejetty:00080489:ios.name: Car Jam Puzzle: Traffic Escape
bluejetty:00080489:ios.summary: Car Jam: Traffic Escape 3D delivers the ultimate puzzle challenge where strategic thinking meets traffic management in addictive escape scenarios. Navigate complex traffic jams using spatial reasoning and precise planning to guide vehicles
bluejetty:00080489:ios.description:
Car Jam: Traffic Escape 3D delivers the ultimate puzzle challenge where strategic thinking meets traffic management in addictive escape scenarios. Navigate complex traffic jams using spatial reasoning and precise planning to guide vehicles through congested situations that test your problem-solving abilities.
Master Strategic Traffic Navigation
Traffic becomes your playground as you orchestrate vehicle movements to escape jams through increasingly challenging scenarios. Each level presents unique traffic patterns where timing and positioning determine success. The intuitive tap-to-move controls make traffic navigation accessible while escalating complexity keeps puzzle enthusiasts engaged.
Experience realistic traffic simulation through advanced 3D graphics that bring authentic vehicle dynamics and spatial awareness to life. Observe traffic light sequences, pedestrian movements, and environmental obstacles as you plan optimal escape routes through dense traffic situations.
Dynamic Escape Challenges
• Progressive difficulty enhancing traffic complexity and escape scenarios
• Realistic vehicle physics with dynamic traffic elements
• Strategic power-ups for overcoming challenging traffic jams
• Coin rewards system celebrating successful navigation
• Multi-layered puzzles combining logic with spatial skills
Unlike conventional puzzle games, Car Jam transforms traffic management into strategic gameplay where players anticipate multiple moves ahead. The sophisticated mechanics require consideration of traffic flow patterns, optimal timing, and route efficiency while executing precise escape maneuvers through complex jams.
Revolutionary Traffic Mechanics
Traffic puzzle enthusiasts appreciate the game's advanced approach to vehicle positioning and movement prediction. Each successful escape unlocks progressively challenging traffic scenarios that build upon learned strategies, creating engaging gameplay that maintains long-term motivation.
The immersive 3D environment enhances traffic navigation by providing crucial depth perception and spatial awareness needed for solving intricate escape puzzles. Players develop genuine traffic management skills while enjoying entertainment that transcends traditional puzzle gaming.
Strategic Traffic Management
Navigate through rush hour scenarios, construction zones, and busy intersections where every decision impacts your escape success. The game incorporates realistic traffic principles, teaching players efficient route planning and timing optimization through engaging puzzle mechanics.
Experience traffic scenarios ranging from simple gridlock situations to complex multi-lane challenges requiring advanced strategic thinking. Each traffic jam presents unique solutions that reward creative problem-solving and spatial intelligence.
Download Car Jam: Traffic Escape 3D and discover why players consider this the definitive traffic puzzle experience. Transform challenging traffic situations into exciting strategic adventures that sharpen analytical skills while delivering hours of compelling gameplay.
Ready to master traffic navigation? Begin your escape adventure and experience the perfect fusion of strategy, skill, and engaging puzzle entertainment that challenges your traffic management expertise.

TIME TRACKING
Auris's Time and Attendance system was built with payroll in mind. Employees can track time directly on thei
bluejetty:00119199:ios.description:
The Auris Payroll+ App is your one-stop-shop for Time Tracking, Employee Self-Service, Benefits, Schedules and more!
TIME TRACKING
Auris's Time and Attendance system was built with payroll in mind. Employees can track time directly on their mobile device, which syncs with payroll systems ensuring hours are reported accurately and efficiently. With compliance features built in, we make it easy for your employer to keep up-to-date with local labor laws. Other time tracking features include GPS for timesheets, real-time exception notifications to supervisors, tracking paid/unpaid breaks, tips and more all to ensure employee paychecks are accurate and timely. 
EMPLOYEE SELF-SERVICE
Auris's Employee Self-Service makes it easy to manage your employee information on a device that’s always with you. Employees will have access to W-2 documents, control their direct deposit information, change tax deductions/withholdings, and update address information. 
BENEFITS ADMINISTRATION 
Start managing your Employer Provided Benefits right from your phone. Complete your Open Enrollment and submit Qualifying Life Events with a few simple taps. All your Health Insurance and Flexible Benefit resources in the palm of your hand. Your benefits journey, made simple.
MANAGE YOUR SCHEDULE
Auris's scheduling software makes it easy to build and manage employee schedules. To get started, your supervisor can simply drag and drop shifts to open time slots. The moment a new shift is published, a new job is scheduled, or any changes are made to an existing schedule, everyone in the team will be up-to-date with real-time notifications.
REQUEST TIME-OFF
Employees can quickly book time-off directly from your mobile device. Managers can stay on top of employee availability by viewing requests in real-time and approving or rejecting requests.
CONTACT
If you like the Auris Payroll+ mobile app, you can leave us a review! If you would like to submit feedback to Auris regarding your app experience, please use the feature within the Payroll+ mobile app labeled “Send Feedback”.

bluejetty:00145168:ios.summary:

Fancy Feats is the ultimate jump rope app—whether you’re a total beginner or want to take your skipping skills to the next level. With 100+ skill tutorials, 100+ combo & routine tutorials, guided workou
bluejetty:00145168:ios.description:
LEARN TO JUMP ROPE WITH LAUREN JUMPS
Fancy Feats is the ultimate jump rope app—whether you’re a total beginner or want to take your skipping skills to the next level. With 100+ skill tutorials, 100+ combo & routine tutorials, guided workouts, and a brand-new XP system, you’ll be mastering jump rope tricks, footwork, and routines faster than ever.
Jump rope isn’t just an amazing cardio workout—it’s portable, fun, and one of the fastest ways to burn calories while building coordination. If you’re bored of the same old workouts, Fancy Feats makes fitness exciting again.
CHOOSE YOUR SKILLS
Learn at your own pace with the interactive skill map:
 - Beginners: land your first jumps, crossovers, or double unders (great for CrossFit)
 - Intermediate: build endurance, boxer-style skipping, and flow footwork
 - Advanced: unlock freestyle jump rope tricks, swings, leg crosses, wraps and more
Every skill includes step-by-step tutorials and drills to make learning easy—and every completed skill earns you XP to keep progress fun and motivating.
UNLOCK COMBOS & ROUTINES
- 100+ combos: link skills together for endless variety
 - Earn XP with each combo and climb the ranks
 - Routines to music: become the next Lauren Jumps with longer sequences for flow and fitness
FAST-TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Prefer structure? Follow one of our jump rope courses:
 - Beginners Crash Course: 30 workouts in 6 weeks
 - Build stamina, nail footwork, and master tricks step by step
 - Earn XP as you go to stay consistent and motivated
TRACK & CELEBRATE YOUR JOURNEY
Use the built-in Journal to record videos, notes, and sessions. Track your progress visually over time and see how far you’ve come.
WHY JUMP ROPE?
Jump rope boosts heart health, burns fat fast, lowers anxiety, and builds coordination—all while being portable and fun. Whether you want to train like a boxer, improve CrossFit performance, or just find a workout you’ll actually enjoy, Fancy Feats makes it possible.
With the XP system, your progress is tracked, rewarded, and celebrated—so every session feels like a win.
Please note, a paid subscription is required to access any of the features of the app.
Privacy policy: https://www.fancyfeats.app/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.fancyfeats.app/terms

bluejetty:00161109:ios.summary:
古色古香的遊戲畫風，操作簡單的遊戲設置，引人入勝的遊戲玩法，多樣化的趣味文字謎題，這款益智類成語填填字，在方格之間，縱横交錯中，考驗你的文字儲備！簡單易上手，難度逐步增加，闖關模式，學習與挑戰兼備。寓教於樂，讓你在遊戲中感受文字的魅力！ 
規則講解： 
成語填填字是一款闖關類文字遊戲，遊戲界面由不同的横豎空格組成，在已知文字的提示下，將下方的零散文字正確填入上方縱横交錯的詞語空格之中，組成正確的成語就能獲得遊戲勝利！ 
遊戲特色： 
-闖關玩法，難度遞增，寓教於樂
bluejetty:00161109:ios.description:
古色古香的遊戲畫風，操作簡單的遊戲設置，引人入勝的遊戲玩法，多樣化的趣味文字謎題，這款益智類成語填填字，在方格之間，縱横交錯中，考驗你的文字儲備！簡單易上手，難度逐步增加，闖關模式，學習與挑戰兼備。寓教於樂，讓你在遊戲中感受文字的魅力！ 
規則講解： 
成語填填字是一款闖關類文字遊戲，遊戲界面由不同的横豎空格組成，在已知文字的提示下，將下方的零散文字正確填入上方縱横交錯的詞語空格之中，組成正確的成語就能獲得遊戲勝利！ 
遊戲特色： 
-闖關玩法，難度遞增，寓教於樂 
-行走的成語庫，隨時聯繫，點開即玩 
-古風古韻的遊戲界面，清新護眼的風格 
-逐步解鎖遊戲關卡，在積累中掌握成語奧祕 
-靈動舒緩的遊戲音樂，完美解壓，放松大腦 
-規則說明一目了然，上手就會，操作簡單 
-答題講解，成語釋義讓你快速學習成語 
-提示和求助功能幫助你快速過關 
成語是中國博大精深的漢字文化的代表之一，融合了文字和文化的精髓。這款成語填填字遊戲，在展現中國成語文化的同時，讓你輕鬆學習成語，瞭解成語釋義，在遊戲中學習成語的魅力。 畫面清新動人，操作簡單易懂，玩樂與學習兼備。閑暇時光來一局，提神醒腦，自我挑戰。難度逐步增加，階梯闖關模式，讓你循序漸進地掌握詞語，學習起來毫無壓力。單機遊戲，無需聯網，下載即玩，趕緊來挑戰吧！
我們希望您在玩我們遊戲的同時，也能收穫好心情！我們會經常更新我們的遊戲，所以別忘了下載最新的版本以獲取最新的關卡和功能！如果您有任何反饋或疑問，請與我們聯繫！
*依遊戲分級管理辦法，此軟體為普遍級。
*本遊戲免費下載，內有部分付費內容。
*請注意遊戲時間，避免沉迷。

bluejetty:00038947:ios.summary:
Embark on an epic anime adventure in "Lord of Heroes"!
Dive into a stunning anime world where you become the Lord of Avillon. Lead your heroes to reshape the destiny of nations in this immersive anime RPG.
[A TALE OF TRIUMPH AND SACRIFICE]
bluejetty:00038947:ios.description:
Embark on an epic anime adventure in "Lord of Heroes"!
Dive into a stunning anime world where you become the Lord of Avillon. Lead your heroes to reshape the destiny of nations in this immersive anime RPG.
[A TALE OF TRIUMPH AND SACRIFICE]
As the Lord of Avillon, you'll embark on a gripping journey filled with trials, triumphs, reunions, and farewells. Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and leadership as your decisions shape history. Uncover the mysteries of this mystical anime world through various chapters and side stories, including the War of the Tyrants and more.
[MEET EXTRAORDINARY ANIME HEROES]
Collect a diverse cast of heroes featuring stunning 3D anime models, each with unique personalities and rich backstories. Summon heroes with Linkstones or recruit them for free through gameplay using Renown and Crystals—currencies anyone can gather just by playing the game! Discover alternate versions of these heroes from different timelines, offering fresh perspectives and exciting narratives. Celebrate their birthdays with in-game events, collect special photocards, and delve into the intricate relationships between heroes in their story archives.
[STRATEGIC MASTERY IN TURN-BASED COMBAT]
Master an intricate turn-based combat system with limitless combinations of anime heroes. Utilize strategic gameplay mechanics like Chain Burst to unleash multiple ultimate skills in one turn, turning the tide of even the toughest battles. With smart resource management and careful hero selection, outmaneuver complex boss mechanics and conquer challenging content such as the Nightmare difficulty of the story or the Obelisk, even with heroes that have yet to unlock their full potential.
[YOUR ADVENTURE, YOUR PACE]
Lord of Heroes respects your time while offering a wealth of content for both casual and hardcore anime RPG fans. Passively level up your heroes in the Dakkeon Training Grounds, complete quick daily dungeons for valuable resources, and unite with fellow Lords to challenge formidable foes in joint raids like Silent Straits and Calamity's Cradle. Join a global community and become part of the ultimate anime experience.
What are you waiting for? Join the adventure and become the Lord of Avillon now!

bluejetty:00131548:ios.name: Pure Mods for Melon Playground
bluejetty:00131548:ios.summary: Big room with unlimited freedom of action, experimental physics and an impressive collection of tools, characters and scenery. You can do whatever you want with our wide variety of mods. With our Mods for Addon Playground you can use your c
bluejetty:00131548:ios.description:
Big room with unlimited freedom of action, experimental physics and an impressive collection of tools, characters and scenery. You can do whatever you want with our wide variety of mods. With our Mods for Addon Playground you can use your creativity to the maximum possibility. Game area give players many choices to create different character incidents between items. No matter where are you on the room you will be a part of a big experiment with car crashes, tanks and weapons, dinosaur appearing, big buildings with tons of furniture. We have collected the most interesting mods on various topics such as: weapons, animal mods, cars mod, furniture, tanks and technics, different buildings and many other. You have possibility to own many unique weapons to take down random obstacles. If you are looking for Addon Playground Mods that challenging and fun you definitely try our app !
A big changes is preparing for you new features in the app, such as the ability to use the mod creator. Now you can change mods in our library as you like, for example change the size or texture. Now using mods with creator will become much more interesting for you because you can change existing mods as you like.
Features:
- Mod creator feature
- Ability to edit and create new mods from library
- Share created mod with friends
- Friendly user interface
- Exclusive collection of different mods and add-ons
- Guns, pets, trucks, decoration mods, build
- Сombat vehicles, heavy military equipment
- Hundreds different items and mods possibilities
DISCLAIMER: This is an unofficial app. The application helps to install and familiarise yourself with the mod for the game Playground, this is not a game, but an add-on with instructions! If you feel there are trademark violations which don’t fall under the “fair use” rules, please contact us by email.
Information about our premium plans:
Our app provides Two Premium Subscription. The subscription plan is renewing automatically but you can cancel it any time.
Get Premium and enjoy:
- Creator - Create, edit, modify mods and add-ons
- Unlimited use of any Addon Playground Mods.
- Regular update of mods database.
- No advertising.
- Use unlimited any new features added to the app.
* Melon Premium - the duration of the plan is one month (which comes with a 3-day free trial) and the price is 9.99 USD per month.
* Melon Premium Special Offer - the duration of the plan is one week (which comes with a 3-day free trial) and the price is 2.99 USD per week.
* Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term. Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.You can cancel your subscription via this url: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
Please before using our app read our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. You can find them on links below:
Privacy Policy: https://melonmods.iosappdevelop.xyz/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://melonmods.iosappdevelop.xyz/terms.html

bluejetty:00087774:ios.description:
SingleMuslim, the world's leading Muslim introduction agency. Download the free Single Muslim app and search our database of over 2 million Muslim singles worldwide. Find your perfect Muslim marriage partner today!
The SingleMuslim app will enable you to:
 • Create a free Muslim dating profile.
 • View Muslim singles living near you.
 • Update your profile and upload photos.
 • View the photo gallery to see who's online.
 • Send and receive messages whilst on the move.
 • See who's been viewing your profile.
 • Search profiles using advanced search criteria.
 • View detailed profiles of members in your area.
 • British, American, Canadian, Australian and Arab Dating.
We use the latest technology to provide a safe online, interactive environment to find your ideal marriage partner. 
Our unique service is run by Muslims, for single Muslims and offers unrivalled opportunities for SingleMuslims to meet potential Islamic marriage partners online.
SingleMuslim members can take advantage of our exclusive online service and can search an extensive, current and growing international database with the assurance of complete privacy. Our rapidly expanding, international database means that the chances of finding the right partner are second-to-none.
Download the app and start your search today!
Add a widget showing potential partners and shortcuts for any notifications, new messages and likes.
Subscription Benefits :
 • Send, read and reply to messages
 • Store messages for more than 30 days
 • See who’s been viewing your profile
 • Priority gold member support
Subscription Prices :
 • 1 month subscription: £29.99**
 • 6 month subscription: £59.99**
 • 12 month subscription: £119.99**
**Prices are in U.K. pound sterling, may vary in countries other than the U.K. and are subject to change without notice.
Please note that with all subscriptions: 
 • Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
 • Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current one/six/twelve month periods. 
 • Auto-renewal may be turned off through the App Store on your Apple device or through the iTunes store on your computer. Once you turn off auto-renewal, your subscription will expire at the end of the current billing cycle. See our Terms of Use Agreement below for more information on our cancellation policy.
Privacy policy: https://singlemuslim.com/page/privacy_security
Terms of service: https://singlemuslim.com/page/terms_and_conditions

bluejetty:00069375:ios.name: CostaLine - Rutas en Autobus
bluejetty:00069375:ios.summary:
CostaLine te ayuda a consultar horarios de autobuses, viajes y rutas en autobús. También podrás comprar tu boleto de transporte público desde nuestra app.
Además ofrecemos servicios de transporte de envíos de Paquetería y Mensajería ligera
bluejetty:00069375:ios.description:
CostaLine te ayuda a consultar horarios de autobuses, viajes y rutas en autobús. También podrás comprar tu boleto de transporte público desde nuestra app.
Además ofrecemos servicios de transporte de envíos de Paquetería y Mensajería ligera con servicio a través de nuestras oficinas ubicadas a lo largo de nuestras rutas.
CostaLine te permite ver rutas de viaje y comprar tu boleto de autobús de forma rápida y sencilla. Beneficiate de nuestros descuentos y promociones para viajar en autobús. Una vez conozcas tu destino, elige los asientos de autobús y compra tu boleto.
DESCUENTOS COSTALINE
Al viajar con CostaLine autobuses no solo obtienes la comodidad y buen servicio en tu viaje, además recibes los mejores descuentos y ofertas para lograr una mejor experiencia de viaje con tu boleto:
• Beneficios en Hoteles
• Beneficios en Restaurantes
• Beneficios en Entretenimiento
• Beneficios en Actividades turísticas
También contamos con dos promociones: 
- Compra tu boleto de autobús en nuestra página web y obten un 15% de descuento al comprar tu viaje redondo
- 10% de descuento por la compra de boleto redondo en taquillas.
RENTA DE AUTOBUSES TURISMO GRAN CLASE
Si necesitas rentar un autobús o varios autobuses para viajar, contamos con servicios perfectos para cubrir tus necesidades. El servicio de Turismo Gran Clase de CostaLine, cuenta con dos opciones de capacidad (24 o 44 asientos) para su comodidad y necesidades de transporte.
BOLETOS DE AUTOBÚS
Contamos con distintos boletos de autobús, para que puedas comprar de la forma que más te guste, ya sea compra física, electrónica, vía telefónica y el boleto abierto para cuando quieras viajar en nuestros autobuses a una ciudad desconociendo la fecha. 
GANA PUNTOS DOTERS COSTALINE
Doters te da puntos por cada viaje que hagas. ¡Solo tienes que unirte gratis a nuestro programa de recompensas, viajar y ganar!
• Boletos recompensa
• Abordaje prioritario en nuestros autobuses
• Descuentos en paquetería
COSTAPASS
Monedero electrónico que te dará más dinero de acuerdo a la cantidad que abones. Con este monedero electrónico podrás pagar tu boleto de autobús en CostaLine para la ruta Chilpancingo-Acapulco, Acapulco-Chilpancingo.
Beneficios con Costa Pass:
- Recarga de $100 a $199 pesos y te abonamos el 10% de tu recarga
- Recarga de $200 a $399 pesos y te abonamos el 15% de tu recarga
- Recarga de $400 pesos o más y te abonamos el 20% de tu recarga
ENVÍOS DE PAQUETERÍA Y MENSAJERÍA
CostaLine ofrece servicios de transporte para el envío de paquetería y mensajería ligera en Servicio Ocurre. Tu solo entrega el paquete en nuestras oficinas de la plaza origen, donde este es enviado, una vez que se encuentra el sobre o paquete en nuestras oficinas de la plaza destino el cliente al que va dirigido el envío puede recogerlo presentando una identificación oficial vigente.
DESTINOS MÉXICO
CostaLine te lleva a viajar a las Ciudades más importantes del país en autobuses, consulte todas nuestras rutas y horarios de autobús.
Compra tu boleto de autobús en cualquiera de nuestros puntos de venta y taquillas a destinos como: Acapulco,Alpuyeca, Ciudad Altamito, Ciudad de México (cdmx), San Luis San Pedro, Chilpancingo, Cuernavaca, entre otras ciudades. ¡Transporte publico a cualquier ciudad de México!
Planifica tus viajes y rutas en autobús. Con CostaLine viajarás tranquilo y cómodo, consulta nuestros horarios de autobuses, encontrará sus puntos de venta o taquillas donde podrá comprar su boleto de transporte, o si lo prefiere puede comprar su boleto para viajar desde la app. 
Descarga la app y compra tu boleto para viajar en autobús. Podrás disfrutar de promociones y ver todas nuestras rutas y horarios de autobuses.

bluejetty:00074332:ios.name: play:Sub Music Streamer
bluejetty:00074332:ios.summary: Your music, from your own server, everywhere. play:Sub plays your Navidrome, Gonic, Subsonic or other Subsonic-compatible library on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in the car with CarPlay, on Chromecast or through your server's Jukebox - streamed in
bluejetty:00074332:ios.description:
Your music, from your own server, everywhere. play:Sub plays your Navidrome, Gonic, Subsonic or other Subsonic-compatible library on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in the car with CarPlay, on Chromecast or through your server's Jukebox - streamed in the quality you choose, or offline.
NEW: AUTO SYNC
• Keeps your starred songs, albums and artists, your newest albums or any playlist on your device, automatically
• Choose per source: Download to keep it, or Cache to let it make room for other music
NEVER LET THE MUSIC STOP
• Auto DJ keeps playing when the queue runs out, with music related to what you started
• Or pick an Auto Play mode: favorite artists, random albums, newest additions, artist radio, decade radio and more
SERVERS
• Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic, Ampache, Funkwhale, Booksonic, Subsonic and more
• OpenSubsonic support
• Multiple servers, with easy switching
• Some servers need their Subsonic API turned on
AUDIO
• FLAC, ALAC, AAC, MP3, OGG, WAV, AIFF, WEBM and more, without transcoding
• Lossless and gapless playback, hi-res up to 24-bit/192 kHz
• 10-band equalizer with presets, crossfade and ReplayGain
• Playback speed from 0.5x to 2x
• Audio Visualizer, and lyrics where your server has them
PLAY ANYWHERE
• iPhone, iPad and Mac (Apple silicon): any orientation, multitasking and resizable windows
• CarPlay: your library, the play queue, server switching, and album and artist pages with play and shuffle buttons
• Chromecast and Subsonic Jukebox
• AirPlay, Bluetooth, headphone and car controls, Lock Screen and Control Center
• Home Screen widgets you can play from
• Picks up again after phone calls
OFFLINE
• Download music to keep it, or let the cache fill and trim itself
• Played tracks are cached automatically, upcoming tracks preloaded
• Download or cache single tracks or whole albums, artists, folders and playlists
• Cached audio is upgraded to a better bitrate when available
• Background downloads
• The same app offline: browse, play, star and edit playlists, synced when you are back online
BROWSE AND DISCOVER
• Artists, albums, songs, folders, genres, decades and record labels
• Playlists, favorites, podcasts, audiobooks and bookmarks
• Recently added, frequently played and random
• Artist radio, top songs and similar artists
• Internet radio: your server's stations, plus 20,000+ from radio-browser.info
• Search everything, filter by media folder or show only starred
• Long-press anything for the actions that fit
PLAYLISTS AND FAVORITES
• Create, edit and delete playlists, personal or shared
• Star artists, albums, songs, folders and record labels
• 5-star ratings
MAKE IT YOURS
• Customizable tabs and library order
• Light and dark themes that follow the system, or your own colors
• Alternate app icons
• Sleep timer
CONNECTION
• HTTPS, including self-signed certificates
• Token authentication on Subsonic 5.3+ servers
• Separate bitrates for cellular and Wi-Fi, with overrides for slow or fast Wi-Fi networks
SCROBBLING
• Scrobbles to Last.fm through your server, and updates Now Playing
• Cached plays count too; offline plays are scrobbled when back online
Requires a server with the Subsonic API 1.8 or newer (Subsonic 4.8+; Subsonic itself needs a Premium license for apps). Some features depend on your server, such as top songs, artist radio, similar artists and record labels.

bluejetty:00146336:ios.description:
Make self-care a priority with the Amaha app (formerly InnerHour)
Find high quality care to overcome depression, beat anxiety, & improve your overall mental health.
Amaha is your safe space for self-care.
At Amaha we believe in quality mental health support and Amaha is a fresh approach to the same. Our psychiatrists and psychologists have used their insights from therapy along with the latest science in CBT (Cognitive Behaviour Therapy), Positive Psychology, and Mindfulness to translate the real-life therapy experience into self-care modules.
Change your life for the better with 500+ therapy-based self-help tools designed for depression, anxiety, and other mental health concerns.
Six self-help courses
• Depression: Build hope by overcoming depression
• Anxiety: Attain calm with anxiety relief
• Sleep: Build healthy habits to sleep better
• Stress: Feel in control of your stress
• Anger: Learn to manage anger better
• Happiness: Develop key skills to feel happier in life
So what does your plan entail?
1. Self-care activities
Learn skills for good mental health with our self-care activities - each of which draws from real-life therapy and mental health research in the fields of CBT, Positive Psychology, or Mindfulness.Practise affirmations, find mindfulness meditations, get guided journal exercises, & more!
2. Goal setting and tracking
Build habits for good mental health that will last a lifetime by setting and tracking self-care goals. This CBT-inspired feature will empower you to stay on track to become your best version.
3. Mood tracking
Check-in with yourself with our specialised mood tracker! Get insights into your mental health & figure out simple self-care solutions to feel better over time.
4. Amaha Resources
We want you to keep learning on your mental health journey. Our resources include articles, tips, and inspiring quotes to help you stay motivated. For instance, you will:
• Understand the different causes of depression
• Learn about the symptoms of anxiety
• Know how to tell if it’s time to go to therapy
Your self-help plan reflects what happens in real life therapy and will help you practise skills to battle depression, get anxiety relief, and ultimately attain good mental health.
Your self-care journey doesn’t end here…
• Access additional self-help courses
Just like in therapy, our app offers support for more specific concerns like overthinking, social anxiety, loneliness & more with our additional courses.
• Feel less alone with Allie
In times of distress, talk to Allie, our intelligent chatbot. Allie identifies your mental health difficulty - be it anxiety or depression - and offers simple activities to help you feel calm immediately.
Looking for more than just self-help? We’ve got you covered.
• Get professional support from Amaha professionals
Reach out to an Amaha therapist to talk about your concerns - be it depression or anxiety. You can even get diagnosis and medication support with qualified Amaha psychiatrists.
Treat yourself to unlimited self-care, starting today!
The Amaha app(formely InnerHour) is free to download for all. A subset of our offerings is available for free forever.
For any questions, you can reach out to us on support@amahahealth.com
Disclaimer: Always seek your doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00079292:ios.description:
Capture 365 Journal is a beautiful and easy to use diary/journal. You will have complete access to your journals all the time, allowing you capture your thoughts and special moments throughout the day.
KEY FEATURES
- Sync with iCloud, Dropbox or 365 Direct Sync.
- Sync with Capture 365 Journal Mac.
- Shared Syncing with other people.*
- Cloud Sync service data encryption.
- Location and Weather.
- Multiple photos and videos.
- Add multiple journal entries each day
- Multiple journal tags per entry.
- Automatically import events and social media posts* to your journals.
- Passcode & Touch ID protection.
- Automated backups.
- Export your journals as email, PDF or RTF by dates and tags.
- Custom font style and sizing.
- Search and view your journals by tags and locations.
- Reminders.
- Supports right to left writing direction.
- User customisable templates.
- Rich text support.
- Multiple journal support.
- 365+ Automation (Automatic Journaling)*
Sync Support
Sync and store your data on cloud services such as iCloud or Dropbox. Alternatively, sync using 365 Direct Sync. 365 Direct Sync will transmit directly to your other devices over your local network. 
Keep your journals in sync - no matter if you're on the Mac, iPad or iPhone.
Shared Syncing*
Create, edit, view and sync your journal entries with your family and friends. 
Multiple Photos and Videos
Attach multiple photos and videos to each of your journal entries.
Location and Weather

bluejetty:00081918:ios.description:
Download NOW the BEST Scan and Translate app in the WORLD and instantly translate business documents, contracts, homework assignments, menus, street signs and other images. GET MORE than 90 different languages which are available for translation!
Scan & Translate app extracts texts from any printed sources: documents, books, signs, instructions or announcements and allows to immediately translate them to any of 90 languages. 
Take a picture of the text and after the text is recognized, you can immediately edit, hear, translate, share it on Facebook, Twitter, vKontakte or simply send by email or as SMS.
Better and faster than any other similar product!
70% cheaper than any other similar app, offered by competitors!
• Recognizes texts in more than 70 languages
• Translates to more than 90 languages
• Reads texts in more than 44 languages
• Advanced optical character recognition technology for 79 languages, including Russian, English, German, Spanish, Greek, Turkish, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese, French ( Internet connection is required)
• Full text translation for more than 90 languages (Internet connection is required)
• Listen to the text that has been recognized and translated into more than 44 languages!
• Edit the text, copy it to clipboard, and save in other apps
• Share the text on Facebook, Twitter, VKontakte or send as SMS or by email
• All texts are saved in History and can be later recovered at any time
With Scan & Translate app you can easily scan and translate:
• any paper documents
• recipes from cookbooks
• notes and letters
• menus in restaurants, bars, and cafes
• articles from magazines and newspapers
• book parts
• instructions and manuals
• texts on product labels
• road signs as well as signs in airports and stations
• and many more...
How to use the app:
• Select the language of the original text as text recognition language.
• Take a picture of the document (page, instruction, or any other text)
• Press the "Scan" button
• Recognized text will appear on the screen with an option to select the source language and the target (translation) language.
• After you select the language, the original text will be automatically translated and will appear at the bottom of the screen.
• To listen to the translation, press the "Voice" button
Scan & Translate app will digitize and translate any printed text right on your device!
*Note: The Free version may be subject to limitations (ex. number of daily translations), which are subject to change***
Take advantage of the Premium Features:
- Unlimited translations
- Ads-free translation experience
For complete access to Scan & Translate and all language change features, you will need to allow access to the following: 
*Camera 
*Photos 
Note: The Free version may be subject to limitations (ex. number of daily text recognitions and translations), which are subject to change 
Сhoose from different subscription options. Our standard subscription options are: 1-month Subscription 
1-year Subscription 
Subscription plans unlock: 
- Unlimited translations 
- Unlimited text recognitions 
- Offline Text Recognition
- Offline translations 
- Ads-free translation experience 
- Snap Mode 
You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by canceling your subscription through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service. Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.

bluejetty:00133215:ios.name: رحَّال | Rahhal
bluejetty:00133215:ios.summary: Rahhal is a map for trips beyond the signal: desert drives, camping, off-roading, wadis and mountains in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. Download the map before you leave, save every place, record the trip and replay it in 3D. In Arabic and Engl
bluejetty:00133215:ios.description:
Rahhal is a map for trips beyond the signal: desert drives, camping, off-roading, wadis and mountains in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. Download the map before you leave, save every place, record the trip and replay it in 3D. In Arabic and English.
Offline Maps:
- Pick the Rahhal Map Engine, download any region, then browse, search and navigate it with no signal at all.
- Or use the Apple Map Engine online, with satellite and 3D views; switch at any time.
Map And Navigation:
- Standard, satellite, hybrid and terrain styles.
- Tap any place to navigate, open it in another map app, save or share it.
- Navigation is a straight line with live direction and distance; off-road there are no turns.
Paste Any Location:
- Paste a link from Google Maps, Apple Maps, HudHud, Waze and other map apps and Rahhal finds the place.
- Or paste coordinates, a Plus Code or a geohash, drop a pin, or use the location in a photo. Coordinates work offline; links need a connection.
Your Library:
- Places, tracks, collections and favorites in one library with search across it all, notes and photos per place, and Google Maps lists.
- Open a place to see its weather and prayer times.
- Point the camera and your saved places appear over the real view with distance and direction, and so does the Qibla.
Trip Recording:
- One tap starts recording; it runs in the background, pauses and resumes, and picks up where it stopped if the app closes or the device restarts.
- Stopping saves distance, elevation, speed, charts and every point.
- Follow it on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities.
- Import GPX, JSON and .rahhal files; export GPX, KML, CSV, JSON or .rahhal.
3D Track Flyover:
- Replay any saved track as a cinematic flight over the real terrain, with speed, distance and elevation playing back live.
CarPlay:
- Navigate to a saved place, start and stop recording, browse the library and search from the car screen.
Siri And Shortcuts:
- Start or stop a recording, save where you are, navigate to a saved place or find the Qibla with Siri, Spotlight or the Shortcuts app.
Mini-Apps:
- A tap from the Yard: the Quran with a choice of reciters, prayer times and Qibla, weather and rain radar, compass, speedometer, 16 themes and 22,000 public places in Saudi Arabia.
- Prayer times are computed on your device and work offline.
Yard And Daily Briefing:
- The Yard is your home screen: location, weather, library and mini-apps.
- The Daily Briefing sums up the weather, the next prayer and what to wear, written on your device by Apple Intelligence where supported.
iPad And iPhone Duo:
- On iPad and the unfolded iPhone Duo, search, recording and place cards sit beside the map.
- On iPad, keep the map in one Rahhal window and the Yard in another, side by side.
Account And Sync:
- Sign in with your phone number to sync your library across devices; what you saved before comes along.
- Add a username, photo and bio to your profile. It all works offline and syncs when you are back in range.
Rahhal+:
One membership includes the Rahhal Map Engine, CarPlay, trip statistics, Live Activities, Siri and Shortcuts, augmented reality, import and export, weather, the Daily Briefing, custom themes and links from most map apps.
Support: https://rahhal.app
Privacy: https://rahhal.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00172122:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00172122:ios.description:
Record the calls that matter, then let AI turn them into something you can actually use.
Record Talk records incoming and outgoing calls by merging them with a recording line, so it works on any carrier and any device — no rooting, no accessibility hacks, no special hardware. Every call is announced before recording starts, so everyone on the line knows.
WHAT YOU GET AFTER EVERY CALL
• A speaker-labelled, timestamped transcript. Tap any line to jump straight to that moment in the audio; the active line follows along as you listen.
• A summary you can read in fifteen seconds — key points, decisions made, and action items with the person responsible.
• Suggested follow-ups you can keep as a checklist and tick off later.
• An automatically suggested title, so your library never fills up with unnamed numbers.
ASK YOUR CALLS ANYTHING
Ask a question across everything you have recorded — "what did the contractor quote for the roof?", "who agreed to send the paperwork?" — and get an answer with the calls it came from. Language is detected automatically, and transcripts can be translated.
A LIBRARY BUILT FOR REAL USE
• Full-text search across titles, notes and transcripts
• Folders, tags, starred calls, rename and private notes
• Sort by date or duration, pull to refresh, and an offline cache so your library opens instantly
• Delete removes the audio and every piece of derived text, everywhere
A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Waveform scrubbing, 15-second skips, 0.75x to 2x speed, background playback with lock-screen controls, and it remembers where you stopped.
SHARE AND EXPORT
Send the audio file, export the transcript as text, or copy the summary straight into an email or a message.
WHO IT IS FOR
Journalists and researchers keeping an accurate record of interviews. Freelancers and contractors capturing what was agreed. Sales and support teams who need the details right. Anyone who has ever put down the phone and realised they missed a number, a date or a name.
RECORD RESPONSIBLY
Call recording laws differ by country and state. Record Talk announces recording to all parties at the start of every call, and you are responsible for obtaining any consent your jurisdiction requires.
SUBSCRIPTION
Record Talk is a subscription. Recording, playback, transcripts, AI and export require an active plan; plans and current prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. A subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of that period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://record-calls-ios-nsbv.pages.dev/p/record-calls-ios/privacy

bluejetty:00184607:ios.description:
Discover Spiky, the Truth or Dare game that turns your nights with friends or your partner into unforgettable moments!
Think you know the people around you? Now's your chance to find out.
A GAME FOR EVERY MOOD
Spiky adapts to your night with different levels, from light and easy to seriously challenging. The app also includes levels designed for kids and families.
WITH FRIENDS
FUN → Fresh truths and dares to ease into the game.
FUN EXTREME → Step it up: ask the questions that reveal your friends' secrets and stories.
FOR COUPLES
SOFT → Ease into the game with light questions and challenges.
HOT → Pick up the pace with playful twists and unexpected challenges.
HARD → Step it up with trickier challenges and more surprising questions.
EXTREME → For players ready to take on the toughest challenges and answer honestly.
FOR FAMILIES
Spiky also includes two levels made for kids and families:
Indoors → Challenges to take on at home using everyday items.
Outdoors → The perfect level for having fun outside on a nice day.
HUNDREDS OF HOURS OF PLAY
Tired of Spin the Bottle or Would You Rather? Spiky has more than 1,000 challenges to play with friends, your partner, or the whole family. We pick the best dares to guarantee a memorable time, and the game has zero ads. New challenges are added regularly.
A GAME MADE FOR YOU
Spiky adapts to you. Set your preferences:
Your gender
Your orientation and the players you want to interact with
Couple mode or friends mode
HOW TO PLAY
Launch the app
Choose your level
Enter your names and preferences
Spin the wheel to pick a random player
Choose Truth or Dare!
YOUR IMAGINATION IS THE ONLY LIMIT
Beyond the thousands of built-in challenges, create your own truths and dares with custom challenges for a night that's all yours.

bluejetty:00042146:ios.name: Fio: Catholic Music & Podcasts
bluejetty:00042146:ios.summary: Fio is a home for Catholic music, podcasts, and audiobooks, built on the belief that this work deserves to be found, trusted, and fairly paid for. Every artist, host, and author here is a practicing Catholic whose work is shaped by the fait
bluejetty:00042146:ios.description:
Fio is a home for Catholic music, podcasts, and audiobooks, built on the belief that this work deserves to be found, trusted, and fairly paid for. Every artist, host, and author here is a practicing Catholic whose work is shaped by the faith, and every listen supports the person behind it. For listeners, that means one place to find content you can rely on and hand to your family. When you press play on Fio, you take up a role the Church has held for centuries: patron of the arts.
Fio brings over 100,000 hours of Catholic content into one app: 1,000+ podcasts, thousands of songs, and 350+ audiobooks, with new releases regularly. Every stream pays the creator behind it, at rates several times higher than the big platforms.
CATHOLIC MUSIC
Thousands of songs from Catholic artists across worship, chant, hip-hop, folk, rock, and everything in between, including releases from Novum Records, Floriani Media, and Catholic Music Initiative. No AI-generated music.
CATHOLIC PODCASTS
1,000+ Catholic podcasts in one place, organized into 60+ Catholic categories such as Apologetics, Theology of the Body, Church History, the Saints, and Catholic News. Follow shows like Pints with Aquinas and Abiding Together, and new episodes appear in your feed as soon as they're released.
CATHOLIC AUDIOBOOKS
350+ audiobooks from Sophia Institute Press, Word on Fire, TAN Books, Scepter Publishers, Pauline Books and Media, and the Theology of the Body Institute: spiritual classics, theology, the writings of the saints, and fiction. No credits and no per-book purchases. Audiobooks are included with Fio's premium plans.
FIND WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR
• Search the entire catalog by title, topic, creator, or theme
• Browse Catholic music genres, podcast categories, and audiobook subjects
• Listen to playlists curated by Fio for the liturgical seasons, prayer, study, work, and the drive
• Follow your favorite artists, hosts, and authors to see their latest releases in your feed
MAKE IT YOURS
• Save favorite songs, episodes, and books to your library
• Track your progress and pick up where you left off
• Create custom playlists for any mood, drive, or season
• Download music, podcast episodes, and audiobooks for offline listening
SAFE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Every creator is reviewed by the Fio team before their work goes live, and each one affirms the Catholic faith. You can also turn on the explicit content filter in settings to keep listening family friendly.
LISTEN ANYWHERE
Listen on iPhone, on Android, or in your web browser at play.fio.fm. Audiobooks are available in the iPhone and Android apps.
PLANS
Fio is free to download and listen. Premium plans offer an improved listening experience and access to audiobooks, and you can start with a free trial.
ABOUT FIO
Fio is made by Fio Technology, Inc., a team of Catholic creators and builders, and is used by listeners in more than 100 countries. New creators join every week, and more features are on the way.
All glory to God.
Questions or suggestions: info@fio.fm
Privacy Policy: https://www.fio.fm/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://fio.fm/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00070789:ios.summary:
The ultimate all-in-one app featuring the Books of Enoch, Jubilees, Jasher, Apocrypha, and the King James Bible (KJV)
FEATURES:
・Comprehensive Collection: Includes the Book of Enoch, Book of Jubilees, Book of Jasher, Apocrypha, and King J
bluejetty:00070789:ios.description:
The ultimate all-in-one app featuring the Books of Enoch, Jubilees, Jasher, Apocrypha, and the King James Bible (KJV)
FEATURES:
・Comprehensive Collection: Includes the Book of Enoch, Book of Jubilees, Book of Jasher, Apocrypha, and King James Bible (KJV) in one easy-to-use app.
・Audio Support: Built-in TTS (Text-To-Speech) to listen to the scriptures while reading.
・Completely Offline: No internet connection required—access all books anytime, anywhere.
・Auto-Scrolling Mode: Continuous reading without touching the screen.
・Customizable Reading Experience: Adjust font size, word spacing, line height, background color, and page margins.
・Full-Screen Mode: Immerse yourself in scripture without distractions.
・Bookmarks & Notes: Save favorite passages, take notes, and copy verses with a single tap.
・Highlighting Tool: Choose from multiple colors.
・Powerful search engine that lets you quickly find verses across all books of the Bible.
・Resume Function: Pick up where you left off with the Resume button.
・Portrait & Landscape Modes: Read in the orientation of your choice.
BOOKS INCLUDED FOR FREE:
The Book of Enoch:
The Book of Enoch is an ancient Hebrew apocalyptic religious text that is traditionally attributed to Enoch, the great-grandfather of Noah. This book is considered one of the most mysterious and controversial writings in biblical history, containing detailed prophecies, angelic history, and accounts of the Nephilim (giant offspring of fallen angels and human women).
・Origins of demons and fallen angels.
・The Genesis flood’s divine purpose.
・Final judgment and the Messiah’s reign.
・Heavenly visions and celestial mysteries.
・Though excluded from the Bible, early Jewish and Christian communities revered it, and it remains scripture in Ethiopian Orthodox Christianity. Fragments were found in the Dead Sea Scrolls, proving its antiquity.
The Book of Jubilees:
Also called "Little Genesis", this book retells Genesis and Exodus stories with extra details, claiming to be dictated to Moses by angels on Mount Sinai.
・49-year Jubilee cycles as a divine historical framework.
・Origins of Jewish laws (Sabbath, circumcision, dietary rules).
・Expanded patriarchal narratives (Adam, Noah, Abraham, Jacob).
・Prophecies about Israel and the Messiah.
・Though not in standard Jewish or Christian Bibles, it was preserved in the Dead Sea Scrolls and is respected in Ethiopian Orthodoxy.
The Book of Jasher:
Mentioned in Joshua 10:13 and 2 Samuel 1:18, the Book of Jasher (meaning "The Book of the Upright") expands on biblical events:
・Creation and early human history.
・The Great Flood and Noah’s warnings.
・Detailed stories of Abraham, Joseph, and Moses.
・An alternative account of the Exodus and Jericho’s fall.
The Apocrypha (Deuterocanonical Books):
The Apocrypha refers to ancient biblical books once included in the 1611 King James Bible (KJV) but removed in 1885. These books, still considered scripture by Catholic, Orthodox, and Ethiopian traditions, provide historical, theological, and moral insights from the intertestamental period.
・Additionally, the missing 70 verses of 2 Esdras, which were not included in the KJV Apocrypha but are available in the Cambridge Annotated Study Apocrypha and the NRSV Holy Bible with Apocrypha, are also referenced.
・Apocrypha / Deuterocanonical: Bible's Lost Books includes these books: 1 Esdras, 2 Esdras, Tobit, Judith, Additions to Esther, Wisdom of Solomon, Sirach, Baruch, the Letter of Jeremiah, Prayer of Azariah, Susanna, Bel and the Dragon, Prayer of Manasseh, 1 Maccabees, 2 Maccabees, and Laodiceans.
The King James Version (KJV):
The KJV remains one of the most influential Bible translations. Commissioned by King James I of England, it shaped English Christianity.
Many scholars and believers still consider the KJV the most authoritative translation of the Word of God.
Thank you for using the Books of Enoch, Jubilees, Jasher, Apocrypha & King James Version (KJV) Bible app.

bluejetty:00184257:ios.description:
A BPI APP foi renovada! Agora mais simples e intuitiva de usar!
Usabilidade
Novo design moderno e funcional, com acesso mais simples e direto no dia-a-dia 
MB Way
• Pague com o telemóvel, transfira para números de telefone e levante dinheiro sem necessidade de cartão
Seguros
• Conheça os seguros que melhor se adequam a si
Contas de outros Bancos
• Veja as suas contas de outros bancos e faça transferências dessas contas através da BPI App 
Com esta aplicação os Clientes BPI podem consultar e gerir as suas contas (do BPI e de outros Bancos), cartões e poupanças. 
Se é Cliente atual dos serviços BPI Net / BPI Direto, poderá de imediato aceder à BPI App, usando os códigos de acesso habituais.
Principais operações disponíveis:
Consultas
• Saldos e Movimentos de Contas e Cartões de Crédito
• Posição Integrada (Património e Crédito)
• Agenda de movimentos previstos para os próximos 30 dias
• Saldos e Movimentos de contas de outros Bancos
Transferências e Pagamentos
• Para beneficiários pré-definidos
• Para Contas BPI, contas de outros Bancos e para nº de telemóvel
• Transferências Imediatas
• Pagamentos de Serviços, Estado e Telemóveis
• Transferências, Pagamentos e Levantamentos MB Way
• Criação e gestão de Cartões MB Net
Cartões
• Cartões de Crédito: pedido de cartão, alteração de Limites de Crédito, alteração de opção de pagamento e pagamento de Saldo ou Reforço
• Adiantamento de numerário a crédito (Cash-Advance)
• Pedido de cancelamento e bloqueios de segurança
• Cartões Pré-Pagos: pedido de cartão, ativação, carregamento e consulta de saldos e movimentos
Poupança e Investimento
• Consulta da carteira de poupanças e investimentos
• Subscrição, reforço e resgate de fundos de investimento e produtos de reforma
• Criação e gestão de planos de poupança periódica
• Poupanças imediatas para os seus objetivos
Crédito
• Simulação e pedido de Crédito Pessoal, com dinheiro imediato na conta
• Consulta de catálogo e encomenda de Produtos Prestígio
As Minhas Finanças
• Organização e categorização automática dos movimentos da contas e cartões
• Resumo mensal e anual de receitas e despesas
• Definição de limites para as despesas e objetivos
E ainda
• Consulta e configuração de Alertas e Notificações
• Personalização de Contas (nome e de fotografia)
• Consulta e alteração de Dados Pessoais
• Canal de Comunicação com o Gestor de Conta ou BPI Direto
• Abertura Online de Conta
Gosta da nossa app? Pode avaliá-la e deixar-nos um comentário. A sua opinião é importante para que continuemos a melhorar!

bluejetty:00152550:ios.description:
Want to identify plants instantly?
Meet Plant Identify – Diagnose Plants, the app for plant lovers! Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced gardener, Plant Identify helps you recognize, care for, and nurture your green friends effortlessly.
What you’ll love about Plant Identify:
- Instant Plant Identification
See a plant you love but don’t know its name? Or have one at home and wonder what species it is? Just snap a photo, and Identify Plant’s AI will identify it for you!
- Comprehensive Plant Care Guides
Not sure how to take care of your plants? Get detailed care instructions for watering, fertilizing, pruning, repotting, and more. Make your plants healthier and happier!
- Smart Care Reminders
Worried about forgetting to water or fertilize your plants? Set personalized reminders for watering, fertilizing, and pruning so your plants always get the attention they need.
- Light Meter Tool
Wonder if your plant is getting enough sunlight? Use the built-in Light Meter to measure the light level and find the best spot for your plant.
- Plant Disease Diagnosis
Is your plant looking unhealthy? Simply take a photo, and Identify Plant will diagnose the problem and suggest treatment solutions so you can save your plant.
- Personalized Care Plans
Get custom care tips for each plant based on its species and needs. From snake plants to orchids, Identify Plant has you covered!
- Water Calculator & Repotting Check 
Easily determine your plant's water needs and frequency by snapping a photo. Take another photo to instantly check if your plant is ready for repotting, ensuring optimal root health and growth.
- Identify Everything
• Weed Identification: Easily identify common and obscure weeds in your garden and get immediate tips on how to control or remove them. Snap a photo to confirm if a new growth is a weed and receive effective management guidance.
• Allergen Plant Identification: Quickly identify allergen plants, receive crucial warnings, and learn immediate response measures to protect your health and well-being.
• Toxic Plant Identification: Instantly identify toxic plants and receive urgent safety warnings to keep your pets, children, and family safe. 
• Identify Birds, Insects, and Fish: Expand your knowledge of the natural world. Identify birds, insects, and fish around you through photos to learn more about these fascinating small creatures.
• Stone Identification: Use photos to identify the material and potential uses of various stones, turning every discovery into a learning moment.

* Unlimited plant identifications

bluejetty:00023776:ios.summary:
