bluejetty:00023776:ios.description:
Life Simulator. Enjoy your virtual Peaceful Kingdom and another life in there.
This may not be a game?(This is a game.)
Eternal time to get family and take over to descendants.
Unprecedented, stand-alone RPG and life simulator. Let's start the kingdom life now.
It's everything You want in a RPG.
Let's immigrate to the free and peaceful kingdom and enjoy your another life.
Enjoy a free life with love and adventure.
Quests, battles, item gathering, harvest, love, marriage, even raising children.
An easy-going, relaxed play experience. 
Real life takes on new meaning. 
 “WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom” is a simulation game that allows the player to enjoy a free lifestyle in an elaborate sandbox kingdom. The large number of AI characters that are moving about the kingdom and to whom the player can communicate make the player feel just as if they were playing an online game.
 Since it's release, “World Neverland - Elnea Kingdom” has seen over 60 updates with improvements and content enhancements reflecting the requests of players. 
X : https://x.com/WN_ElneaKingdom
【Game Outline】
 World Neverland is an original game made using an overhead community simulation system that is patented in Japan.
 What makes this game unique from others of the same genre is that it feels as if it is simulating a living society. The kingdom that sets the stage for this game includes details such as realms, buildings, and even a national system. This creates a virtual community in which hundreds of people live. The various AI characters act of their own free will. 
- The player arrives in this kingdom as a traveler, becomes a citizen, and then lives there.
- Each player has a house and field. The player can also save money to move into a mansion.
- The player can participate as the head of or a guest at events such as seasonal functions, state ceremonies, festivals, marriages, childbirths, and funeral services.
- Players can become friends with and marry other unmarried characters.
- Players can also work hard at a job or martial art to find success in this world.
- The player can also have several children to increase the size of their family.
- By transferring their control to offspring, the player can experience a long period of play over several generations of a family.
- Cooking can also be done using a variety of ingredients.
- Monsters can be defeated and dungeons or forests explored to gather resources or ingredients for cooking and making weapons.
- Martial arts tournaments can be entered, allowing players to compete to be the number one hero in the kingdom.
- The player is free to do, or not do, what they wish.
- The kingdom has a history of several hundred years, which can be read about in the library.
- Compatibility
Recommended iOS 13.0 or later. 
Compatible with iPhone, iPad
"Please note that the game is only available in English."

bluejetty:00141348:ios.description:
WHAT IS plusRN?
Your #1 Digital Preceptor
plusRN is your personalized, AI-enhanced clinical training and reference tool, built to accelerate your journey to becoming an experienced nurse by strengthening your Clinical Judgement and Core Competencies.
Now featuring Nurse Gia, your on-demand AI Preceptor, ready to answer any question related to nursing or the medical profession—24/7. Whether you need quick clinical insights, guidance on patient care, or help with assignments, Nurse Gia is here to support you every step of the way.
HOW DO YOU USE plusRN?
plusRN is your clinical companion at the bedside and beyond. It aligns with the Clinical Judgement Measurement Model (CJMM)—the new nursing process—to guide you through real-world patient care scenarios.
Assess clinical findings and recognize/analyze cues
Prioritize hypotheses and generate nursing/medical solutions
Fill out your care plan and TAKE ACTION
And when you need help—just ask Nurse Gia.
WHO IS plusRN DESIGNED FOR?
Nursing Students
New Graduates (BSN, ADN, LPN)
Preceptors and Clinical Instructors
Practicing Nurses needing just-in-time support
WHY USE plusRN?
We know how important it is to feel confident and competent while caring for patients. plusRN empowers you with the tools and knowledge you need to provide safe, effective care—from bedside interventions to SBAR communication.
With Nurse Gia, you never have to feel alone during clinicals or your first year on the job.
PLUS UP YOUR CLINICAL JUDGEMENT
plusRN guides you through each step of the CJMM:
Assess a Clinical Finding – Use a systems-based approach to identify and analyze cues.
Diagnose & Manage Care – Prioritize hypotheses and generate care plan solutions.
Nursing Interventions – Take Action! Access best-practice skills and nursing care tips.
Discharge Planning – Evaluate outcomes and prepare for next-level care.
SBAR – Communicate effectively with our structured script.
Ask Nurse Gia – Get immediate answers to nursing questions and clinical uncertainties.
GET 2-WEEKS FREE ACCESS
Explore all features, including unlimited questions to Nurse Gia, access to every clinical guide, and full reference functionality.
Don't feel paralyzed while developing your clinical skills—build confidence faster with plusRN.
TESTIMONIALS:
“Using plusRN at the bedside gives me confidence during my clinicals.”
— Brenna McClung, Student Nurse, San Diego State University
“I wish I had plusRN in nursing school! It would have been really helpful in my first job in Med/Surg as well.”
— Kelsey Moe, BSN, RN, St. Luke’s Medical Center
THE STORY BEHIND plusRN
We’re nurses too—and we’ve been where you are. Many schools and employers don’t fully prepare you to practice independently. That feeling of being overwhelmed? We get it.
That’s why we created plusRN. Our content was written and reviewed by nurses with over 100+ years of combined clinical experience. With best-practice guidance and now AI support through Nurse Gia, plusRN is your go-to app to strengthen your clinical judgement and sharpen your nursing core.
HOW TO GET STARTED:
Download plusRN
Open any topic to start strengthening your clinical judgement
Ask Nurse Gia anything—24/7 AI preceptor access
Reference best-practice points and take confident action
Approach every patient like an experienced nurse
Stop second-guessing yourself. Start becoming the nurse you want to be—faster.
Download plusRN today for FREE.

bluejetty:00019197:ios.description:
Ludo Club is a fast-paced multiplayer game to connect, chat, and compete – loved by 200M+ players worldwide!
Step into Ludo Club, the classic board game reimagined for fast, social multiplayer play. Designed for quick, competitive matches anytime, anywhere. Play with friends, family, or players around the world in quick 2 player games or full 4-player matches. Whether you’re playing online or enjoying offline games, every roll of the dice brings strategy, competition, and real connection.
How to Play
Ludo is easy to learn and fun to master!
Roll the dice and move your tokens based on the number you get. Get all your pieces from start to home before your opponents to win. Use smart strategy and perfect timing to block rivals, knock out their tokens, and earn extra turns. Plan every move, stay ahead of the competition, and rise to the top of Ludo Club!
Game Features
Multiplayer Fun
Play real-time multiplayer games with friends or challenge players worldwide in quick 2 player games or competitive 4-player matches.
Live Chat & Social Play
Stay connected with in-game chat – talk, react with emojis and stickers, and make every match more fun and engaging.
Game Modes
Switch between fast modes like Dash and Bold, or enjoy timer-based Rush mode and the most-loved Classic for a relaxed board game experience.
Customize Your Style
Make the game your own with a wide range of boards, dice, pawns, emojis, and backgrounds – stand out in every match.
Unique Power-Ups
Turn the game in your favor with strategic power-ups that give you control over the dice roll and help you outplay opponents when it matters most.
Rewards & Daily Bonuses
Earn in-game coins, unlock unique dice, boards, and more, and climb the leaderboard with rewarding daily bonuses.
Clubs
Join Clubs to connect with like-minded players, chat, send gifts, and build your own community.
Offline Games Mode
Play offline games anytime with no internet required – perfect for quick matches on the go.
Why Players Love Ludo Club?
Players relive the nostalgia of classic board games while enjoying a modern, competitive twist. With faster matches, social gameplay, and exciting features, every game is a chance to outplay rivals, sharpen your strategy, and win big.
It’s your turn – ready to roll the dice? Make your move, outplay your rivals, and claim your spot at the top. Join Ludo Club now!
Privacy Policy: https://moonfroglabs.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00159425:ios.name: Mouse Jiggler Undetectable
bluejetty:00159425:ios.summary:
Prevent your computer screen from locking with Mouse Jiggler.
Compatible with Windows and macOS computers, this application prevents your computer screen from locking by periodically moving your mouse cursor a few millimeters.
MAIN FEATUR
bluejetty:00159425:ios.description:
Prevent your computer screen from locking with Mouse Jiggler.
Compatible with Windows and macOS computers, this application prevents your computer screen from locking by periodically moving your mouse cursor a few millimeters.
MAIN FEATURES :
- Scrolling Mode : Scrolls an image and increases screen brightness at regular intervals to move your mouse cursor.
- Vibration Mode : Vibrates your phone at regular intervals to move your mouse cursor. (Vibration mode is not available on iPad)
- Power-saving Mode : Activates intermittently to consume less energy.
- Undetectable Mode : Use a random time interval between two animations to be practically undetectable by most monitoring systems.
- Completely Free App
ADVANCED SETTINGS :
- Vibration : Enable or disable vibration mode.
- Vibration Duration : Customize how long each vibration lasts. 
- Pause Duration : Set the time between two scrolls or vibrations.
- Brightness Level : Adjust the brightness level when the app activates. (Reducing it too much may impact effectiveness.)
COMPATIBILITY : 
Mouse Jiggler is officially compatible only with mice that use a visible red light (optical sensor).
Mice that use invisible light, such as infrared or laser sensors, are not supported — even if they might occasionally work. This is not a bug, but a limitation related to the sensitivity of the mouse sensor, as well as your phone’s maximum screen brightness and vibration power.
If you experience issues, we recommend using a mouse with a visible red optical sensor.
WHY CHOOSE MOUSE JIGGLER ?
- No Extra Hardware: Unlike USB dongles or jiggling pads, the app only needs your phone and your mouse.
- More Private: Unlike desktop software, this mobile app leaves no digital trace on your computer.
- Free & Convenient: A simple, cost-effective solution — similar hardware tools can cost up to $30.
DISCLAIMER : 
Do not use this app if it conflicts with your employer's policies.
Terms of Use: https://mousejiggler.lol/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://mousejiggler.lol/privacy.html

Enjoy the most addictive jigsaw sorting puzzle game, Jigsort Puzzles! Try it and get a unique and innovative jigsort puzzle experience now!
This great casual puzzle game, Puzzle Games - Jigsort Puzzles, combines the best features of jigsaw puzzles and sorting games to provide you with hours of fun and relaxation. Great jigsaw sorting game for you to relax

RoByte is a simple and easy to use Roku remote control app that works with your Roku Player or Roku TV.
Features:
• No Setup required, RoByte automatically scans for your Roku device
• Easy channel switcher
• Use your keyboard for fast text & voice entry on channels like Netflix, Hulu, or Disney+.
• View all your TV channels and jump directly to the one you like.
• Adjust your Roku TV's volume and toggle the input.
• Tablet support
• Wear OS support, quick access to play/pause from your wrist
• Navigate using D-pad or Swipe-Pad
• Pair with multiple Roku devices
• Customizable Widgets turn your Android homescreen into a Roku remote
• Option to keep the wifi from sleeping
• Beautiful design with material design
RoByte Free features:
• Roku remote control
• Play/pause, fast forward, rewind
• Pair with multiple Roku devices
RoByte Pro features:
• Roku channel switcher
• Power button
• Volume control
• Keyboard & Voice Search
• TV channels switcher
• Homescreen widgets
• Wear OS app
Supported Roku TVs:
• TCL
• Sharp
• Hisense
• Onn.
• Element
• Philips
• Sanyo
• RCA
• JVC
• Magnavox
• Westinghouse
With RoByte Roku TV Remote, we wanted everyone to have the best Roku remote app so we made the remote control functionality free.
Help Guide:
If you are having issues, please do the following on your Roku TV:
Go to Settings -> System -> Advanced System Settings -> Control by mobile apps, and select "Enabled"
Quick tips:
• Most problems connecting to your Roku can be resolved by simply reinstalling RoByte.
• RoByte can only connect if you are on the same wifi network as your Roku device.

listings.description:
To bestie or not to bestie that is the question in this epic break-up game. In Bestie Wars, you’ll win the love games and challenges to break up your bestie’s ‘ship so you can walk down (or race) the aisle. That’s right! Walk like a queen — because you are one!

They say all’s fair in true love and war. Well, not here! Only one pair can survive to the end…and you better win and get to put on that dreamy wedding outfit. Can you hear those wedding bells ringing?! That means it’s time to make the choice that will affect your entire relationship future! Eek!

Will you get married, meet your own boyfriend, or toss those casual relationships aside for true love? Choose your story in this fun game and discover if you’re on the path to true love. Each level is a whole new love episode where there can only be one winner.

Nothing is taboo when it comes to romance. So strap on those high heels, choose your style, show off those fashion skills and stun all those around. With so many different designs to choose from, you won’t struggle to create an outfit (or 10). But make sure you don’t miss out on fancy accessories—they are fire!

Now you’re ready for love interactive stories action! So what’s next? Now it’s time to do everything in your power to get your best friend to break up with their boo. Sabotage their relationship at every turn and get to the finish. Choices, choices…and remember the ones you make now are the difference between a perfect family simulator and a nightmare. So choose carefully and you step on the catwalk to win.

In addition to enhanced graphics and sound, this smartphone version also marks the title's overseas debut.
Drawing upon the roots of the series with such features as beautiful 2-D pixel art, a battle system involving job change-based character growth and ability combinations, and a classic story of light, darkness, and crystals, FINAL FANTASY DIMENSIONS delivers the best of FINAL FANTASY, retro and fresh alike, directly to you.
We hope you enjoy this wonderful new addition to the venerable FINAL FANTASY series.
----------------------
The game's prologue--the first arc in the story--is available for you to enjoy as a free download.
Subsequent chapters are available for purchase via the shop menu.
You can also switch background music from the game using Chiptune Arrange functionality!
Chiptune Arrange is also available for purchase in the shop. Just select "Chiptune BGM"!

bluejetty:00137283:ios.description:
Speed Demons is the ultimate highway racing simulator, with breakneck speeds, amazing physics-based crashes, and the most intense TRAFFIC ever seen in a video game. Featuring hundreds of events, tons of varied vehicles, endless highways, and 11 gameplay modes, this is the top-down, physics-based racing game the world has been waiting for.
Whether you want to leisurely cruise down the highway, weave through traffic at high-speeds, take out rogue racers, or just barrel through everything in sight, this game has it all:
* Drive over 50 upgradeable vehicles, from tiny hatchbacks to super cars to massive semi-trucks. 
* Play 11 distinct game modes including RACE, CHECKPOINT, ESCAPE, PURSUIT, RAMPAGE, and more.
* Choose from over 500 unique events, each customized to the vehicle(s) and mode featured.
Also featured in Speed Demons:
* Endless procedurally-generated highways in 30 environments.
* High-speed physics-based racing with up to 100 vehicles on-screen at once.
* Modern-retro visuals with spectacular effects and an all-new pulse-pounding soundtrack by Auvic.
* Simple but deep controls, and full MFi controller support.
* Seamless iCloud saving across multiple devices.
The joy of endless traffic awaits. Download Speed Demons today and experience the new revolution in highway racing games.
Speed Demons was previously seen on Apple Arcade.

bluejetty:00097001:ios.name: TextKeep - Text Message Export
bluejetty:00097001:ios.summary: TextKeep is the ultimate tool for saving and exporting chat history from any messaging app. Whether you need to print text messages for legal evidence, archive sentimental memories, or back up business conversations, TextKeep makes it simpl
bluejetty:00097001:ios.description:
TextKeep is the ultimate tool for saving and exporting chat history from any messaging app. Whether you need to print text messages for legal evidence, archive sentimental memories, or back up business conversations, TextKeep makes it simple.
Bring iMessage and SMS conversations straight from the Messages app on your iPhone, with no screenshots. Pick a chat and the dates (today, the past week, the past month or your own range), and TextKeep brings in every text with its sender, date and time. It works through a free Apple Shortcut that TextKeep helps you install. Your texts are read on your iPhone and are not uploaded for processing.
POWERFUL AI-DRIVEN EXPORT
For any other chat app, TextKeep uses advanced AI (OCR) to "read" your screenshots. This allows us to detect chat bubbles and timestamps with high accuracy, turning static images into editable, searchable text.
- KEY FEATURES
Messages Import: iMessage and SMS conversations straight from the Messages app, by chat and dates. No screenshots needed.
Auto-Stitch Screenshots: Import multiple overlapping screenshots, and TextKeep will magically stitch them into one long, seamless conversation view.
Export to PDF: Create a clean, professional PDF document of your chat, perfect for printing, sharing with lawyers, or archiving.
Export to Excel (CSV): Need the raw data? Extract the text into a spreadsheet format with separate columns for date, time and message.
Text & JPG Backup: Save the plain text file (.txt) or the long stitched image (.jpg) directly to your device.
Universal Compatibility: Works with WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Messenger, Signal, Instagram DMs, and any other chat interface.
Secure Processing: Screenshots are processed securely on our encrypted servers to ensure the highest quality stitching and text extraction, then deleted immediately after export. Messages Import works on your iPhone.
- PERFECT FOR
Legal Cases: Prepare court-admissible PDFs of text messages for divorce, custody, or small claims disputes.
Memory Books: Save relationships, funny group chats, or conversations with loved ones in a printable format.
Business Records: Archive client communications and order details.
- HOW IT WORKS
iMessage and SMS:
Install the TextKeep shortcut when the app asks.
Pick a conversation and the dates.
TextKeep brings in the texts, ready to export.
Any other chat app:
Take screenshots of your conversation or let the app do it for you.
Import them into TextKeep.
Our AI automatically orders and stitches them.
Then choose your format (PDF, CSV, TXT, or Image) and save! You can also print the original conversation or the processed version.
- SUBSCRIPTION
Weekly (weekly renewal) | Annual (annual renewal)
Auto-renews unless cancelled 24 hours before the period ends. Manage in App Store Account Settings.
- USEFUL LINKS
TextKeep uses secure, encrypted transmission for processing. See our Privacy Policy for more details:
https://novasoftapps.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/32380464491805
Terms and Conditions:
https://novasoftapps.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/32380791084445

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Have a feature request or need help?
support@novasoft.ro

- PERFECT FOR

Legal Cases: Prepare court-admissible PDFs of text messages for divorce, custody, or small claims disputes.

Memory Books: Save relationships, funny group chats, or conversations with loved ones in a printable format.

Business Records: Archive client communications and order details.

iMessage and SMS:

Pick a conversation and the dates.

Take screenshots of your conversation or let the app do it for you.
Import them into TextKeep.
Our AI automatically orders and stitches them.

bluejetty:00060877:ios.description:
Auction.com is the nation’s largest online real estate marketplace. We have 25,000+ exclusive listings and have completed more than $42B in sales. Buy foreclosure and bank-owned residential properties for sale, many at below market value. Download our app today to find your next investment opportunity. Key Features:
• NEW: Remote Bid now available in 15 states. Bid with convenience on foreclosure homes in real-time to expand your opportunities.*
• Stay up-to-date with push notifications from our app. Receive the latest news on foreclosure sales, auction cancellations, live events and more.**
• Save and edit foreclosure Purchase Profiles in the app for deed mailing and vesting info before the auction
• Register and bid on bank-owned properties directly from your device
• Access your saved properties and searches from any device or computer when you log in
• Review property information, photos and street view maps on the property details page
• Conduct due diligence (title information and property reports) from the property details page
• Receive push notifications for auction status on all saved properties (bank-owned and foreclosure homes)
• Easily reach brokers or agents for more information from every property details page
Auction.com’s mobile app gives you access to powerful features to search, bid and win properties on-the-go. Find houses by location, property features, auction date and more. Or use the interactive map to find homes in local or national markets. With the app, you can access property details, see photos and conduct your due diligence with free title and property reports, when available. Save your favorites to your dashboard and never lose track of them. You’ll typically receive emails when your favorites are postponed, canceled or cleared for sale. If you find a property that’s being auctioned, you may be able to use our app to bid directly from your device.
Auction.com has thousands of properties that are both foreclosed upon and bank-owned, also known as “REO or “Real-Estate Owned.” The properties consist of single-family homes, condos, townhouses, duplexes, fourplexes and land. The company lists auctions in all 50 states and Puerto Rico and serves the nation’s largest markets including Florida, Illinois, Texas, Ohio, Georgia, New York and California.
This app only shows residential properties in the US. Auction.com, LLC is a Thomas H. Lee Partners company. To share your feedback, send us an email at Mobile-Support@auction.com.
*Real-time bidding is available in select properties in AL, AR, AZ, CA, GA, ID, MO, MS, MT, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, and WA. Visit Auction.com/RemoteBid for details. **Status updates may be delayed in some counties.

bluejetty:00183640:ios.summary: ScoreSense® gives you quick, anytime access to your credit scores and reports from all three national credit reporting agencies – TransUnion, Equifax, and Experian. You’ll get daily credit monitoring and alerts about important changes to yo
bluejetty:00183640:ios.description:
ScoreSense® gives you quick, anytime access to your credit scores and reports from all three national credit reporting agencies – TransUnion, Equifax, and Experian. You’ll get daily credit monitoring and alerts about important changes to your report through your ScoreSense account.
Questions about your reports or scores? We have Credit Specialists to help you seven days a week. 
TOP FEATURES OF YOUR SCORESENSE ACCOUNT*:
• Credit scores and reports from all three credit bureaus: TransUnion, Equifax and Experian 
• Credit Specialists available to answer your credit questions
• Access to creditor contact information so you can address errors on your credit reports 
• If you are a victim of identity theft, we offer up to $1 million in ID theft insurance to each of our members
• Score Simulator shows your potential future credit scores based on hypothetical situations
• Credit Insights provide a detailed breakdown of what is affecting scores and reports
• MyCreditChecklist provides checklists for getting your finances in order when you want to buy a home or get a new car
• Learning center so you can learn all about what affects your credit rating
• Credit monitoring and alerts of activity or changes on your credit report 
• Ability to compare your scores to others in the U.S., your state or your age group 
• Reminder when your most recent credit scores are available and it’s time to update
• ID Protection Report for monitoring suspicious or fraudulent use of your name, address, social security number, driver's license, or credit/debit cards is an extra available feature.
APP FEATURES:
• Ability to view your credit reports from all three bureaus directly in the app
• Score tracking to see how your credit scores perform over time
• Monitoring of important factors affecting your score 
• Credit Facts and Credit Tips to help you understand your credit scores and reports
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
Q: Why is it important to check my credit scores?
A: Your scores help determine the interest rates you will be offered on mortgages, car loans, credit cards, and lines of credit. With good credit scores, you are often offered more favorable interest rates on loans and credit cards.
Q: How often should I check my credit scores and reports?
A: You should regularly review your credit scores and credit reports to ensure the information is accurate, uncover signs of fraud, and address errors that could adversely affect your scores.
Q: Will checking my credit scores affect my scores?
A: No. Checking your credit scores through the ScoreSense app or ScoreSense.com does not hurt your scores.
Q: How does credit monitoring work?
A: We monitor your credit report, daily, and notify you with a credit alert when a change or suspicious activity is detected that could pose a threat to your credit scores or be a red flag for possible identity theft.
*Note: A ScoreSense account is required to access the ScoreSense app. If you are not a ScoreSense member, sign up for a 7-day trial and get access to your credit scores, credit reports, and credit monitoring.

bluejetty:00016550:ios.description:
HS Player is the ultimatum free music application that absolutely without advertising and in-app purchases. 
Key features:
Various musical sources.
HS Player can play any lossless file of Hi-Res FLAC / ALAC / WAV. Besides the music player has support playing from CUE-files. You can upload files with Wi-Fi, WebDAV, iTunes File Sharing, iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, Yandex.Disk, OneDrive, Mega.
Sound tuning.
HS Player offers any of the 22 standard EQ presets, but you can also create your own unique presets with a 10-band parametric EQ. To enhance the equalizer effect, you can control the Q-slider (ratio of center frequency to bandwidth). AVL preamplifier will help to eliminate distorting noises on loud sounds. If you're a novice, the app will help you set the correct level of preamplification. 
Playlists.
You can create playlists with your favourite tracks, but if you already have previously created playlists in a standard music player, it will be automatically available to HS Player.
Autostop playback on timer
If you like to fall asleep with your music, this is the music player for you.
If you encounter any issues, please contact us at hsplayerinfo@gmail.com. We will be happy to assist you.

bluejetty:00175288:ios.summary:
Windy.app - wind, waves and weather forecast app for surfers, kitesurfers, windsurfers, sailors, fishermen and other wind sports.

bluejetty:00175288:ios.description:
Windy.app - wind, waves and weather forecast app for surfers, kitesurfers, windsurfers, sailors, fishermen and other wind sports. 
FEATURES:
• Wind report, forecast and statistics: wind map, accurate wind compass, wind meter, wind gusts and wind directions. It’s very useful for extreme wind sports.
• Wind alert: Set up windalert and be aware of wind, storm and tornado warning via push-notifications
• Weather history (archive) for 2012-2024: view wind data, temperature (day and night) and atmospheric pressure. Weather archive will help you to choose the best month for travel to the spot.
• Local forecast from NOAA: temperature in Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin, humidity, wind speed, precipitation (rain and snow). Forecast for 10 days with 3 hours step in metric or imperial units: m/s (mps), mph, km/h, knt (knout), bft (beaufort), m, ft, mm, cm, in, hPa, inHg. NOAA is a National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration / National Weather Service (nws).
• Wave forecast: ocean or sea conditions, ocean waves and sea swell, fishing forecast
• Animated wind tracker: weather radar for sailing, yachting and kiting in light wind
• Cloud base/Dewpoint (dew point) data: necessary weather information for pleasant paragliding 
• Spots: over 30.000 spots sorted and located by the type and area. Add your spots to favourites.
• Spot chats. Got anemometer? Share info about weather conditions and wind direction in the chat from a kite spot.
• Community: exchange weather reports on the spot. Want to be a local/spot leader? Email us the name of your spot at feedback@catchwind.co and we will create a chat for it.
• Weather Stations: online data from nearby online weather stations.
• Offline Mode: activate offline mode and check the forecast for your activities without internet connection.
PERFECT FOR:
• Kitesurfing (kitesurf)
• Windsurfing (wind surf)
• Surfing
• Sailing (Boating)
• Yachting
• Paragliding
• Fishing
• Snowkiting 
• Snowboarding
• Skiing
• Skydiving
• Kayaking (kayak)
• Wakeboarding
• Cycling
• Hunting (hunt)
• Golf
--------------------------
The free version allows you to use basic app functions.
WINDY PRO Account auto-renewable subscription allows using all functions of this app. Subscription length periods: 1 month with 3 days free trial, and 1 year with 7 days free trial.
Payment for WINDY PRO Account subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase. Your subscription will be automatically renewed every 30 or 365 days. If you have never subscribed to a monthly Premium account subscription before, you will have the option of getting a free 3/7-day trial period. Cancelling the trial period will immediately disable your subscription.
Payment for subscription renewals will be charged to your account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can disable subscription renewal in your iTunes account settings on your device.
Terms of Use: https://windyapp.co/CustomMenuItems/34/en
--------------------------

bluejetty:00123974:ios.description:
Choose your own adventure in Fallen Road. Your new interactive story game all about angels and demons.
To progress forward in the story, you must make decisive choices during your missions but also during your conversations with other characters.
Story:
You woke up in a disused factory, wounded, and with amnesia. Jeff, a Protector, found you and took care of you. You have no memory of your past. Jeff initiates you then into the secrets of this world.
Angels and demons do indeed exist. And the Protectors, whose ranks you have joined, strive to maintain the delicate balance between these two worlds. Between your mission and searching for clues to your past, will you be able to resist temptation and stay on the right path?
Highlights:
- A new chapter available every 2 weeks
- Your decisions influence the story
- The story is 100% in English
- Fight demons & meet angels!
- Stunning graphics
Follow us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/isitlovegames/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/isitlovegames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weareisitlovegames/
Got any problems or questions?
Contact our in-game support team by clicking on Menu and then Support.
Our story:
1492 Studio is based in Montpellier, France. It was co-founded in 2014 by Claire and Thibaud Zamora, two entrepreneurs with over twenty years’ experience in the freemium game industry. Acquired by Ubisoft in 2018, the studio has forged ahead in creating interactive stories in the form of visual novels, further enriching the content of their "Is It Love?" series. With a total of fourteen mobile applications with more than 60 million downloads to date, 1492 Studio designs games that take players on a journey through worlds that are rich in intrigue, suspense and, of course, romance. The studio continues to provide live games by creating additional content and keeping in touch with a strong and active fan base while working on upcoming projects.

bluejetty:00015802:ios.description:
***** Fun educational games that teach first words *****
***** Learn names of shapes, animals, fruits, clothes, and more *****
***** Perfect for babies and toddlers *****
Expand your child’s vocabulary and fine motor skills with this must-have educational app for all curious babies & toddlers. Packed with simple fun circus-themed games, the app provides an ideal environment for early learning and delights children’s imagination. Children learn names of common animals, shapes, fruits, and so much more.
==== Join over 40,000,000 kids who love playing with award-winning 22learn apps. ====
Monkey Abby goes on a new adventure. This time, Abby goes to the circus! On her journey, she encounters many endearing circus animals. There are playful elephants, seals, and even adorable twin monkeys. The animals perform fun tricks in exchange for children’s help.
Children learn new words while playing a variety of games that also grow their fine motor skills and problem solving skill. For example, children are challenged to match objects to their shades, find the other halves of pictures, or assemble puzzles. The name of each picture is clearly pronounced during the game to familiarize children with the words. For added challenge, children practice their knowledge in recognition games, in which they search for a correct picture based on the word called.
CHILDREN LEARN AND PRACTICE:
- vocabulary
- fine motor skills
- problem solving skills
- attention
FEATURES:
- 10 educational learning categories: fruits, vegetables, clothing, toys, outdoors, weather, wild animals, farm animals, shapes, vehicles
- 8 games for each learning category
- 2 learning modes: interactive flashcards & fun games
- Varied game types: matching, puzzles, & recognition games
- Rewarding mini-games and animations
- All words professionally pronounced in U.S. English
- Easy to use interface
This app features solid educational content, beautiful design, funny animations, and professional voice-over. We hope your children will love the app the same way our little beta-testers did! Have fun playing. If you ever need any help or just want to say hi, please get in touch with us at info@22learn.com. We’ll be happy to hear from you.

Podcast Studio App lets you record, publish, distribute and analyze your podcast, whenever and wherever, easily. Our uniqu
bluejetty:00035177:ios.description:
Podcast Studio has everything you need to create a professional-sounding podcast from your phone, tablet or desktop.
Podcast Studio App lets you record, publish, distribute and analyze your podcast, whenever and wherever, easily. Our unique in-app features, give you total podcasting flexibility at your fingertips, making it ideal for on-the-go podcasting.
Podcast Studio is a podcast creator app for all levels of podcaster, from beginner to experienced. The user-friendly interface makes managing a podcast from creation to distribution.
Download to make a podcast your way.
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS:
RECORD
- Record your audio on the go.
- Experiment with mic controls and auto-ducking.
- Upload files or migrate old content over.
EDIT
- Trim or crop your audio straight from the app to get it sounding super slick.
MANAGE & DISTRIBUTE
- A podcast manager to make your life simpler: upload and schedule content, publish to social media, or see your show’s vital stats.
- Share with all the major podcast platforms in seconds (Google Podcasts, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and more) with one-tap distribution.
ANALYZE
- Get real-time statistics showing plays, sources, geolocation, and episode listening evolution.
- Our stats are IAB compliant.
PRO PLANS:
With Studio you can upgrade to a Pro plan directly from the app.
Pro features include:
- Longer recording sessions (with the free version offering 15 minutes of recording time per episode)
- Better statistics
...plus more options are available only on the website!
Pro plan subscriptions:
- BROADCASTER $19.99/month
- ANCHORMAN $49.99/month
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. Manage your subscriptions in the Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use: http://www.spreaker.com/terms
Privacy Policy: http://www.spreaker.com/privacy

bluejetty:00063904:ios.description:

Podcast? Video content? Double check! Access songs and podcast from Cambodian & International artists in genres that you love. To top it off, get curated jams that tailor-made for you.
ASSORTED FEATURES 
• A digital library of 1,000,000+ songs– You’ll be spoilt for choice! 
• Rock, Pop, Rap, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Trance, EDM, Dance, Disco, Classical, Salsa, Party Hits, New Songs, Old Songs, Sad Songs, Romantic , Khmer Songs, DJ mixes, Instrumental, International Music, Albums & what not! The list goes on. 
• Discovery – Get music that matches your mood 
• Radio - On-demand channels curated for you 
• Brand New Player – Shuffle it. Repeat it. Play it.
• Artist Profiles – Now follow your favorite artists and don’t miss a beat. 
• Now login with your mobile number and have one login for multiple devices – so that you don’t miss a beat.
• Songs that you’ve been playing on loop are right on top. 
• We also arm you with recommendations in tune with your tastes & bent. 
ENDLESS ENTERTAINMENT WITH PLENG PRO 
• WiFi down? Sketchy network? Internet off? Music is still on! 
• Avoid pesky data charges! Take all your music offline. 
• Ad-free = Stress-free. No drama only Pleng!
• Watch exclusive video content. 
• HD music at your fingertips – Enjoy unlimited offline listening.
UNITY IN DIVERSITY 
Our fest from the west comprises of Mariah Carey, Taylor Swift, Justin Bieber, Billie Eilish, Harry Styles, Selena Gomez, the Chainsmokers, Katy Perry, Enrique, Shakira, Eminem, Jennifer Lopez, Rihanna, Pitbull, Pink Sweat, Olivia Rodrigo & just to name a few.
We have it all from egg to apple- Khmer For Pop we have G-Devith, Suly Peng, Kmeng Khmer, SmallWorld SmallBand, Adda, Heng Pitu, Chet Kanhchana, Fulet, Oun. For Retro we have Sin Sisamuth, Meng Keo Pechta, Ros Sereysothea. 
For Rock we have P-Sand, Sam Rocker , Oung Soria, Suffer. We have hip Hop too with CG Movement, T.O., Tempo Tris. Or all songs from our local production houses like Hang Meas, Galaxy Navatra, Town, Sunday, KlapYaHandz, Rondom and more. 
MUSIC FOR YOUR MOOD 
- Monday blues got you down? A workout sesh in progress? Keep your music in sync with your mood with the Discovery feature of the app. 
LISTEN & EARN 
- Play & share songs, invite friends, create playlists. Earn points as you interact.
- Redeem the points & go Pleng PRO for FREE.
WHAT’S YOUR PICK 
Our diverse Pleng PRO subscription plans will never let your options run dry. Subscribe & enjoy unlimited music and video content downloads.

Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com

bluejetty:00062716:ios.summary:
Sporty’s innovative Pilot Training app brings a variety of aviation training courses to one location, allowing you to access all of your Sporty's aviation content from your iPad, iPhone or AppleTV.
It’s free to get started - including inte
bluejetty:00062716:ios.description:
Sporty’s innovative Pilot Training app brings a variety of aviation training courses to one location, allowing you to access all of your Sporty's aviation content from your iPad, iPhone or AppleTV.
It’s free to get started - including interactive free FAA handbooks, free FAR/AIM, FAA practice tests and HD/4K training videos.
SPORTY’S 2026 LEARN TO FLY COURSE
For the cost of a single flight lesson, Sporty’s Learn to Fly course will save you time and money earning your pilot certificate. This is not a weekend “cram course” or a boring ground school lecture on video. It is a comprehensive flight-training companion designed to make your lessons more efficient, more complete and more fun. There is nothing extra to buy—just add flight instructor!
INCLUDES: 20 hours of HD video training with search, knowledge test prep, interactive flight maneuvers guide, video-referenced Airman Certification Standards (ACS), Flight Training Syllabus, Ask a CFI service.
After successful course completion, you’ll earn an FAA knowledge test endorsement and FAA WINGS credit.
SPORTY’S 2026 INSTRUMENT RATING COURSE 
With Sporty’s Complete Instrument Rating Course, you’ll ace your FAA written test—we guarantee it! But this app is much more than just test prep. With incredible in-flight footage and 3D animations, we unlock the secrets of the IFR system so you can be a safe, smooth and proficient pilot. Detailed video segments cover both glass cockpits and analog gauges.
INCLUDES: 13 hours of video training, knowledge test prep, interactive instrument maneuvers guide, video-referenced Airman Certification Standards (ACS), Flight Training Syllabus, Ask a CFI service.
AVIATION COURSE LIBRARY

bluejetty:00123442:ios.description:
Are you tired of suffering from the symptoms of Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)? The FODMAP diet is a proven method for reducing or eliminating these symptoms, and our app makes it easy to follow!
Developed by Australian researchers in 2005, the FODMAP diet involves removing certain carbohydrates from your diet over a specific period of time. But everyone's body is different, which is why our app offers a personalized analysis of your diet.
While it's not free, our app is much cheaper than a visit to a nutritionist. With our easy-to-use interface, you can systematically record what you eat and the symptoms you experience after eating. By keeping track of your meals, you can identify which foods trigger your symptoms and avoid them in the future.
With the integration of Open AI into our app, we've taken it to the next level of intelligence. It's now easier than ever to whip up delicious recipes. Simply select your desired ingredients, choose the role of AI, and voila! Prepare to be amazed by the mouthwatering recipes that await you. Get ready to unleash the power of AI and elevate your culinary experience like never before!
And for your convenience, our app can even use HealthKit to log your symptoms automatically. Rest assured, it will ask for your permission first.
Our app was developed in collaboration with Dietary Specialist Sarah Munn, so you can trust that it's based on the latest research and expertise. Download it now and take control of your IBS symptoms with the FODMAP diet!
__________________________________
Before you begin to use this diet, I highly recommend consulting your doctor. Any action based on the contents found in this app is taken at the sole discretion and sole liability of the person using the app.
__________________________________

bluejetty:00070957:ios.name: MileTracker Pro
bluejetty:00070957:ios.summary:
MileTracker Pro is the easiest and most feature rich app to track your mileage & driving expenses. Get ready for 2021 and start saving money now!
MileTracker allows you to track mileage the way YOU want offering several different methods.
bluejetty:00070957:ios.description:
MileTracker Pro is the easiest and most feature rich app to track your mileage & driving expenses. Get ready for 2021 and start saving money now!
MileTracker allows you to track mileage the way YOU want offering several different methods. Then when tax time arrives or expense reports are needed, you can easily create beautiful reports (accountants love our reports).
MileTracker Pro is finely tuned and exceptionally reliable. MileTracker Pro replaces our MileTracker app which has been helping users track their time worked since 2010.
WHY MileTracker IS BETTER
* Elegant user interface
* The most powerful and flexible Reporting features available
* Offers considerably more features than other mileage tracking apps
* Quick and easy on-screen filtering to view your tracked data
* Organize your entries into Logs for maximum ease
* Distinguish between Personal and Business
EASE OF USE
* The MOST extensive set of preferences available allowing you to customize the app and truly make it your own
* Hide fields you do not use for concise entry forms
* Remembers frequently used choices
* Quick menu with list of frequent trips for super fast entry
TRACK MILEAGE - Requires subscription to Unlimited Usage
* Track mileage the way you want:
 1. LIVE mileage tracking - the app will track your every move via GPS. This feature requires you to tell the app when you start and stop.
 2. Enter Start/Stop odometer reading
 3. Enter the start address and end address-the app will determine the travel distance
 4. Special “real-estate agent” feature which allows one entry to contain multiple legs.
* If using odometer, remembers last stop mileage and pre-fills start for next entry
* Mark an entry as round trip to double the distance
* Supports Multiple Vehicles
* Miles or Km
* Customizable mileage allowance
AUTOTRACK - Requires subscription to AutoTrack (includes everything that Unlimited Usage includes too). See more details below.
DRIVING EXPENSES
* Track Fuel, Tolls and Parking expenses
PHOTO RECEIPTS
* Take photos of receipts
* Crop images easily
REPORTING
* IRS compliant reporting
* The most flexible and powerful reporting available
* On-screen preview
* Choose the attractive PDF format or CSV for importing into Excel
* Email your reports and photo receipts
* Export your reports to iCloud, Dropbox or your computer
* Accountants LOVE our reports because they provide all the key information needed
ON-SCREEN FILTERING
* Sort entries by Date, Category or Client
* Extensive on-screen filtering to find out EXACTLY what you need to know
BACKUP AND SAFE KEEPING
* Backup your data to iCloud, Dropbox or directly to your computer
* Set backup to “Automatic” so your data is always safe
SYNC
* Keep your data synced between multiple devices (ie your iPhone and iPad)
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
* When first installed allows up to 25 manual entries
* After using the 25 entries you will need to subscribe
* There are two subscription options, Unlimited Usage or AutoTrack (available monthly or yearly)
* Unlimited Usage is for those who prefer to track their mileage manually.
* AutoTrack is for those who want a FULLY automatic tracking solution. All you need to do is carry your device with you. Then at your leisure “approve” those drives you wish to keep.
* A new subscription includes 2 free weeks of unlimited usage. You can cancel prior to the end of the trial without any cost to you.
* Payment charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
* Automatic renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
Demo Video on AutoTrack at: tinyurl.com/MileTracker
silverwaresoftware.com/privacy
silverwaresoftware.com/terms
------
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life
Questions/comments? Just choose the Email the Author link in the Prefs screen in the app

bluejetty:00135747:ios.description:
VEED Lite — AI Quick Edits, Captions & Talking Videos
Fast, AI-powered video editing right on your phone. VEED Lite turns raw clips into polished short-form content in minutes — automatic edits, captions, and AI talking-head videos, with no learning curve. Built for creators, businesses, and anyone posting to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn.
VEED Lite or VEED — which one do you need?
VEED Lite (this app) is the quick, lightweight option: AI auto-editing, captions, and AI talking videos for clips up to 10 minutes, all done right here on your phone.
VEED (our full app) is the complete AI video creation platform, with stronger customization options, but also a full video editor, support for longer videos, text-to-speech, voice cloning, transitions, background removal, and 50+ additional features - also offering seamless editing across web and mobile, with your projects always kept in sync.
Want a fully-fledged video creation platform, or powerful, cross-device editing? Get VEED. 
Staying for fast, AI-first essentials? You're in the right place.
What VEED Lite does
AI Talking Videos — Powered by Fabric
We built Fabric, the best AI video generation model in the game. Create talking videos with AI actors that actually look and sound real.
- Create your own AI actors — describe who you want, and we'll generate them. Full control over appearance, voice, and style.
- Best-in-class talking video quality — Fabric delivers lip-sync, expressions, and motion that competitors can't touch.
- Script to video in minutes — type your script, pick (or create) an actor, and you're done.
This is the fastest way to make talking-head content without filming yourself.
Automatic Editing with AI
Upload or record a video. VEED Lite edits it for you.
- Styles you can swipe through — we apply edits automatically, you pick your favorite.
- Toggle off what you don't like — we'll remember for next time.
- Saves hours per video.
Features That Actually Matter
Auto captions
- Multiple styles, designed to maximize views
- Translate into different languages
- Remove silences and filler words automatically
AI zooms
- We zoom in at key moments, automatically
- This makes your videos much more dynamic
AI background music
- Generate royalty-free music
- No licensing headaches
AI B-roll
- Generate B-roll to support your story
- Multiple styles (we use Flux, Nano-banana, and more)
Background noise removal
- Always sound like you're in a studio
Quick editing essentials
- Trim clips and add music, text, stickers, and GIFs
- Powerful on-device edits - your videos stay right here on your phone
Share everywhere
- One tap to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more
- Auto-resize for each platform
Who VEED Lite is for
Quick edits on the go — whether you're a creator, small business owner, marketer, or posting for the first time. 
Want a fully-fledged AI video creation platform, a complete editing toolkit, or to pick up your edits across devices and desktop? Head to the full VEED app.
PAYMENT:
If you subscribe via Apple, payment is charged to your App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions and auto-renewal in Account Settings on your iPhone.
ABOUT VEED.IO
VEED.IO is the fastest way to create pro-level videos on the web. Now we're bringing that same power to your iPhone. We want to make the best mobile video editing app around, so we're listening to your feedback to take this app to the next level.
Feedback? Email us at mobile-support@veed.io
The VEED team

- Custom summary templates

- Full, easy export
